verses.en: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.fr: Chacun avait quatre faces; la face du premier était une face de chérubin, la face du second une face d''homme, celle du troisième une face de lion, et celle du quatrième une face d''aigle.
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱም አራት አራት ፊት ነበሩት፤ አንደኛው ፊት የኪሩብ ፊት፥ ሁለተኛውም የሰው ፊት፥ ሦስተኛው የአንበሳ ፊት፥ አራተኛውም የንስር ፊት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
verses.fr: Et les chérubins s''élevèrent. C''étaient les animaux que j''avais vus près du fleuve du Kebar.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልም ከፍ ከፍ አሉ፤ ይህ በኮቦር ወንዝ ያየሁት እንስሳ ነው።

verses.en: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
verses.fr: Quand les chérubins marchaient, les roues cheminaient à côté d''eux; et quand les chérubins déployaient leurs ailes pour s''élever de terre, les roues aussi ne se détournaient point d''eux.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልም ሲሄዱ መንኰራኵሮቹ በአጠገባቸው ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ኪሩቤልም ከምድር ከፍ ከፍ ይሉ ዘንድ ክንፎቻቸውን ሲዘረጉ መንኰራኵሮች ደግሞ ከአጠገባቸው ፈቀቅ አይሉም ነበር።

verses.en: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.fr: Quand ils s''arrêtaient, elles s''arrêtaient, et quand ils s''élevaient, elles s''élevaient avec eux, car l''esprit des animaux était en elles.
verses.am: ሕይወት ያላቸው የእንስሶች መንፈስ በመንኰራኵሮች ውስጥ ነበረና እነዚህ ሲቆሙ እነዚያ ይቆሙ ነበር፥ እነዚህም ከፍ ከፍ ሲሉ እነዚያ ከእነርሱ ጋር ከፍ ከፍ ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Then the glory of the Lord departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
verses.fr: La gloire de l''Eternel se retira du seuil de la maison, et se plaça sur les chérubins.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ከቤቱ መድረክ ላይ ወጥቶ በኪሩቤል ላይ ቆመ።

verses.en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the Lord's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.fr: Les chérubins déployèrent leurs ailes, et s''élevèrent de terre sous mes yeux quand ils partirent, accompagnés des roues. Ils s''arrêtèrent à l''entrée de la porte de la maison de l''Eternel vers l''orient; et la gloire du Dieu d''Israël était sur eux, en haut.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልም ክንፎቻቸውን ዘረጉ እኔም እያየሁ ከምድር ከፍ ከፍ አሉ፤ በወጡም ጊዜ መንኰራኵሮች በአጠገባቸው ነበሩ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በምሥራቁ በር መግቢያ ቆሙ፥ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ክብር በላያቸው ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
verses.fr: C''étaient les animaux que j''avais vus sous le Dieu d''Israël près du fleuve du Kebar, et je reconnus que c''étaient des chérubins.
verses.am: ይህ በኮበር ወንዝ ከእስራኤል አምላክ በታች ያየሁት እንስሳ ነው፥ ኪሩቤልም እንደ ነበሩ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.en: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.fr: Chacun avait quatre faces, chacun avait quatre ailes, et une forme de main d''homme était sous leurs ailes.
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱ አራት አራት ፊት፥ ለእያንዳንዱም አራት አራት ክንፍ ነበሩት፥ የሰውም እጅ አምሳያ ከክንፎቻቸው በታች ነበረ።

verses.en: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
verses.fr: Leurs faces étaient semblables à celles que j''avais vues près du fleuve du Kebar; c''était le même aspect, c''était eux-mêmes. Chacun marchait droit devant soi.
verses.am: ፊቶቻቸውም በኮቦር ወንዝ ያየኋቸውን ፊቶች ይመስሉ ነበር፤ እነርሱና መልካቸውም እንዲሁ ነበረ፤ እያንዳንዱም አቅንቶ ወደ ፊት ይሄድ ነበር።

verses.en: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the Lord's house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.fr: L''esprit m''enleva, et me transporta à la porte orientale de la maison de l''Eternel, à celle qui regarde l''orient. Et voici, à l''entrée de la porte, il y avait vingt-cinq hommes; et je vis au milieu d''eux Jaazania, fils d''Azzur, et Pelathia, fils de Benaja, chefs du peuple.
verses.am: መንፈስም አነሣኝ፤ ወደ ፀሐይ መውጫ ወደሚመለከት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤትም ወደ ምሥራቁ በር አመጣኝ። እነሆም፥ በበሩ መግቢያ ሀያ አምስት ሰዎች ነበሩ፥ በመካከላቸውም የሕዝቡን አለቆች የዓዙርን ልጅ ያእዛንያንና የበናያስ ልጅ ፈላጥያን አየሁ።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel me dit: Fils de l''homme, ce sont les hommes qui méditent l''iniquité, et qui donnent de mauvais conseils dans cette ville.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ክፋትን የሚያስቡ በዚህችም ከተማ ክፉን ምክር የሚመክሩ ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
verses.fr: Ils disent: Ce n''est pas le moment! Bâtissons des maisons! La ville est la chaudière, et nous sommes la viande.
verses.am: እነርሱም። በውኑ ቤቶችን የምንሠራበት ዘመን የቀረበ አይደለምን? ይህች ከተማ ድስት እኛም ሥጋ ነን ብለዋል።

verses.en: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi prophétise contre eux, prophétise, fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ትንቢት ተናገርባቸው፤ ትንቢት ተናገር።

verses.en: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the Lord; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
verses.fr: Alors l''esprit de l''Eternel tomba sur moi. Et il me dit: Dis: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Vous parlez de la sorte, maison d''Israël! Et ce qui vous monte à la pensée, je le sais.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ ወደቀብኝ እንዲህም አለኝ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ተናገር። የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ይህን ነገር ተናግራችኋል፥ እኔም የልባችሁን አሳብ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
verses.fr: Vous avez multiplié les meurtres dans cette ville, Vous avez rempli les rues de cadavres.
verses.am: በዚህች ከተማ ውስጥ ግዳዮቻችሁን አብዝታችኋል በጎዳናዎችዋም ግዳዮችን ሞልታችኋል።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Vos morts que vous avez étendus au milieu d''elle, C''est la viande, et elle, c''est la chaudière; Mais vous, on vous en fera sortir.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመካከልዋ ያኖራችኋቸው ግዳዮቻችሁ እነርሱ ሥጋው ናቸው፥ ይህችም ከተማ ድስቱ ናት፤ እናንተን ግን ከመካከልዋ አወጣችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Vous avez peur de l''épée, Et je ferai venir sur vous l''épée, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰይፍን ፈርታችኋል እኔም ሰይፍን አመጣባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
verses.fr: Je vous ferai sortir du milieu d''elle, Je vous livrerai entre les mains des étrangers, Et j''exercerai contre vous mes jugements.
verses.am: ከመካከልዋም አወጣችኋለሁ፥ በእንግዶችም እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ በላያችሁም ፍርድ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous tomberez par l''épée, Je vous jugerai sur la frontière d''Israël, Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሰይፍ ትወድቃላችሁ በእስራኤልም ድንበር እፈርድባችኋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
verses.fr: La ville ne sera pas pour vous une chaudière, Et vous ne serez pas la viande au milieu d''elle: C''est sur la frontière d''Israël que je vous jugerai.
verses.am: ይህች ከተማ ድስት አትሆንላችሁም እናንተም በመካከልዋ ሥጋ አትሆኑም፥ እኔም በእስራኤል ድንበር እፈርድባችኋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am the Lord: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
verses.fr: Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel, Dont vous n''avez pas suivi les ordonnances Et pratiqué les lois; Mais vous avez agi selon les lois des nations qui vous entourent.
verses.am: በትእዛዜ አልሄዳችሁምና፥ ፍርዴንም አላደረጋችሁምና፤ በዙሪያችሁም እንደሚኖሩት እንደ አሕዛብ ሕግ አድርጋችኋል።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord God! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
verses.fr: Comme je prophétisais, Pelathia, fils de Benaja, mourut. Je tombai sur ma face, et je m''écriai à haute voix: Ah! Seigneur Eternel, anéantiras-tu ce qui reste d''Israël?
verses.am: ትንቢትም በተናገርሁ ጊዜ የበናያስ ልጅ ፈላጥያ ሞተ፤ እኔም በግምባሬ ተደፍቼ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ! በውኑ የእስራኤልን ቅሬታ ፈጽመህ ታጠፋለህን? ብዬ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኽሁ።

verses.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the Lord: unto us is this land given in possession.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, ce sont tes frères, tes frères, Ceux de ta parenté, et la maison d''Israël tout entière, A qui les habitants de Jérusalem disent: Restez loin de l''Eternel, Le pays nous a été donné en propriété.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ። ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ራቁ፤ ይህች ምድር ርስት ሆና ለእኛ ተሰጥታለች የሚሉአቸው ወንድሞችህና ዘመዶችህ የወገኖችህም ሰዎች ሁሉ የእስራኤልም ቤት ሁሉ ናቸው።

verses.en: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Si je les tiens éloignés parmi les nations, Si je les ai dispersés en divers pays, Je serai pour eux quelque temps un asile Dans les pays où ils sont venus.
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ ወደ አሕዛብ አርቄአቸዋለሁ፥ ወደ አገሮችም በትኛቸዋለሁ፤ ይሁን እንጂ፥ በመጡባቸው አገሮች በእነዚያ ትንሽ መቅደስ እሆናቸዋለሁ በል።

verses.en: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Je vous rassemblerai du milieu des peuples, Je vous recueillerai des pays où vous êtes dispersés, Et je vous donnerai la terre d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከአሕዛብ ዘንድ አከማቻችኋለሁ ከተበተናችሁባቸውም አገሮች እሰበስባችኋለሁ፥ የእስራኤልንም ምድር እሰጣችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
verses.fr: C''est là qu''ils iront, Et ils en ôteront toutes les idoles et toutes les abominations.
verses.am: ወደዚያም ይመጣሉ፥ ጸያፉንና ርኩሱንም ነገር ሁሉ ከእርስዋ ያወጣሉ።

verses.en: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
verses.fr: Je leur donnerai un même coeur, Et je mettrai en vous un esprit nouveau; J''ôterai de leur corps le coeur de pierre, Et je leur donnerai un coeur de chair,
verses.am: ልባቸውም ጸያፍንና ርኩስን ነገር በሚከተል በእነርሱ ራስ ላይ መንገዳቸውን እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils suivent mes ordonnances, Et qu''ils observent et pratiquent mes lois; Et ils seront mon peuple, et je serai leur Dieu.
verses.am: ልባቸውም ጸያፍንና ርኩስን ነገር በሚከተል በእነርሱ ራስ ላይ መንገዳቸውን እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Mais pour ceux dont le coeur se plaît à leurs idoles et à leurs abominations, Je ferai retomber leurs oeuvres sur leur tête, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልም ክንፎቻቸውን ዘረጉ፥ መንኰራኵሮችም በአጠገባቸው ነበሩ፤ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ክብር በላያቸው ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.fr: Les chérubins déployèrent leurs ailes, accompagnés des roues; et la gloire du Dieu d''Israël était sur eux, en haut.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ከከተማይቱ ውስጥ ተነሥቶ በከተማይቱ ምሥራቅ በኩል ባለው ተራራ ላይ ቆመ።

verses.en: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
verses.fr: La gloire de l''Eternel s''éleva du milieu de la ville, et elle se plaça sur la montagne qui est à l''orient de la ville.
verses.am: መንፈስም አነሣኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በራእይ ወደ ከላውዴዎን ምድር ወደ ምርኮኞቹ አመጣኝ። ያየሁትም ራእይ ከእኔ ወጥቶ ተለየ።

verses.en: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.fr: L''esprit m''enleva, et me transporta en Chaldée auprès des captifs, en vision par l''esprit de Dieu; et la vision que j''avais eue disparut au-dessus de moi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያሳየኝን ነገር ሁሉ ለምርኮኞች ተናገርሁ።

verses.en: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the Lord had shewed me.
verses.fr: Je dis aux captifs toutes les paroles de l''Eternel, qu''il m''avait révélées.
verses.am: ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያሳየኝን ነገር ሁሉ ለምርኮኞች ተናገርሁ።

verses.en: The word of the Lord also came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tu habites au milieu d''une famille de rebelles, qui ont des yeux pour voir et qui ne voient point, des oreilles pour entendre et qui n''entendent point; car c''est une famille de rebelles.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በዓመፀኛ ቤት መካከል ተቀምጠሃል፤ ያዩ ዘንድ ዓይን አላቸው እነርሱም አያዩም፥ ይሰሙም ዘንድ ጆሮ አላቸው እነርሱም አይሰሙም፤ እነርሱ ዓመፀኛ ቤት ናቸውና።

verses.en: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, prépare tes effets de voyage, et pars de jour, sous leurs yeux! Pars, en leur présence, du lieu où tu es pour un autre lieu: peut-être verront-ils qu''ils sont une famille de rebelles.
verses.am: አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የስደተኛ እክት አዘጋጅ በፊታቸውም ቀን ለቀን ተማረክ፥ በፊታቸውም ከስፍራ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ ተማርከህ ሂድ፤ እነርሱም ዓመፀኛ ቤት እንደ ሆኑ ምናልባት ያስተውሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
verses.fr: Sors tes effets comme des effets de voyage, de jour sous leurs yeux; et toi, pars le soir, en leur présence, comme partent des exilés.
verses.am: ቀን ለቀንም በፊታቸው እክትህን እንደ ስደተኛ እክት አውጣው፥ በማታም ጊዜ በፊታቸው ስደተኞች እንደሚወጡ እንዲሁ ውጣ።

verses.en: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
verses.fr: Sous leurs yeux, tu perceras la muraille, et tu sortiras tes effets par là.
verses.am: በፊታቸውም ግንቡን ንደል በእርሱም አውጣ።

verses.en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Sous leurs yeux, tu les mettras sur ton épaule, tu les sortiras pendant l''obscurité, tu te couvriras le visage, et tu ne regarderas pas la terre; car je veux que tu sois un signe pour la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ቤት ምልክት አድርጌሃለሁና በፊታቸው በጫንቃህ ላይ አንግተው፥ በጨለማም ተሸክመህ ውጣ፤ ምድሪቱንም እንዳታይ ፊትህን ሸፍን።

verses.en: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
verses.fr: Je fis ce qui m''avait été ordonné: je sortis de jour mes effets comme des effets de voyage, le soir je perçai la muraille avec la main, et je les sortis pendant l''obscurité et les mis sur mon épaule, en leur présence.
verses.am: እንዳዘዘኝም አደረግሁ፤ ቀን ለቀንም እክቱን እንደ ስደተኛ እክት አወጣሁ፥ በማታም ጊዜ ግንቡን በእጄ ነደልሁ፥ በጨለማም አወጣሁት በፊታቸውም በጫንቃዬ ላይ አንግቼ ተሸከምሁት።

verses.en: And in the morning came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Le matin, la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: በነጋውም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, la maison d''Israël, cette famille de rebelles ne t''a-t-elle pas dit: Que fais-tu?
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ዓመፀኛ ቤት የእስራኤል ቤት። የምታደርገው ምንድር ነው? አላሉህምን?

verses.en: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
verses.fr: Dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Cet oracle concerne le prince qui est à Jérusalem, et toute la maison d''Israël qui s''y trouve.
verses.am: አንተም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ሸክም በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖረው አለቃ ላይ በመካከላቸውም በሚኖሩት በእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ላይ ነው በላቸው።

verses.en: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
verses.fr: Dis: Je suis pour vous un signe. Ce que j''ai fait, c''est ce qui leur sera fait: Ils iront en exil, en captivité.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እኔ ምልክታችሁ ነኝ፤ እኔ እንዳደረግሁ እንዲሁ ይደረግባቸዋል፥ እነርሱም በስደት ወደ ምርኮ ይሄዳሉ በል።

verses.en: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
verses.fr: Le prince qui est au milieu d''eux Mettra son bagage sur l''épaule pendant l''obscurité et partira; On percera la muraille pour le faire sortir; Il se couvrira le visage, Pour que ses yeux ne regardent pas la terre.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም የሚኖረው አለቃ በጫንቃው ላይ አንግቶ በጨለማ ይወጣል፤ በዚያ ያወጡ ዘንድ ግንቡን ይነድላሉ፥ በዓይኑም ምድርን እንዳያይ ፊቱን ይሸፍናል።

verses.en: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.fr: J''étendrai mon rets sur lui, Et il sera pris dans mon filet; Je l''emmènerai à Babylone, dans le pays des Chaldéens; Mais il ne le verra pas, et il y mourra.
verses.am: መረቤንም በእርሱ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ በወጥመዴም ይያዛል፥ ወደ ከለዳውያንም ምድር ወደ ባቢሎን አመጣዋለሁ፤ ሆኖም አያያትም በዚያም ይሞታል።

verses.en: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui l''entourent et lui sont en aide, Et toutes ses troupes, je les disperserai à tous les vents, Et je tirerai l''épée derrière eux.
verses.am: ሊረዱትም በዙሪያው ያሉትን ሁሉ ጭፍሮቹንም ሁሉ ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ በኋላቸውም ሰይፍ እመዝዛለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
verses.fr: Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel, Quand je les répandrai parmi les nations, Quand je les disperserai en divers pays.
verses.am: በአሕዛብም መካከል በበተንኋቸው ጊዜ፥ በአገሮችም በዘራኋቸው ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais je laisserai d''eux quelques hommes Qui échapperont à l''épée, à la famine et à la peste, Afin qu''ils racontent toutes leurs abominations Parmi les nations où ils iront. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሚሄዱባቸውም አሕዛብ መካከል ርኵሰታቸውን ሁሉ ይናገሩ ዘንድ ከሰይፍና ከራብ ከቸነፈርም ጥቂቶች ሰዎችን ከእነርሱ አስቀራለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tu mangeras ton pain avec tremblement, Tu boiras ton eau avec inquiétude et angoisse.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እንጀራህን በድንጋጤ ብላ ውኃህንም በመንቀጥቀጥና በኀዘን ጠጣ፤

verses.en: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord God of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
verses.fr: Dis au peuple du pays: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel, Sur les habitants de Jérusalem dans la terre d''Israël! Ils mangeront leur pain avec angoisse, Et ils boiront leur eau avec épouvante; Car leur pays sera dépouillé de tout ce qu''il contient, A cause de la violence de tous ceux qui l''habitent.
verses.am: ለምድሪቱም ሕዝብ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም ስለሚኖሩ ስለ እስራኤልም ምድር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለሚኖሩባት ሁሉ ግፍ ምድሪቱ ከነሞላዋ ትጠፋ ዘንድ እንጀራቸውን በችግር ይበላሉ ወኃቸውንም በድንጋጤ ይጠጣሉ።

verses.en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Les villes peuplées seront détruites, Et le pays sera ravagé. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰዎች የሚኖሩባቸው ከተሞች ባድማ ይሆናሉ ምድሪቱም ውድማ ትሆናለች፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ በላቸው።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, que signifient ces discours moqueurs Que vous tenez dans le pays d''Israël: Les jours se prolongent, Et toutes les visions restent sans effet?
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በእስራኤል ምድር። ዘመኑ ረዝሞአል ራእዩም ሁሉ ጠፍቶአል የምትሉት ምሳሌ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord God; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Je ferai cesser ces discours moqueurs; On ne les tiendra plus en Israël. Dis-leur, au contraire: Les jours approchent, Et toutes les visions s''accompliront.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እንዲህ በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህን ምሳሌ አስቀረዋለሁ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ደግሞ ምሳሌ አድርገው አይናገሩትም፤ አንተ ግን። ዘመኑና የራእዩ ሁሉ ነገር ቀርቦአል በላቸው።

verses.en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Car il n''y aura plus de visions vaines, Ni d''oracles trompeurs, Au milieu de la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ በእስራኤል ቤት መካከል ከንቱ ራእይና ውሸተኛ ምዋርት አይሆንም።

verses.en: For I am the Lord: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Car moi, l''Eternel, je parlerai; Ce que je dirai s''accomplira, Et ne sera plus différé; Oui, de vos jours, famille de rebelles, Je prononcerai une parole et je l''accomplirai, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እናገራለሁ የምናገረውም ቃል ይፈጸማል፥ ደግሞም አይዘገይም፤ እናንተ ዓመፀኛ ቤት ሆይ፥ በዘመናችሁ ቃሌን እናገራለሁ እፈጽመውማለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, voici, la maison d''Israël dit: Les visions qu''il a ne sont pas près de s''accomplir; Il prophétise pour des temps éloignés.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ቤት። ይህች የሚያያት ራእይ ለብዙ ዘመን ናት፥ እርሱም ለሩቅ ወራት ትንቢት ይናገራል ይላሉ።

verses.en: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Il n''y aura plus de délai dans l''accomplissement de mes paroles; La parole que je prononcerai s''accomplira, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የምናገረው ቃል ይፈጸማል እንጂ ከቃሌ ሁሉ ደግሞ የሚዘገይ የለም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the Lord;
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, prophétise contre les prophètes d''Israël qui prophétisent, Et dis à ceux qui prophétisent selon leur propre coeur: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ትንቢት በሚናገሩ በእስራኤል ነቢያት ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር፥ ከገዛ ልባቸውም ትንቢት የሚናገሩትን። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ በላቸው፤

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Malheur aux prophètes insensés, Qui suivent leur propre esprit et qui ne voient rien!
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ምንምን ሳያዩ የገዛ መንፈሳቸውን ለሚከተሉ ለሰነፎች ነቢያት ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
verses.fr: Tels des renards au milieu des ruines, Tels sont tes prophètes, ô Israël!
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ነቢያትህ በምድረ በዳ እንደሚኖሩ ቀበሮች ናቸው።

verses.en: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous n''êtes pas montés devant les brèches, Vous n''avez pas entouré d''un mur la maison d''Israël, Pour demeurer fermes dans le combat, Au jour de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወደ ተሰበረው ቅጥር አልወጣችሁም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቀን በሰልፍ ትቆሙ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ቤት ቅጥር አልሠራችሁም።

verses.en: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The Lord saith: and the Lord hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
verses.fr: Leurs visions sont vaines, et leurs oracles menteurs; Ils disent: L''Eternel a dit! Et l''Eternel ne les a point envoyés; Et ils font espérer que leur parole s''accomplira.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሳይልካቸው። እግዚአብሔር ይላል የሚሉ ሰዎች ከንቱ ነገርንና ውሸተኛ ምዋርትን አይተዋል፤ ቃሉም ይጠና ዘንድ ተስፋ አስደርገዋል።

verses.en: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The Lord saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.fr: Les visions que vous avez ne sont-elles pas vaines, Et les oracles que vous prononcez ne sont-ils pas menteurs? Vous dites: L''Eternel a dit! Et je n''ai point parlé.
verses.am: እኔም ሳልናገር። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎአል ስትሉ፥ ከንቱ ራእይን ያያችሁ ውሸተኛንም ምዋርት የተናገራችሁ አይደላችሁምን?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que vous dites des choses vaines, Et que vos visions sont des mensonges, Voici, j''en veux à vous, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከንቱ ነገርን ስለ ተናገራችሁ ውሸተኛ ራእይንም ስላያችሁ፥ ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.fr: Ma main sera contre les prophètes Dont les visions sont vaines et les oracles menteurs; Ils ne feront point partie de l''assemblée de mon peuple, Ils ne seront pas inscrits dans le livre de la maison d''Israël, Et ils n''entreront pas dans le pays d''Israël. Et vous saurez que je suis le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እጄም ከንቱ ራእይን በሚያዩ፥ በውሸትም በሚያምዋርቱ ነቢያት ላይ ትሆናለች፤ እነርሱም በሕዝቤ ማኅበር ውስጥ አይገኙም፥ በእስራኤልም ቤት መጽሐፍ አይጻፉም፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ምድር አይገቡም፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
verses.fr: Ces choses arriveront parce qu''ils égarent mon peuple, En disant: Paix! quand il n''y a point de paix. Et mon peuple bâtit une muraille, Et eux, ils la couvrent de plâtre.
verses.am: ሰላም ሳይኖር። ሰላም እያሉ ሕዝቤን አታልለዋልና፤ አንዱም ሰው ቅጥር ሲሠራ፥ እነሆ፥ ገለባ በሌለበት ጭቃ ይመርጉታልና

verses.en: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
verses.fr: Dis à ceux qui la couvrent de plâtre qu''elle s''écroulera; Une pluie violente surviendra; Et vous, pierres de grêle, vous tomberez, Et la tempête éclatera.
verses.am: ገለባ በሌለበት ጭቃ ለሚመርጉት ሰዎች። ይወድቃል በላቸው። የሚያሰጥም ዝናብ ይዘንባል፥ ታላቅም የበረዶ ድንጋይ ይወድቃል፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ይሰነጣጥቀዋል።

verses.en: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
verses.fr: Et voici, la muraille s''écroule! ne vous dira-t-on pas: Où est le plâtre dont vous l''avez couverte?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ግንቡ በወደቀ ጊዜ። የመረጋችሁት ጭቃ ወዴት አለ? አይሉአችሁምን?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Je ferai, dans ma fureur, éclater la tempête; Il surviendra, dans ma colère, une pluie violente; Et des pierres de grêle tomberont avec fureur pour détruire.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመዓቴ በዐውሎ ነፋስ እሰነጣጥቀዋለሁ፥ ያጠፋውም ዘንድ በቍጣዬ የሚያሰጥም ዝናብ፥ በመዓቴም ታላቅ የበረዶ ድንጋይ ይወርዳል።

verses.en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: J''abattrai la muraille que vous avez couverte de plâtre, Je lui ferai toucher la terre, et ses fondements seront mis à nu; Elle s''écroulera, et vous périrez au milieu de ses ruines. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ገለባም በሌለበት ጭቃ የመረጋችሁትን ቅጥር አፈርሳለሁ ወደ ምድርም እጥለዋለሁ፥ መሠረቱም ይታያል። እርሱም ይናዳል በመካከሉም ትጠፋላችሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
verses.fr: J''assouvirai ainsi ma fureur contre la muraille, Et contre ceux qui l''ont couverte de plâtre; Et je vous dirai; Plus de muraille! Et c''en est fait de ceux qui la replâtraient,
verses.am: መዓቴንም በግንቡ ላይ ገለባም በሌለበት ጭቃ በመረጉት ላይ እፈጽማለሁ፤ እኔም። ግንቡና መራጊዎቹ የሉም እላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Des prophètes d''Israël qui prophétisent sur Jérusalem, Et qui ont sur elle des visions de paix, Quand il n''y a point de paix! Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነርሱም ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ትንቢት የሚናገሩ የሰላምን ራእይ የሚያዩላት የእስራኤል ነቢያት ናቸው፥ ሰላምም የለም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, porte tes regards sur les filles de ton peuple Qui prophétisent selon leur propre coeur, Et prophétise contre elles!
verses.am: አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ከገዛ ልባቸው ትንቢት በሚናገሩ በሕዝብህ ሴቶች ልጆች ላይ ፊትህን አድርግ፤ ትንቢትም ተናገርባቸው፥

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Malheur à celles qui fabriquent des coussinets pour toutes les aisselles, Et qui font des voiles pour la tête des gens de toute taille, Afin de surprendre les âmes! Pensez-vous surprendre les âmes de mon peuple, Et conserver vos propres âmes?
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ነፍስን ለማጥመድ ለእጅ ድጋፍ ሁሉ መከዳ ለሚሰፉ ለሰውም ሁሉ ራስ እንደ እየቁመቱ ሽፋን ለሚሠሩ ሴቶች ወዮላቸው! የሕዝቤንም ነፍስ ብታጠምዱ በውኑ ነፍሳችሁን ታድናላችሁን?

verses.en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
verses.fr: Vous me déshonorez auprès de mon peuple Pour des poignées d''orge et des morceaux de pain, En tuant des âmes qui ne doivent pas mourir, Et en faisant vivre des âmes qui ne doivent pas vivre, Trompant ainsi mon peuple, qui écoute le mensonge.
verses.am: ውሸታችሁን ለሚሰሙት ሕዝቤ እየዋሻችሁ ሞት የማይገባቸውን ነፍሳት ትገድሉ ዘንድ በሕይወትም መኖር የማይገባቸውን ነፍሳት በሕይወት ታኖሩ ዘንድ ስለ ጭብጥ ገብስና ስለ ቍራሽ እንጀራ በሕዝቤ ዘንድ አርክሳችሁኛል።

verses.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''en veux à vos coussinets Par lesquels vous surprenez les âmes afin qu''elles s''envolent, Et je les arracherai de vos bras; Et je délivrerai les âmes Que vous cherchez à surprendre afin qu''elles s''envolent.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እኔ ነፍሳትን እንደ ወፍ በምታጠምዱባት በመከዳችሁ ላይ ነኝ፥ ከክንዳችሁም ወስጄ እቀድዳታለሁ፥ እንደ ወፍም የምታጠምዱአቸውን ነፍሳት እለቅቃለሁ።

verses.en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: J''arracherai aussi vos voiles, Et je délivrerai de vos mains mon peuple; Ils ne serviront plus de piège entre vos mains. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሽፋኖቻችሁን ደግሞ እቀድዳለሁ ሕዝቤንም ከእጃችሁ አድናለሁ፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ በእጃችሁ ለመታደን አይሆኑም፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
verses.fr: Parce que vous affligez le coeur du juste par des mensonges, Quand moi-même je ne l''ai point attristé, Et parce que vous fortifiez les mains du méchant Pour l''empêcher de quitter sa mauvaise voie et pour le faire vivre,
verses.am: እኔም ያላሳዘንሁትን የጻድቁን ልብ በውሸት አሳዝናችኋልና፥ በሕይወትም ይኖር ዘንድ ከክፉ መንገድ እንዳይመለስ የኃጢአተኛውን እጅ አበርትታችኋልና

verses.en: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous n''aurez plus de vaines visions, Et vous ne prononcerez plus d''oracles; Je délivrerai de vos mains mon peuple. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከንቱን ራእይ እንግዲህ አታዩም ምዋርትንም አታምዋርቱም፥ ሕዝቤንም ከእጃችሁ አድናለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns des anciens d''Israël vinrent auprès de moi et s''assirent devant moi.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች አያሌ ሰዎች ወደ እኔ መጥተው በፊቴ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, ces gens-là portent leurs idoles dans leur coeur, et ils attachent les regards sur ce qui les a fait tomber dans l''iniquité. Me laisserai-je consulter par eux?
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ሰዎች ጣዖቶቻቸውን በልባቸው አኑረዋል የበደላቸውንም መቅሠፍት በፊታቸው አቁመዋል፤ እኔስ ከእነርሱ ልጠየቅን?

verses.en: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the Lord will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi parle-leur, et dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Tout homme de la maison d''Israël qui porte ses idoles dans son coeur, et qui attache les regards sur ce qui l''a fait tomber dans son iniquité, -s''il vient s''adresser au prophète, -moi, l''Eternel, je lui répondrai, malgré la multitude de ses idoles,
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሁሉም በጣዖቶቻቸው ከእኔ ተለይተዋልና የእስራኤልን ቤት በልባቸው እይዝ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጣዖቶቹን በልቡ የሚያኖር፥ የበደሉንም መቅሠፍት በፊቱ የሚያቆም ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ነቢዩ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጣዖታቱ ብዛት እመልስለታለሁ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.fr: afin de saisir dans leur propre coeur ceux de la maison d''Israël qui se sont éloignés de moi avec toutes leurs idoles.
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሁሉም በጣዖቶቻቸው ከእኔ ተለይተዋልና የእስራኤልን ቤት በልባቸው እይዝ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጣዖቶቹን በልቡ የሚያኖር፥ የበደሉንም መቅሠፍት በፊቱ የሚያቆም ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ነቢዩ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጣዖታቱ ብዛት እመልስለታለሁ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi dis à la maison d''Israël: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Revenez, et détournez-vous de vos idoles, détournez les regards de toutes vos abominations!
verses.am: ስለዚህ ለእስራኤል ቤት እንዲህ በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ንስሐ ግቡ ከጣዖቶቻችሁም ተመለሱ፥ ፊታችሁንም ከርኵሰታችሁ ሁሉ መልሱ።

verses.en: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the Lord will answer him by myself:
verses.fr: Car tout homme de la maison d''Israël, ou des étrangers séjournant en Israël, qui s''est éloigné de moi, qui porte ses idoles dans son coeur, et qui attache les regards sur ce qui l''a fait tomber dans son iniquité, -s''il vient s''adresser au prophète pour me consulter par lui, -moi, l''Eternel, je lui répondrai par moi.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ቤት፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ከሚቀመጡ መጻተኞች የሚሆን፥ ከእኔ ተለይቶ ጣዖቶቹን በልቡ የሚያኖር፥ የበደሉንም መቅሠፍት በፊቱ የሚያቆም ሰው ሁሉ፥ ስለ እኔ ይጠይቅ ዘንድ ወደ ነቢዩ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በራሴ እመልስለታለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Je tournerai ma face contre cet homme, je ferai de lui un signe et un sujet de sarcasme, et je l''exterminerai du milieu de mon peuple. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፊቴንም በዚያ ሰው ላይ አደርጋለሁ ምልክትና ምሳሌም አደርገዋለሁ ከሕዝቤም መካከል አጠፋዋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the Lord have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
verses.fr: Si le prophète se laisse séduire, s''il prononce une parole, c''est moi, l''Eternel, qui aurai séduit ce prophète; j''étendrai ma main contre lui, et je le détruirai du milieu de mon peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ቢታለል ቃልንም ቢናገር፥ ያንን ነቢይ ያታለልሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ እጄንም በእርሱ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ ከሕዝቤም ከእስራኤል መካከል አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;
verses.fr: Ils porteront ainsi la peine de leur iniquité; la peine du prophète sera comme la peine de celui qui consulte,
verses.am: ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ እንደሚጠይቀውም ሰው ኃጢአት እንዲሁ የነቢዩ ኃጢአት ይሆናል።

verses.en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: afin que la maison d''Israël ne s''égare plus loin de moi, et qu''elle ne se souille plus par toutes ses transgressions. Alors ils seront mon peuple, et je serai leur Dieu, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ይኸውም የእስራኤል ቤት ደግሞ ከእኔ ርቀው እንዳይስቱ በኃጢአታቸውም ሁሉ እንዳይረክሱ ነው። እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, lorsqu''un pays pécherait contre moi en se livrant à l''infidélité, et que j''étendrais ma main sur lui, -si je brisais pour lui le bâton du pain, si je lui envoyais la famine, si j''en exterminais les hommes et les bêtes,
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ምድር በማመፅ በእኔ ላይ ኃጢአት ስትሠራ፥ እኔም እጄን ስዘረጋባት የእንጀራዋንም በትር ስሰብር ራብን ስሰድድባት ሰውንና እንስሳውንም ከእርስዋ ሳጠፋ፥

verses.en: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: et qu''il y eût au milieu de lui ces trois hommes, Noé, Daniel et Job, ils sauveraient leur âme par leur justice, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሦስት ሰዎች፥ ኖኅና ዳንኤል ኢዮብም፥ ቢኖሩባት በጽድቃቸው የገዛ ነፍሳቸውን ብቻ ያድናሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
verses.fr: Si je faisais parcourir le pays par des bêtes féroces qui le dépeupleraient, s''il devenait un désert où personne ne passerait à cause de ces bêtes,
verses.am: ክፉዎቹን አራዊት በምድር ባሳልፍ እነርሱም ልጆችዋን ቢያጠፉ ስለ አራዊትም ማንም እንዳያልፍባት ባድማ ብትሆን፥

verses.en: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
verses.fr: et qu''il y eût au milieu de lui ces trois hommes, je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, ils ne sauveraient ni fils ni filles, eux seuls seraient sauvés, et le pays deviendrait un désert.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሦስት ሰዎች ቢኖሩባት፥ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እነርሱ ብቻቸውን ይድናሉ እንጂ ወንዶችንና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን አያድኑም፥ ምድሪቱም ባድማ ትሆናለች፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
verses.fr: Ou si j''amenais l''épée contre ce pays, si je disais: Que l''épée parcoure le pays! si j''en exterminais les hommes et les bêtes,
verses.am: ወይም በዚያች ምድር ላይ ሰይፍ አምጥቼ። ሰይፍ ሆይ፥ በምድሪቱ ላይ እለፊ ብል፥ ሰውንና እንስሳውንም ከእርስዋ ባጠፋ፥

verses.en: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
verses.fr: et qu''il y eût au milieu de lui ces trois hommes, je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, ils ne sauveraient ni fils ni filles, mais eux seuls seraient sauvés.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሦስት ሰዎች ቢኖሩባት፥ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እነርሱ ብቻቸውን ይድናሉ እንጂ ወንዶችንና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን አያድኑም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
verses.fr: Ou si j''envoyais la peste dans ce pays, si je répandais contre lui ma fureur par la mortalité, pour en exterminer les hommes et les bêtes,
verses.am: ወይም በዚያች ምድር ላይ ቸነፈር ብሰድድ ሰውንና እንስሳውንም ከእርስዋ አጠፋ ዘንድ መዓቴን በደም ባፈስስባት፥

verses.en: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.fr: et qu''il y eût au milieu de lui Noé, Daniel et Job, je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, ils ne sauveraient ni fils ni filles, mais ils sauveraient leur âme par leur justice.
verses.am: ኖኅና ዳንኤል ኢዮብም ቢኖሩባት፥ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በጽድቃቸው ነፍሳቸውን ብቻ ያድናሉ እንጂ ወንዶችንና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን አያድኑም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
verses.fr: Oui, ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Quoique j''envoie contre Jérusalem mes quatre châtiments terribles, l''épée, la famine, les bêtes féroces et la peste, pour en exterminer les hommes et les bêtes,
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ይልቁንስ ሰውንና እንስሳን ከእርስዋ አጠፋ ዘንድ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አራቱን ክፉ ፍርዶቼን፥ ሰይፍንና ራብን ክፉዎችንም አውሬዎች ቸነፈርንም፥ ስሰድድባት!

verses.en: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
verses.fr: il y aura néanmoins un reste qui échappera, qui en sortira, des fils et des filles. Voici, ils arriveront auprès de vous; vous verrez leur conduite et leurs actions, et vous vous consolerez du malheur que je fais venir sur Jérusalem, de tout ce que je fais venir sur elle.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ እነሆ፥ የሚያመልጡና ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችን የሚያመጡ ይቀሩላታል፤ እነሆ፥ ወደ እናንተ ይወጣሉ እናንተም መንገዳቸውንና ሥራቸውን ታያላችሁ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ ስላመጣሁት ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ስላመጣሁባትም ነገር ሁሉ ትጽናናላችሁ።

verses.en: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Ils vous consoleront, quand vous verrez leur conduite et leurs actions; et vous reconnaîtrez que ce n''est pas sans raison que je fais tout ce que je lui fais, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: መንገዳቸውንና ሥራቸውን ባያችሁ ጊዜ ያጽናኑአችኋል፤ ያደረግሁባትንም ሁሉ በከንቱ እንዳላደረግሁባት ታውቃላችሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, le bois de la vigne, qu''a-t-il de plus que tout autre bois, Le sarment qui est parmi les arbres de la forêt?
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የወይን ግንድ፥ በዱር ዛፎች መካከል ያለ የወይን አረግ፥ ከዛፍ ሁሉ ይልቅ ብልጫው ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.fr: Prend-on de ce bois pour fabriquer un ouvrage? En tire-t-on une cheville pour y suspendre un objet quelconque?
verses.am: በውኑ ሥራ የሚሠራበትን እንጨት ከእርሱ ይወስዳሉን? ወይስ ሰዎች ዕቃ የሚንጠለጠልበትን ኵላብ ከእርሱ ይወስዳሉን?

verses.en: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
verses.fr: Voici, on le met au feu pour le consumer; Le feu en consume les deux bouts, et le milieu brûle: Sera-t-il bon à quelque chose?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለመቃጠል በእሳት ላይ ተጥሎአል፥ እሳቱም ሁለቱን ጫፎቹን በልቶአል፥ መካከሉም ተቃጥሎአል፤ በውኑ ለሥራ ይጠቅማልን?

verses.en: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
verses.fr: Voici, lorsqu''il était entier, on n''en faisait aucun ouvrage; Combien moins, lorsque le feu l''a consumé et qu''il est brûlé, En pourra-t-on faire quelque ouvrage?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ደህና ሳለ ለሥራ ካልጠቀመ፥ ይልቁንስ እሳት ከበላው እርሱም ከተቃጠለ በኋላ እንዴት ሥራ ይሠራበታል?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Comme le bois de la vigne parmi les arbres de la forêt, Ce bois que je livre au feu pour le consumer, Ainsi je livrerai les habitants de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዱር ዛፎች መካከል ያለውን የወይን ግንድ እሳት ይበላው ዘንድ እንደ ሰጠሁት፥ እንዲሁ በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I set my face against them.
verses.fr: Je tournerai ma face contre eux; Ils sont sortis du feu, et le feu les consumera. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel, Quand je tournerai ma face contre eux.
verses.am: ፊቴንም በእነርሱ ላይ አደርጋለሁ፤ ከእሳትም ይወጣሉ፥ እሳት ግን ይበላቸዋል፤ ፊቴንም በእነርሱ ላይ ባደረግሁ ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Je ferai du pays un désert, Parce qu''ils ont été infidèles, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዓመፅን አድርገዋልና ምድሪቱን ባድማ አደርጋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, fais connaître à Jérusalem ses abominations!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለኢየሩሳሌም ርኵሰትዋን አስታውቃት፥

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord God unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel, à Jérusalem: Par ton origine et ta naissance tu es du pays de Canaan; ton père était un Amoréen, et ta mère une Héthienne.
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለኢየሩሳሌም እንዲህ ይላል። ዘርሽና ትውልድሽ ከከነዓን ምድር ነው፤ አባትሽ አሞራዊ ነበረ እናትሽም ኬጢያዊት ነበረች።

verses.en: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.fr: A ta naissance, au jour où tu naquis, ton nombril n''a pas été coupé, tu n''as pas été lavée dans l''eau pour être purifiée, tu n''as pas été frottée avec du sel, tu n''as pas été enveloppée dans des langes.
verses.am: በተወለድሽ ጊዜ በዚያው ቀን እትብትሽ አልተቈረጠም ንጹሕም ትሆኚ ዘንድ በውኃ አልታጠብሽም፥ በጨውም አልተቀባሽም በጨርቅም አልተጠቀለልሽም።

verses.en: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.fr: Nul n''a porté sur toi un regard de pitié pour te faire une seule de ces choses, par compassion pour toi; mais tu as été jetée dans les champs, le jour de ta naissance, parce qu''on avait horreur de toi.
verses.am: በተወለድሽበት ቀን ከሰውነትሽ ጕስቍልና የተነሣ በሜዳ ላይ ተጣልሽ እንጂ ከዚህ አንዳች ይደረግልሽ ዘንድ ዓይን አልራራልሽም፥ ማንም አላዘነልሽም።

verses.en: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
verses.fr: Je passai près de toi, je t''aperçus baignée dans ton sang, et je te dis: Vis dans ton sang! je te dis: Vis dans ton sang!
verses.am: በአንቺም ዘንድ ባለፍሁ ጊዜ በደምሽም ውስጥ ተለውሰሽ ባየሁሽ ጊዜ። በደምሽ እንዳለሽ በሕይወት ኑሪ አልሁሽ፤ አዎን። በደምሽ እንዳለሽ በሕይወት ኑሪ አልሁሽ።

verses.en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.
verses.fr: Je t''ai multipliée par dix milliers, comme les herbes des champs. Et tu pris de l''accroissement, tu grandis, tu devins d''une beauté parfaite; tes seins se formèrent, ta chevelure se développa. Mais tu étais nue, entièrement nue.
verses.am: በእርሻ ላይ እንዳለ ቡቃያ አበዛሁሽ፥ አንቺም አደግሽ ታላቅም ሆንሽ፥ በእጅጉም አጌጥሽ፤ ጡቶችሽም አጐጠጐጡ ጠጕርሽም አደገ፥ ነገር ግን ዕርቃንሽን ሆንሽ፥ ተራቍተሽም ነበርሽ።

verses.en: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord God, and thou becamest mine.
verses.fr: Je passai près de toi, je te regardai, et voici, ton temps était là, le temps des amours. J''étendis sur toi le pan de ma robe, je couvris ta nudité, je te jurai fidélité, je fis alliance avec toi, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, et tu fus à moi.
verses.am: በአንቺ ዘንድ ባለፍሁና ባየሁሽ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ጊዜሽ የፍቅር ጊዜ ነበረ፤ እኔም መጐናጸፊያዬን በላይሽ ዘረጋሁ ኀፍረተ ሥጋሽንም ከደንሁ፤ ማልሁልሽም ከአንቺም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ገባሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ አንቺም ለእኔ ሆንሽ።

verses.en: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.fr: Je te lavai dans l''eau, je fis disparaître le sang qui était sur toi, et je t''oignis avec de l''huile.
verses.am: በውኃም አጠብሁሽ ከደምሽም አጠራሁሽ በዘይትም ቀባሁሽ።

verses.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
verses.fr: Je te donnai des vêtements brodés, et une chaussure de peaux teintes en bleu; je te ceignis de fin lin, et je te couvris de soie.
verses.am: ወርቀ ዘቦም አለበስሁሽ በአቆስጣ ቁርበትም ጫማ አደረግሁልሽ፤ በጥሩ በፍታ አስታጠቅሁሽ በሐርም ከደንሁሽ።

verses.en: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.fr: Je te parai d''ornements: je mis des bracelets à tes mains, un collier à ton cou,
verses.am: በጌጥም አስጌጥሁሽ በእጅሽም ላይ አንባር በአንገትሽም ላይ ድሪ አደረግሁልሽ።

verses.en: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
verses.fr: je mis un anneau à ton nez, des pendants à tes oreilles, et une couronne magnifique sur ta tête.
verses.am: በአፍንጫሽም ቀለበት በጆሮሽም ጕትቻ በራስሽም ላይ የክብር አክሊል አደረግሁ።

verses.en: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
verses.fr: Ainsi tu fus parée d''or et d''argent, et tu fus vêtue de fin lin, de soie et d''étoffes brodées. La fleur de farine, le miel et l''huile, furent ta nourriture. Tu étais d''une beauté accomplie, digne de la royauté.
verses.am: በወርቅና በብር አጌጥሽ፥ ልብስሽም ጥሩ በፍታና ሐር ወርቀ ዘቦም ነበረ፤ አንቺም መልካምን ዱቄትና ማርን ዘይትንም በላሽ፤ እጅግ በጣም ውብ ሆንሽ ለመንግሥትም ደረስሽ።

verses.en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Et ta renommée se répandit parmi les nations, à cause de ta beauté; car elle était parfaite, grâce à l''éclat dont je t''avais ornée, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ባንቺ ላይ ካኖርኋት ከክብሬ የተነሣ ውበትሽ ፍጹም ነበረና ዝናሽ በአሕዛብ መካከል ወጣ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.fr: Mais tu t''es confiée dans ta beauté, et tu t''es prostituée, à la faveur de ton nom; tu as prodigué tes prostitutions à tous les passants, tu t''es livrée à eux.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በውበትሽ ታምነሻል ስለ ዝናሽም አመንዝረሻል ምንዝርናሽንም ከመንገድ አላፊ ሁሉ ጋር አበዛሽ።

verses.en: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
verses.fr: Tu as pris de tes vêtements, tu t''es fait des hauts lieux que tu as garnis d''étoffes de toutes couleurs, et tu t''y es prostituée: rien de semblable n''était arrivé et n''arrivera jamais.
verses.am: ከልብስሽም ወስደሽ በኮረብቶች ላይ በዝንጕርጕር ልብስ ያስጌጥሻቸውን መስገጆች ለራስሽ ሠራሽ በዚያም ገለሞትሽ፤ እንዲህም ያለ ነገር ከአሁን በፊት አልነበረም፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ አይሆንም።

verses.en: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
verses.fr: Tu as pris ta magnifique parure d''or et d''argent, que je t''avais donnée, et tu en as fait des simulacres d''hommes, auxquels tu t''es prostituée.
verses.am: ከሰጠሁሽም ከወርቄና ከብሬ የተሠራውን የክብርሽን ዕቃ ወስደሽ የወንድ ምስሎች ለራስሽ አድርገሻል አመንዝረሽባቸውማል።

verses.en: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.fr: Tu as pris tes vêtements brodés, tu les en as couverts, et tu as offert à ces simulacres mon huile et mon encens.
verses.am: ወርቀዘቦውን ልብስሽንም ወስደሽ ደረብሽላቸው፥ ዘይቴንና ዕጣኔንም በፊታቸው አኖርሽ።

verses.en: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Le pain que je t''avais donné, la fleur de farine, l''huile et le miel, dont je te nourrissais, tu leur as offert ces choses comme des parfums d''une odeur agréable. Voilà ce qui est arrivé, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሰጠሁሽንም እንጀራዬን ያበላሁሽንም መልካሙን ዱቄትና ዘይቱን ማሩንም ጣፋጭ ሽታ አድርገሽ በፊታቸው አኖርሽ፥ እንዲሁም ሆኖአል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
verses.fr: Tu as pris tes fils et tes filles, que tu m''avais enfantés, et tu les leur as sacrifiés pour qu''ils leur servent d''aliment: n''était-ce pas assez de tes prostitutions?
verses.am: ለእኔም የወለድሻቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችሽን ወስደሽ መብል ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሠዋሽላቸው።

verses.en: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
verses.fr: Tu as égorgé mes fils, et tu les as donnés, en les faisant passer par le feu en leur honneur.
verses.am: ልጆቼን አረድሽ፤ ለእነርሱም በእሳት በኩል አሳልፈሽ ሰጠሽ፤ በውኑ ግልሙትናሽ ጥቂት ነውን?

verses.en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
verses.fr: Au milieu de toutes tes abominations et de tes prostitutions, tu ne t''es pas souvenue du temps de ta jeunesse, lorsque tu étais nue, entièrement nue, et baignée dans ton sang.
verses.am: በርኵስነትሽና በግልሙትናሽ ሁሉ ዕርቃንሽን ሆነሽ ተራቍተሽም ሳለሽ በደምሽም ተለውሰሽ ሳለሽ የሕፃንነትሽን ወራት አላሰብሽም።

verses.en: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord God;)
verses.fr: Après toutes tes méchantes actions, -malheur, malheur à toi! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, -
verses.am: ወዮ! ወዮልሽ! ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
verses.fr: tu t''es bâti des maisons de prostitution, tu t''es fait des hauts lieux dans toutes les places;
verses.am: ከክፋትሽም ሁሉ በኋላ የምንዝርናን ስፍራ፥ በየአደባባዩም ከፍ ያለ ቦታን ለራስሽ ሠራሽ።

verses.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
verses.fr: l''entrée de chaque chemin tu as construit tes hauts lieux, tu as déshonoré ta beauté, tu t''es livrée à tous les passants, tu as multiplié tes prostitutions.
verses.am: በየመንገዱ ራስ ከፍ ያለውን ቦታሽን ሠራሽ፥ ውበትሽንም አረከስሽ፥ ለመንገድ አላፊም ሁሉ እግርሽን ገለጥሽ ግልሙትናሽንም አበዛሽ።

verses.en: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.fr: Tu t''es prostituée aux Egyptiens, tes voisins au corps vigoureux, et tu as multiplié tes prostitutions pour m''irriter.
verses.am: ሥጋቸውም ከወፈረ ከጐረቤቶችሽ ከግብጻውያን ጋር አመነዘርሽ፥ እኔንም ታስቈጭ ዘንድ ግልሙትናሽን አበዛሽ።

verses.en: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.fr: Et voici, j''ai étendu ma main contre toi, j''ai diminué la part que je t''avais assignée, je t''ai livrée à la volonté de tes ennemies, les filles des Philistins, qui ont rougi de ta conduite criminelle.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ እጄን በአንቺ ላይ ዘርግቻለሁ ድርጐሽንም አጕድያለሁ፤ ለሚጠሉሽም ከክፉ መንገድሽ የተነሣ ለሚያፍሩ ለፍልስጥኤም ሴቶች ልጆች ፈቃድ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼሻለሁ።

verses.en: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
verses.fr: Tu t''es prostituée aux Assyriens, parce que tu n''étais pas rassasiée; tu t''es prostituée à eux, et tu n''as pas encore été rassasiée.
verses.am: አልጠገብሽምና ከአሦራውያን ጋር ደግሞ ገለሞትሽ ከዚህም ጋር ገና አልጠገብሽም።

verses.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied therewith.
verses.fr: Tu as multiplié tes prostitutions avec le pays de Canaan et jusqu''en Chaldée, et avec cela tu n''as pas encore été rassasiée.
verses.am: እስከ ነጋዴዎች ምድር እስከ ከላውዴዎን ድረስ ግልሙትናሽን አበዛሽ። ከዚህም ጋር ገና አልጠገብሽም።

verses.en: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord God, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.fr: Quelle faiblesse de coeur tu as eue, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, en faisant toutes ces choses, qui sont l''oeuvre d''une maîtresse prostituée!
verses.am: የማታፍረውን የጋለሞታን ሥራ ሁሉ ሠርተሻልና ልብሽ ምንኛ ደካማ ነው? ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
verses.fr: Lorsque tu bâtissais tes maisons de prostitution à l''entrée de chaque chemin, lorsque tu faisais tes hauts lieux dans toutes les places, tu n''as pas même été comme la prostituée qui réclame un salaire;
verses.am: በየመንገዱ ራስ የምንዝርናሽን ስፍራ ሠርተሻል በየአደባባዩም ከፍ ያለውን ቦታሽን አድርገሻል። ዋጋዋን እንደምትንቅ እንደ ጋለሞታ አልሆንሽም።

verses.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.fr: tu as été la femme adultère, qui reçoit des étrangers au lieu de son mari.
verses.am: በባልዋ ፋንታ ሌሎችን ተቀብላ የምታመነዝር ሴትን ትመስያለሽ።

verses.en: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
verses.fr: A toutes les prostituées on paie un salaire; mais toi, tu as fait des dons à tous tes amants, tu les as gagnés par des présents, afin de les attirer à toi de toutes parts dans tes prostitutions.
verses.am: ለጋለሞቶች ሁሉ ዋጋ ይሰጡአቸዋል፤ አንቺ ግን ለውሽሞችሽ ሁሉ ዋጋ ትሰጫለሽ፥ ከአንቺም ጋር ለማመንዘር በዙሪያሽ ይገቡብሽ ዘንድ መማለጃ ትሰጫቸዋለሽ።

verses.en: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
verses.fr: Tu as été le contraire des autres prostituées, parce qu''on ne te recherchait pas; et en donnant un salaire au lieu d''en recevoir un, tu as été le contraire des autres.
verses.am: ግልሙትናሽ ከሌሎች ሴቶች ግልብጥ ነው፤ ማንም ለግልሙትና የሚከተልሽ የለም፤ ዋጋ ሳይሰጥሽ አንቺ ዋጋ በመስጠትሽ በዚህ ነገር ልዩ ሆነሻል።

verses.en: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, prostituée, écoute la parole de l''Eternel!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ጋለሞታ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሚ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que tes trésors ont été dissipés, et que ta nudité a été découverte dans tes prostitutions avec tes amants et avec toutes tes abominables idoles, et à cause du sang de tes enfants que tu leur as donnés,
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከውሽሞችሽ ጋር ባደረግሽው በግልሙትናሽ ርኵሰትሽ ስለ ፈሰሰ ኀፍረተ ሥጋሽም ስለ ተገለጠ፥ ስለ ርኵሰትሽም ጣዖታት ሁሉ ስለ ሰጠሻቸውም ስለ ልጆች ደም፥

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.fr: voici, je rassemblerai tous tes amants avec lesquels tu te plaisais, tous ceux que tu as aimés et tous ceux que tu as haïs, je les rassemblerai de toutes parts contre toi, je leur découvrirai ta nudité, et ils verront toute ta nudité.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር ደስ ያለሽን የወደድሻቸውንም ውሽሞችሽ ሁሉ ከጠላሻቸው ሁሉ ጋር እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ በአንቺ ላይ በዙሪያሽ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ ኀፍረተ ሥጋሽንም ሁሉ እንዲያዩ በፊታቸው ኀፍረተ ሥጋሽን እገልጣለሁ።

verses.en: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
verses.fr: Je te jugerai comme on juge les femmes adultères et celles qui répandent le sang, et je ferai de toi une victime sanglante de la fureur et de la jalousie.
verses.am: በአመንዝሮችና በደም አፍሳሾች ላይ የሚፈረደውን ፍርድ እፈርድብሻለሁ፥ የመዓትንና የቅንዓትን ደምም አመጣብሻለሁ።

verses.en: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
verses.fr: Je te livrerai entre leurs mains; ils abattront tes maisons de prostitution et détruiront tes hauts lieux; ils te dépouilleront de tes vêtements, prendront ta magnifique parure, et te laisseront nue, entièrement nue.
verses.am: በእጃቸውም አሳልፌ እሰጥሻለሁ፥ የምንዝርናሽንም ስፍራ ያፈርሳሉ ከፍ ያለውንም ቦታሽን ይገለብጣሉ፤ ልብስሽንም ይገፉሻል የክብርሽንም ጌጥ ይወስዳሉ፥ ዕርቃንሽን አድርገው ዕራቁትሽን ይተዉሻል።

verses.en: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.fr: Ils amèneront la foule contre toi, ils te lapideront et te perceront à coups d''épée;
verses.am: ጉባኤን ያመጡብሻል በድንጋይም ይወግሩሻል፥ በሰይፋቸውም ይወጉሻል።

verses.en: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
verses.fr: ils brûleront tes maisons par le feu, et ils feront justice de toi, aux yeux d''une multitude de femmes. Je ferai cesser ainsi ton impudicité et tu ne donneras plus de salaire.
verses.am: ቤቶችሽንም በእሳት ያቃጥላሉ በብዙም ሴቶች ፊት በላይሽ ፍርድን ያደርጉብሻል፤ ግልሙትናሽንም አስተውሻለሁ፥ እንግዲህስ ዋጋ አትሰጭም።

verses.en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.fr: J''assouvirai ma colère contre toi, et tu ne seras plus l''objet de ma jalousie; je m''apaiserai, je ne serai plus irrité.
verses.am: መዓቴንም በአንቺ ላይ እጨርሳለሁ ቅንዓቴም ከአንቺ ይርቃል፥ እኔም ዝም እላለሁ ደግሞም አልቈጣም።

verses.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord God: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
verses.fr: Parce que tu ne t''es pas souvenue du temps de ta jeunesse, parce que tu m''as provoqué par toutes ces choses, voici, je ferai retomber ta conduite sur ta tête, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, et tu ne commettras plus le crime avec toutes tes abominations.
verses.am: የሕፃንነትሽን ወራት አላሰብሽምና፥ በዚህም ነገር ሁሉ አስቈጥተሽኛልና ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ ደግሞ መንገድሽን በራስሽ ላይ አመጣለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ ሌላንም ነውር በርኵሰትሽ ሁሉ ላይ አትጨምሪም።

verses.en: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
verses.fr: Voici, tous ceux qui disent des proverbes, t''appliqueront ce proverbe: Telle mère, telle fille!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በምሳሌ የሚናገር ሁሉ። እንደ እናቲቱ እንዲሁ ሴት ልጂቱ ናት እያለ ምሳሌ ይመስልብሻል።

verses.en: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.fr: Tu es la fille de ta mère, qui a repoussé son mari et ses enfants; tu es la soeur de tes soeurs, qui ont repoussé leurs maris et leurs enfants. Votre mère était une Héthienne, et votre père un Amoréen.
verses.am: አንቺ ባልዋንና ልጆችዋን የጠላሽ የእናትሽ ልጅ ነሽ፤ አንቺም ባሎቻቸውንና ልጆቻቸውን የጠሉ የእኅቶችሽ እኅት ነሽ፤ እናታችሁ ኬጢያዊት ነበረች አባታችሁም አሞራዊ ነበረ።

verses.en: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.fr: Ta grande soeur, qui demeure à ta gauche, c''est Samarie avec ses filles; et ta petite soeur, qui demeure à ta droite, c''est Sodome avec ses filles.
verses.am: ታላቂቱም እኅትሽ ከሴቶች ልጆችዋ ጋር በስተ ግራሽ የምትቀመጥ ሰማርያ ናት፤ ታናሺቱም እኅትሽ ከሴቶች ልጆችዋ ጋር በስተ ቀኝሽ የምትቀመጥ ሰዶም ናት።

verses.en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
verses.fr: Tu n''as pas seulement marché dans leurs voies, commis les mêmes abominations, c''était trop peu; tu as été plus corrompue qu''elles dans toutes tes voies.
verses.am: አንቺ ግን በመንገዳቸው አልሄድሽም እንደ ርኵሰታቸውም አላደረግሽም ያው ለአንቺ ጥቂት ነበረና በመንገድሽ ሁሉ ከእነርሱ የሚከፋ ርኵሰት አደረግሽ።

verses.en: As I live, saith the Lord God, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.fr: Je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, Sodome, ta soeur, et ses filles n''ont pas fait ce que vous avez fait, toi et tes filles.
verses.am: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና አንቺና ሴቶች ልጆችሽ እንዳደረጋችሁት እንዲሁ ሰዶምና ሴቶች ልጆችዋ አላደረጉም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.fr: Voici quel a été le crime de Sodome, ta soeur. Elle avait de l''orgueil, elle vivait dans l''abondance et dans une insouciante sécurité, elle et ses filles, et elle ne soutenait pas la main du malheureux et de l''indigent.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእኅትሽ የሰዶም ኃጢአት ይህ ነበረ፤ ትዕቢት እንጀራን መጥገብ መዝለልና ሥራ መፍታት በእርስዋና በሴቶች ልጆችዋ ነበረ፥ የችግረኛውንና የድሀውንም እጅ አላጸናችም።

verses.en: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
verses.fr: Elles sont devenues hautaines, et elles ont commis des abominations devant moi. Je les ai fait disparaître, quand j''ai vu cela.
verses.am: ኰርተው ነበር በፊቴም ርኩስ ነገር አደረጉ፤ ስለዚህ ባየሁ ጊዜ አጠፋኋቸው።

verses.en: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.fr: Samarie n''a pas commis la moitié de tes péchés; tes abominations ont été plus nombreuses que les siennes, et tu as justifié tes soeurs par toutes les abominations que tu as faites.
verses.am: ሰማርያም የኃጢአትሽን እኵሌታ አልሠራችም፤ አንቺ ግን ከእኅቶችሽ ይልቅ ርኵሰትሽን አበዛሽ፥ በሥራሽም ርኵሰት ሁሉ አጸደቅሻቸው።

verses.en: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.fr: Toi qui condamnais tes soeurs, supporte ton opprobre, à cause de tes péchés par lesquels tu t''es rendue plus abominable qu''elles, et qui les font paraître plus justes que toi; sois confuse, et supporte ton opprobre, puisque tu as justifié tes soeurs.
verses.am: አሁንም ለእኅቶችሽ ስለ ፈረድሽ እፍረትሽን ተሸከሚ፤ ከእነርሱ የባሰ ኃጢአት ሠርተሻልና ከአንቺ ይልቅ ጻድቃን ናቸው፤ እኅቶችሽንም ስለ አጸደቅሻቸው እፈሪ እፍረትሽንም ተሸከሚ።

verses.en: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
verses.fr: Je ramènerai leurs captifs, les captifs de Sodome et de ses filles, les captifs de Samarie et de ses filles, et tes captifs au milieu des leurs,
verses.am: ምርኮአቸውን፥ የሰዶምና የሴቶች ልጆችዋን ምርኮ፥ የሰማርያንና የሴቶች ልጆችዋንም ምርኮ፥ በመካከላቸውም ያሉትን የምርኮኞችሽን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፤

verses.en: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.fr: afin que tu subisses ton opprobre, et que tu rougisses de tout ce que tu as fait, en étant pour elles un sujet de consolation.
verses.am: ስለ አጽናናሻቸው፥ እፍረትን ትሸከሚ ዘንድ ስለ አደረግሽውም ሁሉ ታፍሪ ዘንድ።

verses.en: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.fr: Tes soeurs, Sodome et ses filles, reviendront à leur premier état, Samarie et ses filles reviendront à leur premier état; et toi et tes filles, vous reviendrez à votre premier état.
verses.am: እኅቶችሽም ሰዶምና ሴቶች ልጆችዋ ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታቸው ይመለሳሉ፥ ሰማርያና ሴቶች ልጆችዋም ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታቸው ይመለሳሉ፥ አንቺና ሴቶች ልጆችሽም ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታችሁ ትመለሳላችሁ።

verses.en: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
verses.fr: Ne discourais-tu pas sur ta soeur Sodome, dans le temps de ton orgueil,
verses.am: ክፋትሽ ሳይገለጥ በትዕቢትሽ ቀን እኅትሽ ሰዶም በአፍሽ መተረቻ አልነበረችምን?

verses.en: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
verses.fr: avant que ta méchanceté soit mise à nu, lorsque tu as reçu les outrages des filles de la Syrie et de tous ses alentours, des filles des Philistins, qui te méprisaient de tous côtés!
verses.am: አሁን ለሶርያ ሴቶች ልጆችና ለጎረቤቶችዋ ሁሉ፥ በዙሪያሽም ለሚንቁሽ ለፍልስጥኤም ሴቶች ልጆች እንደ እርስዋ መሰደቢያ ሆነሻል።

verses.en: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu portes tes crimes et tes abominations, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ምንዝርነትሽንና ርኵስነትሽን ተሸክመሻል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: J''agirai envers toi comme tu as agi, toi qui as méprisé le serment en rompant l''alliance.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። አንቺ ቃል ኪዳንን በማፍረስ መሐላን የናቅሽ ሆይ፥ አንቺ እንዳደረግሽ እኔ ደግሞ አደርግብሻለሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.fr: Mais je me souviendrai de mon alliance avec toi au temps de ta jeunesse, et j''établirai avec toi une alliance éternelle.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሕፃንነትሽ ወራት ከአንቺ ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አስባለሁ የዘላለምንም ቃል ኪዳን አጸናልሻለሁ።

verses.en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.fr: Tu te souviendras de ta conduite, et tu en auras honte, quand tu recevras tes soeurs, les grandes et les petites; je te les donnerai pour filles, mais non en vertu de ton alliance.
verses.am: እኅቶችሽንም ታላቂቱንና ታናሺቱን በተቀበልሽ ጊዜ መንገድሽን ታስቢያለሽ ታፍሪማለሽ፤ ለአንቺም ልጆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ ስለ ቃል ኪዳንሽ ግን አይደለም።

verses.en: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord:
verses.fr: J''établirai mon alliance avec toi, et tu sauras que je suis l''Eternel,

verses.en: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Afin que tu te souviennes du passé et que tu rougisses, afin que tu n''ouvres plus la bouche et que tu sois confuse, quand je te pardonnerai tout ce que tu as fait, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፤ ስላደረግሽውም ሁሉ ይቅር ባልሁሽ ጊዜ፥ ታስቢ ዘንድ ታፍሪም ዘንድ ስለ እፍረትሽም ደግሞ አፍሽን እንዳትከፍቺ፥ ቃል ኪዳኔን ከአንቺ ጋር አጸናለሁ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, propose une énigme, dis une parabole à la maison d''Israël!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በእንቈቅልሽ አጫውት ለእስራኤልም ቤት ምሳሌ ንገር፥ እንዲህም በል።

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Un grand aigle, aux longues ailes, aux ailes déployées, couvert de plumes de toutes couleurs, vint sur le Liban, et enleva la cime d''un cèdre.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ታላቅ ክንፍ ረጅምም ማርገብገቢያ ያለው ላባም የተሞላ፥ መልከ ዝንጕርጕር ታላቅ ንስር ወደ ሊባኖስ መጣ፥ የዝግባንም ጫፍ ወሰደ።

verses.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.fr: Il arracha le plus élevé de ses rameaux, l''emporta dans un pays de commerce, et le déposa dans une ville de marchands.
verses.am: ቀንበጡንም ቀነጠበ ወደ ከነዓንም ምድር ወሰደው በነጋዶችም ከተማ አኖረው።

verses.en: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
verses.fr: Et il prit un rejeton du pays, et le plaça dans un sol fertile; il le mit près d''une eau abondante, et le planta comme un saule.
verses.am: ከምድርም ዘር ወሰደ በፍሬያማ እርሻ ተከለው በብዙም ውኃ አጠገብ እንደ አኻያ ዛፍ አኖረው።

verses.en: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
verses.fr: Ce rejeton poussa, et devint un cep de vigne étendu, mais de peu d''élévation; ses rameaux étaient tournés vers l''aigle, et ses racines étaient sous lui; il devint un cep de vigne, donna des jets, et produisit des branches.
verses.am: በበቀለም ጊዜ ቁመቱ ያጠረ አረጉም ወደ እርሱ የሚመለስ ሥሩም በበታቹ የነበረ ሰፊ ወይን ሆነ፥ እንዲሁ ወይን ሆነ አረግም ሰደደ ቀንበጥም አወጣ።

verses.en: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
verses.fr: Il y avait un autre aigle, grand, aux longues ailes, au plumage épais. Et voici, du parterre où elle était plantée, cette vigne étendit avec avidité ses racines de son côté et dirigea ses rameaux vers lui, afin qu''il l''arrosât.
verses.am: ታላቅ ክንፍና ብዙ ላባም ያለው ሌላ ታላቅ ንስር ነበረ፤ እነሆም፥ ያጠጣው ዘንድ ይህ ወይን ሥሩን ወደ እርሱ አዘነበለ አረጉንም ከተተከለበት ከመደቡ ወደ እርሱ ሰደደ።

verses.en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
verses.fr: Elle était plantée dans un bon terrain, près d''une eau abondante, de manière à produire des branches et à porter du fruit, à devenir une vigne magnifique.
verses.am: አረግም ያወጣ ፍሬም ያፈራ የከበረም ወይን ይሆን ዘንድ በመልካም መሬት ውስጥ በብዙም ውኃ አጠገብ ተተክሎ ነበር።

verses.en: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord God; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
verses.fr: Dis: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Prospérera-t-elle? Le premier aigle n''arrachera-t-il pas ses racines, n''enlèvera-t-il pas son fruit, afin qu''elle se dessèche, afin que toutes les feuilles qu''elle a poussées se dessèchent?
