Et il ne faudra ni beaucoup de force ni un peuple nombreux pour la séparer de ses racines.
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በውኑ ይከናወንለት ይሆንን? ይደርቅስ ዘንድ፥ አዲስ የበቀለውስ ቅጠሉ ይጠወልግ ዘንድ ሥሩን አይነቅለውምን? ፍሬውንስ አይለቅመውምን? ሥሩም የተነቀለው በብርቱ ክንድና በብዙ ሕዝብ አይደለም።

verses.en: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
verses.fr: Voici, elle est plantée: prospérera-t-elle? Si le vent d''orient la touche, ne séchera-t-elle pas? Elle séchera sur le parterre où elle a poussé.
verses.am: ተተክሎስ፥ እነሆ፥ ይከናወንለት ይሆንን? የምሥራቅ ነፋስ ባገኘው ጊዜ ፈጽሞ አይደርቅምን? በተተከለበት መደብ ላይ ይደርቃል።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
verses.fr: Dis à la maison rebelle: Ne savez-vous pas ce que cela signifie? Dis: Voici, le roi de Babylone est allé à Jérusalem, il en a pris le roi et les chefs, et les a emmenés avec lui à Babylone.
verses.am: ለዓመፀኛ ቤት። ይህ ትርጓሜ ምን እንደ ሆነ አታውቁምን? በላቸው። እንዲህም ብለህ ንገራቸው። እነሆ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፥ ንጉሥዋንና መኳንንቶችዋንም ማረከ፥ ወደ እርሱም ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዳቸው።

verses.en: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
verses.fr: Il a choisi un membre de la race royale, a traité alliance avec lui, et lui a fait prêter serment, et il a emmené les grands du pays,
verses.am: ከመንግሥትም ዘር ወስዶ ቃል ኪዳን ከእርሱ ጋር አደረገ፤ አማለውም፥ የምድሪቱንም ኃያላን ወሰደ፤

verses.en: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
verses.fr: afin que le royaume fût tenu dans l''abaissement, sans pouvoir s''élever, et qu''il gardât son alliance en y demeurant fidèle.
verses.am: ይኸውም ቃል ኪዳኑን በመጠበቅ እንድትጸና እንጂ መንግሥቱ እንድትዋረድና ከፍ እንዳትል ነው።

verses.en: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
verses.fr: Mais il s''est révolté contre lui, en envoyant ses messagers en Egypte, pour qu''elle lui donnât des chevaux et un grand nombre d''hommes. Celui qui a fait de telles choses réussira-t-il, échappera-t-il? Il a rompu l''alliance, et il échapperait!
verses.am: እርሱ ግን በእርሱ ላይ ሸፈተ ፈረሶችንና ብዙንም ሕዝብ ይሰጡት ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን ወደ ግብጽ ላከ። በውኑ ይከናወንለት ይሆንን? ይህንስ ያደረገ ያመልጣልን? ቃል ኪዳንንስ አፍርሶ ያመልጣልን?

verses.en: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.fr: Je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, c''est dans le pays du roi qui l''a fait régner, envers qui il a violé son serment et dont il a rompu l''alliance, c''est près de lui, au milieu de Babylone, qu''il mourra.
verses.am: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና ያነገሠውና መሐላውን የናቀበቱ፥ ቃል ኪዳኑንም ያፈረሰበቱ ንጉሥ በሚኖርበት ስፍራ ከእርሱ ጋር በባቢሎን መካከል በእርግጥ ይሞታል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
verses.fr: Pharaon n''ira pas avec une grande armée et un peuple nombreux le secourir pendant la guerre, lorsqu''on élèvera des terrasses et qu''on fera des retranchements pour exterminer une multitude d''âmes.
verses.am: ብዙዎችን ነፍሳት ለማስወገድ አፈርን በደለደሉ ምሽግም በሠሩ ጊዜ፥ ፈርዖን ከብዙ ሠራዊቱና ከታላቁ ጉባኤው ጋር በሰልፍ አይረዳውም።

verses.en: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
verses.fr: Il a méprisé le serment, il a rompu l''alliance; il avait donné sa main, et il a fait tout cela; il n''échappera pas!
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኑንም በማፍረስ መሐላውን ንቆአል፤ እነሆም፥ እጁን ሰጠ፥ ይህንም ሁሉ አድርጎአል፤ ስለዚህ አያመልጥም።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Je suis vivant! c''est le serment fait en mon nom qu''il a méprisé, c''est mon alliance qu''il a rompue. Je ferai retomber cela sur sa tête.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና የናቀውን መሐላዬን ያፈረሰውንም ቃል ኪዳኔን በራሱ ላይ አመጣለሁ።

verses.en: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
verses.fr: J''étendrai mon rets sur lui, et il sera pris dans mon filet; je l''emmènerai à Babylone, et là je plaiderai avec lui sur sa perfidie à mon égard.
verses.am: መረቤንም በእርሱ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ በወጥመድም ይያዛል፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም አመጣዋለሁ በእኔም ላይ ስላደረገው ዓመፅ በዚያ ከእርሱ ጋር እፋረዳለሁ።

verses.en: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the Lord have spoken it.
verses.fr: Tous les fuyards de toutes ses troupes tomberont par l''épée, et ceux qui resteront seront dispersés à tous les vents. Et vous saurez que moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé.
verses.am: ጭፍሮቹም ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፥ የቀሩትም ሁሉ ወደ እየነፋሳቱ ይበተናሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገርሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: J''enlèverai, moi, la cime d''un grand cèdre, et je la placerai; j''arracherai du sommet de ses branches un tendre rameau, et je le planterai sur une montagne haute et élevée.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከረጅሙ ዝግባ ጫፍ ላይ ቀንበጥን ወስጄ አኖረዋለሁ፤ ከጫፎቹ አንዱን ቀንበጥ እቀነጥበዋለሁ፤ በረጅምና በታላቅ ተራራም ላይ እተክለዋለሁ።

verses.en: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.fr: Je le planterai sur une haute montagne d''Israël; il produira des branches et portera du fruit, il deviendra un cèdre magnifique. Les oiseaux de toute espèce reposeront sous lui, tout ce qui a des ailes reposera sous l''ombre de ses rameaux.
verses.am: ከፍ ባለው በእስራኤል ተራራ ላይ እተክለዋለሁ፥ ቅርንጫፎችም ያወጣል ፍሬም ያፈራል የከበረም ዝግባ ይሆናል፤ በበታቹም ወፎች ሁሉ ያርፋሉ፥ በቅርንጫፎቹም ጥላ በክንፍ የሚበርር ሁሉ ይጠጋል።

verses.en: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the Lord have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the Lord have spoken and have done it.
verses.fr: Et tous les arbres des champs sauront que moi, l''Eternel, j''ai abaissé l''arbre qui s''élevait et élevé l''arbre qui était abaissé, que j''ai desséché l''arbre vert et fait verdir l''arbre sec. Moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé, et j''agirai.
verses.am: የዱር ዛፎች ሁሉ ረጅሙን ዛፍ ዝቅ ያደረግሁ፥ አጭሩንም ዛፍ ከፍ ያደረግሁ፥ የለመለመውንም ዛፍ ያደረቅሁ፥ የደረቀውንም ዛፍ ያለመለምሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ እኔም አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
verses.fr: Pourquoi dites-vous ce proverbe dans le pays d''Israël: Les pères ont mangé des raisins verts, et les dents des enfants en ont été agacées?
verses.am: ስለ እስራኤል ምድር። አባቶች ጨርቋ የወይን ፍሬ በሉ፥ የልጆችም ጥርሶች ጠረሱ ብላችሁ የምትመስሉት ምሳሌ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: As I live, saith the Lord God, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
verses.fr: Je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, vous n''aurez plus lieu de dire ce proverbe en Israël.
verses.am: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እንግዲህ ወዲህ ይህን ምሳሌ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አትመስሉትም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
verses.fr: Voici, toutes les âmes sont à moi; l''âme du fils comme l''âme du père, l''une et l''autre sont à moi; l''âme qui pèche, c''est celle qui mourra.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ነፍሳት ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸው፤ የአባት ነፍስ የእኔ እንደ ሆነች ደግሞ የልጅ ነፍስ የእኔ ናት፤ ኃጢአት የምትሠራ ነፍስ እርስዋ ትሞታለች።

verses.en: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
verses.fr: L''homme qui est juste, qui pratique la droiture et la justice,
verses.am: ሰውም ጻድቅ ቢሆን ፍርድንና ቅን ነገርን ቢያደርግ፥

verses.en: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
verses.fr: qui ne mange pas sur les montagnes et ne lève pas les yeux vers les idoles de la maison d''Israël, qui ne déshonore pas la femme de son prochain et ne s''approche pas d''une femme pendant son impureté,
verses.am: በተራራም ላይ ባይበላ ዓይኞቹንም ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ጣዖታት ባያነሣ የባልንጀራውንም ሚስት ባያረክስ አደፍም ወዳለባት ሴት ባይቀርብ፤

verses.en: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.fr: qui n''opprime personne, qui rend au débiteur son gage, qui ne commet point de rapines, qui donne son pain à celui qui a faim et couvre d''un vêtement celui qui est nu,
verses.am: ሰውንም ባያስጨንቅ ለባለ ዕዳም መያዣውን ቢመልስ ፈጽሞም ባይቀማ ከእንጀራውም ለተራበ ቢሰጥ የተራቈተውንም በልብስ ቢያለብስ፤

verses.en: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
verses.fr: qui ne prête pas à intérêt et ne tire point d''usure, qui détourne sa main de l''iniquité et juge selon la vérité entre un homme et un autre,
verses.am: በአራጣ ባያበድር፥ ትርፎቻም ባይወስድ፥ እጁንም ከኃጢአት ቢመልስ፥ በሰውና በሰው መካከልም የእውነትን ፍርድ ቢፈርድ፤

verses.en: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: qui suit mes lois et observe mes ordonnances en agissant avec fidélité, celui-là est juste, il vivra, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በትእዛዜም ቢሄድ፥ እውነትንም ለማድረግ ፍርዴን ቢጠብቅ፥ እርሱ ጻድቅ ነው፥ ፈጽሞ በሕይወት ይኖራል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
verses.fr: S''il a un fils qui soit violent, qui répande le sang, ou qui commette quelque chose de semblable;
verses.am: እርሱም ቀማኛና ደም አፍሳሽ ልጅ ከዚህም ሁሉ አንዳቸውን የሚያደርገውን ቢወልድ፥

verses.en: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,
verses.fr: si ce fils n''imite en rien la conduite de son père, s''il mange sur les montagnes, s''il déshonore la femme de son prochain,
verses.am: እርሱም ጻድቅ አባቱ የሠራውን ሁሉ ባይሠራ በተራራም ላይ ቢበላ የባልንጀራውንም ሚስት ቢያረክስ፥

verses.en: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
verses.fr: s''il opprime le malheureux et l''indigent, s''il commet des rapines, s''il ne rend pas le gage, s''il lève les yeux vers les idoles et fait des abominations,
verses.am: ድሀውንና ችግረኛውንም ቢያስጨንቅ ቢቀማም መያዣውንም ባይመልስ ዓይኖቹንም ወደ ጣዖታት ቢያነሣ ርኩስን ነገር ቢያደርግ፥

verses.en: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.fr: S''il prête à intérêt et tire une usure, ce fils-là vivrait! Il ne vivra pas; il a commis toutes ces abominations; qu''il meure! que son sang retombe sur lui!
verses.am: በአራጣ ቢያበድር፥ ትርፎቻም ቢወስድ፥ በውኑ እርሱ በሕይወት ይኖራልን? በሕይወት አይኖርም፤ ይህን ርኵሰት ሁሉ አድርጎአልና ፈጽሞ ይሞታል፤ ደሙ በላዩ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
verses.fr: Mais si un homme a un fils qui voie tous les péchés que commet son père, qui les voie et n''agisse pas de la même manière;
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ልጅ ቢወልድ፥ እርሱም አባቱ የሠራውን ኃጢአት አይቶ ቢፈራ እንዲህም ባይሠራ፥

verses.en: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,
verses.fr: si ce fils ne mange pas sur les montagnes et ne lève pas les yeux vers les idoles de la maison d''Israël, s''il ne déshonore pas la femme de son prochain,
verses.am: በተራራ ላይ ባይበላ ዓይኖቹንም ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ጣዖታት ባያነሣ የባልንጀራውንም ሚስት ባያረክስ፥

verses.en: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
verses.fr: s''il n''opprime personne, s''il ne prend point de gage, s''il ne commet point de rapines, s''il donne son pain à celui qui a faim et couvre d''un vêtement celui qui est nu,
verses.am: ሰውንም ባያስጨንቅ መያዣውን ባይወስድ ባይቀማም ከእንጀራውም ለተራበ ቢሰጥ ለተራቈተውም ልብስን ቢያለብስ፥

verses.en: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
verses.fr: s''il détourne sa main de l''iniquité, s''il n''exige ni intérêt ni usure, s''il observe mes ordonnances et suit mes lois, celui-là ne mourra pas pour l''iniquité de son père; il vivra.
verses.am: እጁንም ድሀን ከመበደል ቢመልስ አራጣን ትርፎቻንም ባይወስድ ፍርዴንም ቢያደርግ በትእዛዜም ቢሄድ፥ እርሱ ፈጽሞ በሕይወት ይኖራል እንጂ በአባቱ ኃጢአት አይሞትም።

verses.en: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
verses.fr: C''est son père, qui a été un oppresseur, qui a commis des rapines envers les autres, qui a fait au milieu de son peuple ce qui n''est pas bien, c''est lui qui mourra pour son iniquité.
verses.am: አባቱ ግን ፈጽሞ በድሎአልና፥ ወንድሙንም ቀምቶአልና፥ በሕዝቡም መካከል ክፉን ነገር አድርጎአልና እነሆ፥ እርሱ በበደሉ ይሞታል።

verses.en: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
verses.fr: Vous dites: Pourquoi le fils ne porte-t-il pas l''iniquité de son père? C''est que le fils a agi selon la droiture et la justice, c''est qu''il a observé et mis en pratique toutes mes lois; il vivra.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን። ልጅ የአባቱን ኃጢአት ስለ ምን አይሸከምም? ትላላችሁ። ልጅ ፍርድንና ቅን ነገርን ባደረገ ትእዛዜንም ሁሉ በጠበቀና ባደረገ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ በሕይወት ይኖራል።

verses.en: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
verses.fr: L''âme qui pèche, c''est celle qui mourra. Le fils ne portera pas l''iniquité de son père, et le père ne portera pas l''iniquité de son fils. La justice du juste sera sur lui, et la méchanceté du méchant sera sur lui.
verses.am: ኃጢአትን የምትሠራ ነፍስ እርስዋ ትሞታለች፤ ልጅ የአባቱን ኃጢአት አይሸከምም፥ አባትም የልጁን ኃጢአት አይሸከምም፤ የጻድቁ ጽድቅ በራሱ ላይ ይሆናል፥ የኃጢአተኛውም ኃጢአት በራሱ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.fr: Si le méchant revient de tous les péchés qu''il a commis, s''il observe toutes mes lois et pratique la droiture et la justice, il vivra, il ne mourra pas.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛውም ካደረጋት ኃጢአት ሁሉ ቢመለስ ትእዛዜንም ሁሉ ቢጠብቅ ፍርድንና ቅን ነገርንም ቢያደርግ ፈጽሞ በሕይወት ይኖራል እንጂ አይሞትም።

verses.en: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
verses.fr: Toutes les transgressions qu''il a commises seront oubliées; il vivra, à cause de la justice qu''il a pratiquée.
verses.am: የበደለው በደል ሁሉ አይታሰብበትም፤ በሠራው ጽድቅ በሕይወት ይኖራል።

verses.en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord God: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
verses.fr: Ce que je désire, est-ce que le méchant meure? dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel. N''est-ce pas qu''il change de conduite et qu''il vive?
verses.am: በውኑ ኃጢአተኛ ይሞት ዘንድ እፈቅዳለሁን? ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ከመንገዱስ ይመለስና በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ አይደለምን?

verses.en: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
verses.fr: Si le juste se détourne de sa justice et commet l''iniquité, s''il imite toutes les abominations du méchant, vivra-t-il? Toute sa justice sera oubliée, parce qu''il s''est livré à l''iniquité et au péché; à cause de cela, il mourra.
verses.am: ጻድቁ ግን ከጽድቁ ቢመለስ ኃጢአትንም ቢሠራ ኃጢአተኛውም እንደሚያደርገው ርኵሰት ሁሉ ቢያደርግ፥ በሕይወት ይኖራልን? የሠራት ጽድቅ ሁሉ አትታሰብለትም፤ ባደረገው ዓመፅና በሠራት ኃጢአት በዚያች ይሞታል።

verses.en: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.fr: Vous dites: La voie du Seigneur n''est pas droite. Ecoutez donc, maison d''Israël! Est-ce ma voie qui n''est pas droite? Ne sont-ce pas plutôt vos voies qui ne sont pas droites?
verses.am: እናንተ ግን። የጌታ መንገድ የቀናች አይደለችም ትላላችሁ። የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ስሙ፤ በውኑ መንገዴ የቀናች አይደለችምን? ይልቅስ የእናንተ መንገድ ያልቀናች አይደለችምን?

verses.en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
verses.fr: Si le juste se détourne de sa justice et commet l''iniquité, et meurt pour cela, il meurt à cause de l''iniquité qu''il a commise.
verses.am: ጻድቁ ከጽድቁ ቢመለስ፥ ኃጢአትንም በሠራ ጊዜ፥ በዚያም ቢሞት፥ እርሱ ባደረገው በደል ይሞታል።

verses.en: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
verses.fr: Si le méchant revient de sa méchanceté et pratique la droiture et la justice, il fera vivre son âme.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛውም ከሠራው ኃጢአት ቢመለስ ፍርድንና ቅን ነገርንም ቢያደርግ ነፍሱን ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.fr: S''il ouvre les yeux et se détourne de toutes les transgressions qu''il a commises, il vivra, il ne mourra pas.
verses.am: አስቦ ከሠራው በደል ሁሉ ተመልሶአልና ፈጽሞ በሕይወት ይኖራል እንጂ አይሞትም።

verses.en: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.fr: La maison d''Israël dit: La voie du Seigneur n''est pas droite. Est-ce ma voie qui n''est pas droite, maison d''Israël? Ne sont-ce pas plutôt vos voies qui ne sont pas droites?
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል ቤት። የጌታ መንገድ የቀናች አይደለችም ይላል። የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በውኑ መንገዴ የቀናች አይደለችምን? ይልቅስ የእናንተ መንገድ ያልቀናች አይደለችምን?

verses.en: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord God. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous jugerai chacun selon ses voies, maison d''Israël, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel. Revenez et détournez-vous de toutes vos transgressions, afin que l''iniquité ne cause pas votre ruine.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ እንደ መንገዱ በየሰዉ ሁሉ እፈርድባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ንስሐ ግቡ ኃጢአትም ዕንቅፋት እንዳይሆንባችሁ ከኃጢአታችሁ ሁሉ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.fr: Rejetez loin de vous toutes les transgressions par lesquelles vous avez péché; faites-vous un coeur nouveau et un esprit nouveau. Pourquoi mourriez-vous, maison d''Israël?
verses.am: የበደላችሁትን በደል ሁሉ ከእናንተ ጣሉ አዲስ ልብና አዲስ መንፈስም ለእናንተ አድርጉ፤ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ስለ ምን ትሞታላችሁ?

verses.en: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord God: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
verses.fr: Car je ne désire pas la mort de celui qui meurt, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel. Convertissez-vous donc, et vivez.
verses.am: የምዋቹን ሞት አልፈቅድምና፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ስለዚህ ተመለሱና በሕይወት ኑሩ።

verses.en: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.fr: Et toi, prononce une complainte sur les princes d''Israël,
verses.am: አንተም በእስራኤል አለቆች ላይ ይህን ሙሾ አሙሽ፥ እንዲህም በል።

verses.en: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
verses.fr: et dis: Ta mère, qu''était-ce? Une lionne. Elle était couchée parmi les lions; C''est au milieu des lionceaux Qu''elle a élevé ses petits.
verses.am: እናትህ ምን ነበረች? አንበሳ ነበረች፤ በአንበሶች መካከል ተጋደመች፤ በደቦል አንበሶች መካከል ግልገሎችዋን አሳደገች።

verses.en: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
verses.fr: Elle éleva l''un de ses petits, Qui devint un jeune lion, Et qui apprit à déchirer sa proie; Il dévora des hommes.
verses.am: ከግልገሎችዋም አንዱን አወጣች እርሱም ደቦል አንበሳ ሆነ፤ ንጥቂያንም ተማረ፥ ሰዎችንም በላ።

verses.en: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Les nations entendirent parler de lui, Et il fut pris dans leur fosse; Elles mirent une boucle à ses narines et l''emmenèrent Dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: አሕዛብም ወሬውን ሰሙ እርሱም በጕድጓዳቸው ተያዘ፥ በሰንሰለትም አድርገው ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ወሰዱት።

verses.en: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
verses.fr: Quand la lionne vit qu''elle attendait en vain, Qu''elle était trompée dans son espérance, Elle prit un autre de ses petits, Et en fit un jeune lion.
verses.am: እርስዋም እንደ ደከመችና ተስፋዋ እንደ ጠፋ ባየች ጊዜ፥ ከግልገሎችዋ ሌላን ወስዳ ደቦል አንበሳ አደረገችው።

verses.en: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
verses.fr: Il marcha parmi les lions, Il devint un jeune lion, Et il apprit à déchirer sa proie; Il dévora des hommes.
verses.am: እርሱም በአንበሶች መካከል ተመላለሰ ደቦል አንበሳም ሆነ፤ ንጥቂያም ተማረ፥ ሰዎችንም በላ።

verses.en: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
verses.fr: Il força leurs palais, Et détruisit leurs villes; Le pays, tout ce qui s''y trouvait, fut ravagé, Au bruit de ses rugissements.
verses.am: ግንቦቻቸውንም አወቀ፥ ከተሞቻቸውንም አፈረሰ፤ ከግሣቱም ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድሪቱና ሞላዋ ጠፋች።

verses.en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
verses.fr: Contre lui se rangèrent les nations D''alentour, des provinces; Elles tendirent sur lui leur rets, Et il fut pris dans leur fosse.
verses.am: አሕዛብም በዙሪያው ከየአገሩ ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡበት፤ መረባቸውንም በእርሱ ላይ ዘረጉ በጕድጓዳቸውም ተያዘ።

verses.en: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.fr: Elles mirent une boucle à ses narines, le placèrent dans une cage, Et l''emmenèrent auprès du roi de Babylone; Puis elles le conduisirent dans une forteresse, Afin qu''on n''entende plus sa voix sur les montagnes d''Israël.
verses.am: በሰንሰለትም አድርገው በቀፎ ውስጥ አኖሩት ወደ ባቢሎንም ንጉሥ አመጡት፤ ድምፁም በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ ከዚያ ወዲያ እንዳይሰማ ወደ አምባ አገቡት።

verses.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.fr: Ta mère était, comme toi, semblable à une vigne, Plantée près des eaux. Elle était féconde et chargée de branches, A cause de l''abondance des eaux.
verses.am: እናትህ በመልክህ በውኃ አጠገብ እንደ ተተከለች እንደ ወይን ግንድ ነበረች፤ ከውኃም ብዛት የተነሣ የምታፈራና የምትሰፋ ሆነች።

verses.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
verses.fr: Elle avait de vigoureux rameaux pour des sceptres de souverains; Par son élévation elle dominait les branches touffues; Elle attirait les regards par sa hauteur, Et par la multitude de ses rameaux.
verses.am: ለእርስዋም ብርቱዎች በትሮች ነበሩአት እነርሱም ለነገሥታት በትሮች ነበሩ። ቁመታቸውም በዛፎች ቅርንጫፎች መካከል ረዘመ፥ በጫፎቻቸውም ብዛትና በርዝመታቸው ታዩ።

verses.en: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
verses.fr: Mais elle a été arrachée avec fureur et jetée par terre; Le vent d''orient a desséché son fruit; Ses rameaux vigoureux ont été rompus et desséchés; Le feu les a dévorés.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመዓት ተነቀለች ወደ መሬትም ተጣለች የምሥራቅም ነፋስ ፍሬዋን አደረቀ፤ ብርቱዎች በትሮችዋም ተሰበሩና ደረቁ፥ እሳትም በላቻቸው።

verses.en: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
verses.fr: Et maintenant elle est plantée dans le désert, Dans une terre sèche et aride.
verses.am: አሁንም በምድረ በዳ፥ በደረቅና በተጠማች መሬት ተተከለች።

verses.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
verses.fr: Le feu est sorti de ses branches, Et a dévoré son fruit; Elle n''a plus de rameau vigoureux Pour un sceptre de souverain. C''est là une complainte, et cela servira de complainte.
verses.am: ከጫፎችዋም በትሮች እሳት ወጣች ፍሬዋንም በላች፥ የነገሥታትም በትር ይሆን ዘንድ የበረታ በትር የለባትም። ይህ ሙሾ ነው፥ ለልቅሶም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the Lord, and sat before me.
verses.fr: La septième année, le dixième jour du cinquième mois, quelques-uns des anciens d''Israël vinrent pour consulter l''Eternel, et s''assirent devant moi.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሰባተኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን እግዚአብሔርን ይጠይቁ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች አያሌ ሰዎች መጡ፥ በፊቴም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Then came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, parle aux anciens d''Israël, et dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Est-ce pour me consulter que vous êtes venus? Je suis vivant! je ne me laisserai pas consulter par vous, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ተናገር፥ እንዲህም በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔን ትጠይቁ ዘንድ መጥታችኋልን? እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በእናንተ ዘንድ አልጠየቅም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
verses.fr: Veux-tu les juger, veux-tu les juger, fils de l''homme? Fais-leur connaître les abominations de leurs pères!
verses.am: ትፈርድባቸዋለህን? የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በውኑ ትፈርድባቸዋለህን? የአባቶቻቸውን ርኵሰት አስታውቃቸው።

verses.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the Lord your God;
verses.fr: Tu leur diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Le jour où j''ai choisi Israël, j''ai levé ma main vers la postérité de la maison de Jacob, et je me suis fait connaître à eux dans le pays d''Egypte; j''ai levé ma main vers eux, en disant: Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲህም በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤልን በመረጥሁበት ለያዕቆብም ቤት ዘር በማልሁበት ቀን በግብጽም ምድር በተገለጥሁላቸውና። እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ ብዬ በማልሁላቸው ጊዜ፥

verses.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, j''ai levé ma main vers eux, pour les faire passer du pays d''Egypte dans un pays que j''avais cherché pour eux, pays où coulent le lait et le miel, le plus beau de tous les pays.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ከግብጽ ምድር ወዳዘጋጀሁላቸው፥ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስሰው፥ የምድርም ሁሉ ጌጥ ወደምትሆን ምድር አወጣቸው ዘንድ ማልሁላቸው፤

verses.en: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Je leur dis: Rejetez chacun les abominations qui attirent vos regards, et ne vous souillez pas par les idoles de l''Egypte! Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: እኔም። ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ የዓይኑን ርኵሰት ይጣል፥ በግብጽም ጣዖታት አትርከሱ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Et ils se révoltèrent contre moi, et ils ne voulurent pas m''écouter. Aucun ne rejeta les abominations qui attiraient ses regards, et ils n''abandonnèrent point les idoles de l''Egypte. J''eus la pensée de répandre ma fureur sur eux, d''épuiser contre eux ma colère, au milieu du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ዐመፁብኝ ይሰሙኝም ዘንድ አልወደዱም፥ ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ የዓይኑን ርኵሰት አልጣለም የግብጽንም ጣዖታት አልተወም፤ በዚህም ጊዜ። በግብጽ ምድር መካከል ቍጣዬን እፈጽምባቸው ዘንድ መዓቴን አፈስስባቸዋለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Néanmoins j''ai agi par égard pour mon nom, afin qu''il ne soit pas profané aux yeux des nations parmi lesquelles ils se trouvaient, et aux yeux desquelles je m''étais fait connaître à eux, pour les faire sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመካከላቸው ባሉ ከግብጽም ምድር አወጣቸው ዘንድ በፊታቸው በተገለጥሁላቸው በአሕዛብ ፊት ስሜ እንዳይረክስ ብዬ ስለ ስሜ ሠራሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.fr: Et je les fis sortir du pays d''Egypte, et je les conduisis dans le désert.
verses.am: ከግብጽም ምድር አወጣኋቸው ወደ ምድረ በዳም አመጣኋቸው።

verses.en: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
verses.fr: Je leur donnai mes lois et leur fis connaître mes ordonnances, que l''homme doit mettre en pratique, afin de vivre par elles.
verses.am: ሰው ቢያደርገው ኖሮ በሕይወት የሚኖርበትን ሥርዓቴንም ሰጠኋቸው፥ ፍርዴንም አስታወቅኋቸው።

verses.en: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the Lord that sanctify them.
verses.fr: Je leur donnai aussi mes sabbats comme un signe entre moi et eux, pour qu''ils connussent que je suis l''Eternel qui les sanctifie.
verses.am: የምቀድሳቸውም እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ በእኔና በእነርሱ መካከል ምልክት ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሰንበታቴን ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.en: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.fr: Et la maison d''Israël se révolta contre moi dans le désert. Ils ne suivirent point mes lois, et ils rejetèrent mes ordonnances, que l''homme doit mettre en pratique, afin de vivre par elles, et ils profanèrent à l''excès mes sabbats. J''eus la pensée de répandre sur eux ma fureur dans le désert, pour les anéantir.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል ቤት በምድረ በዳ ዐመፁብኝ፤ ሰው ቢያደርገው ኖሮ በሕይወት የሚኖርበትንም ፍርዴን ጣሱ፥ በትእዛዜም አልሄዱም፥ ሰንበታቴንም ፈጽመው አረከሱ። በዚህም ጊዜ። አጠፋቸው ዘንድ ቍጣዬን በምድረ በዳ አፈስስባቸዋለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.fr: Néanmoins j''ai agi par égard pour mon nom, afin qu''il ne soit pas profané aux yeux des nations en présence desquelles je les avais fait sortir d''Egypte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በፊታቸው ባወጣኋቸው በአሕዛብ ፊት ስሜ እንዳይረክስ ብዬ ስለ ስሜ ሠራሁ።

verses.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
verses.fr: Dans le désert, je levai ma main vers eux, pour ne pas les conduire dans le pays que je leur avais destiné, pays où coulent le lait et le miel, le plus beau de tous les pays,
verses.am: ወተትና ማርም ወደምታፈስሰው የምድር ሁሉ ጌጥ ወደምትሆን ወደ ሰጠኋቸው ምድር አላመጣቸውም ብዬ በምድረ በዳ ማልሁባቸው።

verses.en: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.fr: et cela parce qu''ils rejetèrent mes ordonnances et ne suivirent point mes lois, et parce qu''ils profanèrent mes sabbats, car leur coeur ne s''éloigna pas de leurs idoles.
verses.am: ልባቸው ጣዖቶቻቸውን ተከትሎአልና፤ ፍርዴንም ጥሰዋልና፥ በሥርዓቴም አልሄዱምና፥ ሰንበታቴንም አርክሰዋልና።

verses.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Mais j''eus pour eux un regard de pitié et je ne les détruisis pas, je ne les exterminai pas dans le désert.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዓይኔ ራራችላቸው እኔም አላጠፋኋቸውም፥ በምድረ በዳም ፈጽሜ አልፈጀኋቸውም።

verses.en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
verses.fr: Je dis à leurs fils dans le désert: Ne suivez pas les préceptes de vos pères, n''observez pas leurs coutumes, et ne vous souillez pas par leurs idoles!
verses.am: ለልጆቻቸውም በምድረ በዳ እንዲህ አልኋቸው። በአባቶቻችሁ ሥርዓት አትሂዱ ወጋቸውንም አትጠብቁ በጣዖቶቻቸውም አትርከሱ።

verses.en: I am the Lord your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu. Suivez mes préceptes, observez mes ordonnances, et mettez-les en pratique.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ፤ በትእዛዜ ሂዱ ፍርዴንም ጠብቁ አድርጓትም።

verses.en: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Sanctifiez mes sabbats, et qu''ils soient entre moi et vous un signe auquel on connaisse que je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ሰንበታቴንም ቀድሱ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል ምልክት ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Et les fils se révoltèrent contre moi. Ils ne suivirent point mes préceptes, ils n''observèrent point et n''exécutèrent point mes ordonnances, que l''homme doit mettre en pratique, afin de vivre par elles, et ils profanèrent mes sabbats. J''eus la pensée de répandre sur eux ma fureur, d''épuiser contre eux ma colère dans le désert.
verses.am: ልጆች ግን ዐመፁብኝ፥ ሰው ቢያደርገው ኖሮ በሕይወት የሚኖርባትን ፍርዴን ጠብቀው አላደረጓትም በሥርዓቴም አልሄዱም፥ ሰንበታቴንም አረከሱ፤ በዚህም ጊዜ። መዓቴን አፈስስባቸዋለሁ ቍጣዬንም በምድረ በዳ እፈጽምባቸዋለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.fr: Néanmoins j''ai retiré ma main, et j''ai agi par égard pour mon nom, afin qu''il ne fût pas profané aux yeux des nations en présence desquelles je les avais fait sortir d''Egypte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እጄን መለስሁ፥ በፊታቸውም ባወጣኋቸው በአሕዛብ ፊት ስሜ እንዳይረክስ ብዬ ስለ ስሜ ሠራሁ።

verses.en: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.fr: Dans le désert, je levai encore ma main vers eux, pour les disperser parmi les nations et les répandre en divers pays,
verses.am: ደግሞም ወደ አሕዛብ እበትናቸው ዘንድ፥ በአገሮችም እበትናቸው ዘንድ በምድረ በዳ ማልሁባቸው፤ ፍርዴን አላደረጉምና፤

verses.en: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
verses.fr: parce qu''ils ne mirent pas en pratique mes ordonnances, parce qu''ils rejetèrent mes préceptes, profanèrent mes sabbats, et tournèrent leurs yeux vers les idoles de leurs pères.
verses.am: ሥርዓቴንም ጥሰዋልና፤ ሰንበታቴንም አርክሰዋልና፤ ዓይናቸውም የአባቶቻቸውን ጣዖታቶች ተከትለዋልና።

verses.en: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
verses.fr: Je leur donnai aussi des préceptes qui n''étaient pas bons, et des ordonnances par lesquelles ils ne pouvaient vivre.
verses.am: ደግሞም መልካም ያልሆነውን ሥርዓት በሕይወት የማይኖሩበትንም ፍርድ ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.en: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Je les souillai par leurs offrandes, quand ils faisaient passer par le feu tous leurs premiers-nés; je voulus ainsi les punir, et leur faire connaître que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ እንዲያውቁ አጠፋቸው ዘንድ፥ ማኅፀን የሚከፍተውን ሁሉ በእሳት ባሳለፉ ጊዜ፥ በመባቸው አረከስኋቸው።

verses.en: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi parle à la maison d''Israël, fils de l''homme, et dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Vos pères m''ont encore outragé, en se montrant infidèles à mon égard.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለእስራኤል ቤት ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህም ደግሞ አባቶቻችሁ ባደረጉት ዓመፅ አስቈጡኝ።

verses.en: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.fr: Je les ai conduits dans le pays que j''avais juré de leur donner, et ils ont jeté les yeux sur toute colline élevée et sur tout arbre touffu; là ils ont fait leurs sacrifices, ils ont présenté leurs offrandes qui m''irritaient, ils ont brûlé leurs parfums d''une agréable odeur, et ils ont répandu leurs libations.
verses.am: እሰጣቸውም ዘንድ ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ባገባኋቸው ጊዜ፥ ከፍ ያለውን ኮረብታ ሁሉ ቅጠልማውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ አዩ፥ በዚያም መሥዋዕታቸውን ሠዉ በዚያም የሚያስቈጣኝን ቍርባናቸውን አቀረቡ በዚያም ደግሞ ጣፋጩን ሽታቸውን አደረጉ በዚያም የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን አፈሰሱ።

verses.en: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name whereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.fr: Je leur dis: Qu''est-ce que ces hauts lieux où vous vous rendez? Et le nom de hauts lieux leur a été donné jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እኔም። እናንተ ወደ እርሱ የምትሄዱበት ከፍታ ምንድር ነው? አልኋቸው። እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ስሙ ባማ ተብሎ ተጠርቶአል።

verses.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi dis à la maison d''Israël: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Ne vous souillez-vous pas à la manière de vos pères, et ne vous prostituez-vous pas à leurs abominations?
verses.am: ስለዚህ ለእስራኤል ቤት እንዲህ በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንደ አባቶቻችሁ ልማድ ትረክሳላችሁን? ርኵሰታቸውንም ተከትላችሁ ታመነዝራላችሁን?

verses.en: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.fr: En présentant vos offrandes, en faisant passer vos enfants par le feu, vous vous souillez encore aujourd''hui par toutes vos idoles. Et moi, je me laisserais consulter par vous, maison d''Israël! Je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, je ne me laisserai pas consulter par vous.
verses.am: ቍርባናችሁን ባቀረባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ልጆቻችሁንም በእሳት ባሳለፋችሁ ጊዜ፥ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በጣዖቶቻችሁ ትረክሳላችሁን የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ከእናንተስ ዘንድ እጠየቃለሁን? እኔ ሕያው ነኛና ከእናንተ ዘንድ አልጠየቅም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.fr: On ne verra pas s''accomplir ce que vous imaginez, quand vous dites: Nous voulons être comme les nations, comme les familles des autres pays, nous voulons servir le bois et la pierre.
verses.am: ለእናንተም። እንደ አሕዛብና እንደ ምድር ወገኖች እንሆናለን፥ እንጨትና ድንጋይም እናመልካለን የሚል ከልባችሁ የወጣ አሳብ አይፈጸምላችሁም።

verses.en: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
verses.fr: Je suis vivant! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, je régnerai sur vous, à main forte et à bras étendu, et en répandant ma fureur.
verses.am: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በበረታች እጅና በተዘረጋች ክንድ በፈሰሰችም መዓት እነግሥባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.fr: Je vous ferai sortir du milieu des peuples, et je vous rassemblerai des pays où vous êtes dispersés, à main forte et à bras étendu, et en répandant ma fureur.
verses.am: ከአሕዛብም ዘንድ አወጣችኋለሁ ከተበተናችሁባትም አገር ሁሉ በበረታች እጅና በተዘረጋች ክንድ በፈሰሰችም መዓት እሰበስባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
verses.fr: Je vous amènerai dans le désert des peuples, et là je vous jugerai face à face.
verses.am: ወደ አሕዛብም ምድረ በዳ አመጣችኋለሁ በዚያም ፊት ለፊት ከእናንተ ጋር እፋረዳለሁ።

verses.en: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Comme je suis entré en jugement avec vos pères dans le désert du pays d''Egypte, ainsi j''entrerai en jugement avec vous, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በግብጽ ምድረ በዳ ከአባቶቻችሁ ጋር እንደ ተፋረድሁ እንዲሁ ከእናንተ ጋር እፋረዳለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
verses.fr: Je vous ferai passer sous la verge, et je vous mettrai dans les liens de l''alliance.
verses.am: ከበትርም በታች አሳልፋችኋለሁ ወደ ቃል ኪዳንም እስራት አገባችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Je séparerai de vous les rebelles et ceux qui me sont infidèles; je les tirerai du pays où ils sont étrangers, mais ils n''iront pas au pays d''Israël. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእናንተም ዘንድ ዓመፀኞችንና የበደሉኝን እለያለሁ፤ ከኖሩባትም ምድር አወጣቸዋለሁ፥ ወደ እስራኤል ምድር ግን አይገቡም፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord God; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
verses.fr: Et vous, maison d''Israël, ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Allez chacun servir vos idoles! Mais après cela, vous m''écouterez, et vous ne profanerez plus mon saint nom par vos offrandes et par vos idoles.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ሂዱ፥ ከዚህም በኋላ ትሰሙኝ ዘንድ ባትወድዱ ሁላችሁ ጣዖቶቻችሁን አምልኩ። ነገር ግን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በቍርባናችሁና በጣዖቶቻችሁ ቅዱሱን ስሜን አታረክሱም።

verses.en: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord God, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.fr: Car sur ma montagne sainte, sur la haute montagne d''Israël, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, là toute la maison d''Israël, tous ceux qui seront dans le pays me serviront; là je les recevrai favorablement, je rechercherai vos offrandes, les prémices de vos dons, et tout ce que vous me consacrerez.
verses.am: በቅዱሱ ተራራዬ፥ ከፍ ባለው በእስራኤል ተራራ ላይ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያ የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ሁላቸው በምድሩ ላይ ያመልኩኛል፤ በዚያም እቀበላቸዋለሁ፥ በዚያም ቍርባናችሁን በኵራታችሁንም የቀደሳችሁትንም ነገር ሁሉ እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.en: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
verses.fr: Je vous recevrai comme un parfum d''une agréable odeur, quand je vous aurai fait sortir du milieu des peuples, et rassemblés des pays où vous êtes dispersés; et je serai sanctifié par vous aux yeux des nations.
verses.am: ከአሕዛብም ዘንድ ባወጣኋችሁ ጊዜ ከተበተናችሁባትም አገር ሁሉ በሰበሰብኋችሁ ጊዜ እንደ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እቀበላችኋለሁ፥ በአሕዛብም ፊት እቀደስባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.fr: Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel, quand je vous ramènerai dans le pays d''Israël, dans le pays que j''avais juré de donner à vos pères.
verses.am: ለአባቶቻችሁም እሰጣት ዘንድ ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ወደ እስራኤል አገር ባገባኋችሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
verses.fr: Là vous vous souviendrez de votre conduite et de toutes vos actions par lesquelles vous vous êtes souillés; vous vous prendrez vous-mêmes en dégoût, à cause de toutes les infamies que vous avez commises.
verses.am: በዚያም የረከሳችሁባትን መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን ሁሉ ታስባላችሁ፤ ስለ ሠራችሁትም ክፋታችሁ ሁሉ ራሳችሁን ትጸየፋላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am the Lord when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel, quand j''agirai avec vous par égard pour mon nom, et nullement d''après votre conduite mauvaise et vos actions corrompues, ô maison d''Israël! dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እንደ ክፉ መንገዳችሁና እንደ ርኩስ ሥራችሁ ሳይሆን ስለ ስሜ ስል በሠራሁላችሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tourne ta face vers le midi, Et parle contre le midi! Prophétise contre la forêt des champs du midi!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ ደቡብ አቅና ወደ ደቡብም ተናገር በደቡብም ባለው ዱር ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር፤

verses.en: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
verses.fr: Tu diras à la forêt du midi: Ecoute la parole de l''Eternel! Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Je vais allumer un feu au dedans de toi, Et il dévorera tout arbre vert et tout arbre sec; La flamme ardente ne s''éteindra point, Et tout visage en sera brûlé, Du midi au septentrion.
verses.am: ለደቡብም ዱር። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በአንተ ውስጥ እሳት አነድዳለሁ፤ በውስጥህም ያለውን የለመለመውንና የደረቀውን ዛፍ ሁሉ ይበላል፤ የሚቃጠል ነበልባል አይጠፋም፤ ከደቡብም ጀምሮ እስከ ሰሜን ድረስ ፊት ሁሉ ይቃጠልበታል።

verses.en: And all flesh shall see that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
verses.fr: Et toute chair verra Que moi, l''Eternel, je l''ai allumé. Il ne s''éteindra point.
verses.am: እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንዳነደድሁት ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ያያል፥ እርሱም አይጠፋም በለው።

verses.en: Then said I, Ah Lord God! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
verses.fr: Je dis: Ah! Seigneur Eternel! Ils disent de moi: N''est-ce pas un faiseur de paraboles?
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እነርሱ ስለ እኔ። ይህ ምሳሌን የሚመስል አይደለምን? ብለዋል አልሁ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tourne ta face vers Jérusalem, Et parle contre les lieux saints! Prophétise contre le pays d''Israël!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አቅና ወደ መቅደሶችም ተናገር በእስራኤልም ምድር ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር።

verses.en: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
verses.fr: Tu diras au pays d''Israël: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, j''en veux à toi, Je tirerai mon épée de son fourreau, Et j''exterminerai du milieu de toi le juste et le méchant.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ምድር እንዲህ በል። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ሰይፌንም ከሰገባው እመዝዘዋለሁ፥ ጻድቁንና ክፉውንም ከአንተ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
verses.fr: Parce que je veux exterminer du milieu de toi le juste et le méchant, Mon épée sortira de son fourreau, Pour frapper toute chair, Du midi au septentrion.
verses.am: እኔም ጻድቁንና ክፉውን ከአንተ ዘንድ ስለማጠፋ፥ ስለዚህ ሰይፌ ከደቡብ ጀምሮ እስከ ሰሜን ድረስ ባለ በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ ከሰገባው ይመዘዛል።

verses.en: That all flesh may know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
verses.fr: Et toute chair saura Que moi, l''Eternel, j''ai tiré mon épée de son fourreau. Elle n''y rentrera plus.
verses.am: ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ሰይፌን ከሰገባው እንደ መዘዝሁ ያውቃል፥ እርሱም ደግሞ አይመለስም።

verses.en: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, gémis! Les reins brisés et l''amertume dans l''âme, Gémis sous leurs regards!
verses.am: ስለዚህም፥ አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ አልቅስ፤ ወገብህን በማጕበጥ በፊታቸው ምርር ብለህ አልቅስ።

verses.en: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Et s''ils te disent: Pourquoi gémis-tu? Tu répondras: Parce qu''il arrive une nouvelle... Tous les coeurs s''alarmeront, Toutes les mains deviendront faibles, Tous les esprits seront abattus, Tous les genoux se fondront en eau... Voici, elle arrive, elle est là! Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ስለ ምን ታለቅሳለህ? ቢሉህ፥ አንተ እንዲህ በላቸው። ወሬ ስለሚመጣ ነው፤ ልብም ሁሉ ይቀልጣል፥ እጆችም ሁሉ ይዝላሉ፥ ነፍስም ሁሉ ትደክማለች፥ ጉልበትም እንደ ውኃ ይፈስሳል፤ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል ይፈጸምማል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, prophétise, et dis: Ainsi parle l''Eternel. Dis: L''épée! l''épée! Elle est aiguisée, elle est polie.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ትንቢት ተናገር፤ ሰይፍ ሰይፍ የተሳለ የተሰነገለም ነው በል።

verses.en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
verses.fr: C''est pour massacrer qu''elle est aiguisée, C''est pour étinceler qu''elle est polie... Nous réjouirons-nous? Le sceptre de mon fils méprise tout bois...
verses.am: ይገድል ዘንድ ተስሎአል ያብረቀርቅም ዘንድ ተሰንግሎአል፤ እኛስ ደስ ይለናልን? የልጄን በትር እንደ ዛፍ ሁሉ ንቆታል።

verses.en: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
verses.fr: On l''a donnée à polir, Pour que la main la saisisse; Elle est aiguisée, l''épée, elle est polie, Pour armer la main de celui qui massacre.
verses.am: በእጁም እንዲያዝ ለመሰንገል ተሰጠ፤ ሰይፍ በገዳይ እጅ እንዲሰጥ ተሳለና ተሰነገለ።

verses.en: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.
verses.fr: Crie et gémis, fils de l''homme! Car elle est tirée contre mon peuple, Contre tous les princes d''Israël; Ils sont livrés à l''épée avec mon peuple. Frappe donc sur ta cuisse!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በሕዝቤ ላይ ነውና፥ በእስራኤል አለቆች ሁሉ ላይ ነውና ጩኽ ዋይም በል፤ እነርሱ ከሕዝቤ ጋር ለሰይፍ ተሰጥተዋል፤ ስለዚህ ጭንህን ጽፋ።

verses.en: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Oui, l''épreuve sera faite; Et que sera-ce, si ce sceptre qui méprise tout est anéanti? Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፈተና ደርሶአል፤ የተናቀ በትርስ ደግሞ ባይኖር ምንድር ነው? ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together. and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, prophétise, Et frappe des mains! Et que les coups de l''épée soient doublés, soient triplés! C''est l''épée du carnage, l''épée du grand carnage, L''épée qui doit les poursuivre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ አንተ የሰው ልጅ፥ ትንቢት ተናገር፥ እጅህን አጨብጭብ፤ የተገደሉ ሰዎች ሰይፍ ሦስት ጊዜ ይደጋግም የሚከብባቸው የተገደለ የታላቅ ሰው ሰይፍ ነው።

verses.en: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
verses.fr: Pour jeter l''effroi dans les coeurs, Pour multiplier les victimes, A toutes leurs portes je les menacerai de l''épée. Ah! elle est faite pour étinceler, Elle est aiguisée pour massacrer.
verses.am: ልባቸው እንዲቀልጥ መሰናክላቸውም እንዲበዛ የሚገድለውን ሰይፍ በበሮቻቸው ሁሉ ላይ አድርጌአለሁ፤ ወዮ! ያብረቀርቅ ዘንድ ተሰንግሎአል ይገድልም ዘንድ ተስሎአል።

verses.en: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
verses.fr: Rassemble tes forces, tourne-toi à droite! Place-toi, tourne-toi à gauche! Dirige de tous côtés ton tranchant!
verses.am: ተዘጋጅተህ ፊትህ ወደ ወደደው ወደ ቀኝ ወይም ወደ ግራ ሂድ።

verses.en: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the Lord have said it.
verses.fr: Et moi aussi, je frapperai des mains, Et j''assouvirai ma fureur. C''est moi, l''Eternel, qui parle.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ በእጄ አጨበጭባለሁ መዓቴንም እጨርሳለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, trace deux chemins pour servir de passage à l''épée du roi de Babylone; tous les deux doivent sortir du même pays; marque un signe, marque-le à l''entrée du chemin qui conduit à une ville.
verses.am: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሰይፍ ይመጣ ዘንድ ሁለት መንገዶችን አድርግ፤ ሁለቱም ከአንዲት ምድር ይውጡ፤ ምልክትም አድርግ፥ በከተማይቱ መንገድ ራስ ላይ አድርገው።

verses.en: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
verses.fr: Tu traceras l''un des chemins pour que l''épée arrive à Rabbath, ville des enfants d''Ammon, et l''autre pour qu''elle arrive en Juda, à Jérusalem, ville fortifiée.
verses.am: ሰይፍ ወደ አሞን ልጆች አገር ወደ ረባት ወደ ይሁዳም ወደ ተመሸገች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይመጣ ዘንድ መንገድን አድርግ።

verses.en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
verses.fr: Car le roi de Babylone se tient au carrefour, à l''entrée des deux chemins, pour tirer des présages; il secoue les flèches, il interroge les théraphim, il examine le foie.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ምዋርቱን ያምዋርት ዘንድ በመንታ መንገድ ላይ በሁለቱ መንገዶች ራስ ላይ ቆሞ ነበር፤ ፍላጾችን ወዘወዘ፥ ከተራፊምም ጠየቀ፥ ጉበትም ተመለከተ።

verses.en: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
verses.fr: Le sort, qui est dans sa droite, désigne Jérusalem, où l''on devra dresser des béliers, commander le carnage, et pousser des cris de guerre; on dressera des béliers contre les portes, on élèvera des terrasses, on formera des retranchements.
verses.am: የቅጥሩን ማፍረሻ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ አፍንም በጩኸት ይከፍት ዘንድ፥ በውካታም ድምፅን ከፍ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ የቅጥሩን ማፍረሻ በበሮች ላይ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ አፈርን ይደለድል ዘንድ፥ ምሽግም ይሠራ ዘንድ የኢየሩሳሌም ዕጣ በቀኝ እጁ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
verses.fr: Ils ne voient là que de vaines divinations, eux qui ont fait des serments. Mais lui, il se souvient de leur iniquité, en sorte qu''ils seront pris.
verses.am: መሐላውንም በማሉ በዓይናቸው ዘንድ የሐሰት ምዋርት ይመስላል፥ ነገር ግን እነርሱ ይያዙ ዘንድ እርሱ ኃጢአትን ያሳስባል።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que vous rappelez le souvenir de votre iniquité, en mettant à nu vos transgressions, en manifestant vos péchés dans toutes vos actions; parce que vous en rappelez le souvenir, vous serez saisis par sa main.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ኃጢአታችሁን ስለ አሰባችሁ መተላለፋችሁም ስለ ተገለጠ ኃጢአታችሁም በሥራችሁ ሁሉ ስለ ታየ እናንተም ስለ ታሰባችሁ፥ በእጅ ትያዛላችሁ።

verses.en: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
verses.fr: Et toi, profane, méchant, prince d''Israël, dont le jour arrive au temps où l''iniquité est à son terme!
verses.am: አንተም ቀንህ የደረሰብህ፥ የኃጢአትህ ቀጠሮ ጊዜ የደረሰብህ፥ ርኩስ ኃጢአተኛ የእስራኤል አለቃ ሆይ፥

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: La tiare sera ôtée, le diadème sera enlevé. Les choses vont changer. Ce qui est abaissé sera élevé, et ce qui est élevé sera abaissé.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መጠምጠሚያውን አውልቅ፥ ዘውዱንም አርቅ፤ ይህ እንዲህ አይሆንም፤ የተዋረደውን ከፍ አድርግ፥ ከፍ ያለውንም አዋርድ።

verses.en: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
verses.fr: J''en ferai une ruine, une ruine, une ruine. Mais cela n''aura lieu qu''à la venue de celui à qui appartient le jugement et à qui je le remettrai.
verses.am: ባድማ፥ ባድማ፥ ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ፤ ፍርድ ያለው እስኪመጣ ድረስ ይህች ደግሞ አትሆንም፥ ለእርሱም እሰጣታለሁ።

verses.en: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, prophétise, et dis: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel, sur les enfants d''Ammon et sur leur opprobre. Dis: L''épée, l''épée est tirée, elle est polie, pour massacrer, pour dévorer, pour étinceler!
verses.am: ወደ ሰገባውም መልሰው። በተፈጠርህበት ስፍራ በተወለድህባትም ምድር እፈርድብሃለሁ።

verses.en: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
verses.fr: Au milieu de tes visions vaines et de tes oracles menteurs, elle te fera tomber parmi les cadavres des méchants, dont le jour arrive au temps où l''iniquité est à son terme.
verses.am: ወደ ሰገባውም መልሰው። በተፈጠርህበት ስፍራ በተወለድህባትም ምድር እፈርድብሃለሁ።

verses.en: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
verses.fr: Remets ton épée dans le fourreau. Je te jugerai dans le lieu où tu as été créé, dans le pays de ta naissance.
verses.am: ቍጣዬንም አፈስስብሃለሁ፥ በመዓቴም እሳት አናፋብሃለሁ፥ ማጥፋትንም ለሚያውቁ ለጨካኞች ሰዎች እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
verses.fr: Je répandrai sur toi ma colère, je soufflerai contre toi avec le feu de ma fureur, et je te livrerai entre les mains d''hommes qui dévorent, qui ne travaillent qu''à détruire.
verses.am: ለእሳት ማገዶ ትሆናለህ፥ ደምህም በምድር መካከል ይሆናል፥ ደግሞም አትታሰብም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁና።

verses.en: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the Lord have spoken it.
verses.fr: Tu seras consumé par le feu; ton sang coulera au milieu du pays; on ne se souviendra plus de toi. Car moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé.
verses.am: ፤ ለእሳት ማገዶ ትሆናለህ፥ ደምህም በምድር መካከል ይሆናል፥ ደግሞም አትታሰብም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁና።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, jugeras-tu, jugeras-tu la ville sanguinaire? Fais-lui connaître toutes ses abominations!
verses.am: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ትፈርዳለህን? ደም በምታፈስስ ከተማ ላይ ትፈርዳለህን? ርኵሰትዋን ሁሉ አስታውቃት።

verses.en: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord God, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Ville qui répands le sang au milieu de toi, pour que ton jour arrive, et qui te fais des idoles pour te souiller!
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጊዜሽ እንዲደርስ በመካከልሽ ደምን የምታፈስሺ እንድትረክሺም በራስሽ ላይ ጣዖታትን የምታደርጊ ከተማ ሆይ!

verses.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
verses.fr: Tu es coupable à cause du sang que tu as répandu, et tu t''es souillée par les idoles que tu as faites. Tu as ainsi avancé tes jours, et tu es parvenue au terme de tes années. C''est pourquoi je te rends un objet d''opprobre pour les nations et de moquerie pour tous les pays.
verses.am: ባፈሰስሽው ደም በድለሻል ባደረግሽውም ጣዖታት ረክሰሻል፤ ቀንሽን አቀረብሽ ዘመንሽንም አሳጠርሽ፤ ስለዚህ ለአሕዛብ መሰደቢያ ለአገሮችም ሁሉ መሳለቂያ አደረግሁሽ።

verses.en: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont près et ceux qui sont au loin se moqueront de toi, qui es souillée de réputation et pleine de trouble.
verses.am: አንቺ ስምሽ የረከሰ ሽብርም የሞላብሽ ሆይ፥ ወደ አንቺ የቀረቡና ከአንቺ የራቁ ይሳለቁብሻል።

verses.en: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
verses.fr: Voici, au dedans de toi, tous les princes d''Israël usent de leur force pour répandre le sang;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል አለቆች እያንዳንዱ እንደ ችሎቱ ደም ያፈስሱ ዘንድ በአንቺ ውስጥ ነበሩ።

verses.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
verses.fr: au dedans de toi, l''on méprise père et mère, on maltraite l''étranger, on opprime l''orphelin et la veuve.
verses.am: በአንቺ ውስጥ አባትንና እናትን አቃለሉ፤ በመካከልሽ በመጻተኛው ላይ በደልን አደረጉ፤ በአንቺ ውስጥ ድሀ አደጉንና መበለቲቱን አስጨነቁ።

verses.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
verses.fr: Tu dédaignes mes sanctuaires, tu profanes mes sabbats.
verses.am: ቅድሳቴንም ናቅሽ ሰንበታቴንም አረከስሽ።

verses.en: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
verses.fr: Il y a chez toi des calomniateurs pour répandre le sang; chez toi, l''on mange sur les montagnes; on commet le crime dans ton sein.
verses.am: ደምን ያፈስሱ ዘንድ ቀማኞች ሰዎች በአንቺ ውስጥ ነበሩ፤ በአንቺ ውስጥ በተራሮች ላይ በሉ፤ በመካከልሽ ሴሰኝነትን አደረጉ።

verses.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
verses.fr: Au milieu de toi, on découvre la nudité du père; au milieu de toi, on fait violence à la femme pendant son impureté.
verses.am: በአንቺ ውስጥ የአባቶቻቸውን ኀፍረተ ሥጋ ገለጡ፤ በአንቺም ውስጥ አደፍ ያለባትን አዋረዱ።

verses.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.
verses.fr: Au milieu de toi, chacun se livre à des abominations avec la femme de son prochain, chacun se souille par l''inceste avec sa belle-fille, chacun déshonore sa soeur, fille de son père.
verses.am: ሰውም በባልንጀራው ሚስት ርኵሰትን አደረገ፥ አባትም የልጁን ሚስት አረከሰ፥ በአንቺም ዘንድ ወንድም የአባቱን ልጅ እኅቱን አሳፈረ።

verses.en: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Chez toi, l''on reçoit des présents pour répandre le sang: tu exiges un intérêt et une usure, tu dépouilles ton prochain par la violence, et moi, tu m''oublies, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በአንቺ ውስጥ ደምን ያፈስሱ ዘንድ ጉቦን ተቀበሉ፤ አንቺም አራጣና ትርፍ ወስደሻል፥ ከባልንጀሮችሽም በቅሚያ የስስትን ትርፍ አገኘሽ፥ እኔንም ረሳሽኝ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
verses.fr: Voici, je frappe des mains à cause de la cupidité que tu as eue, et du sang qui a été répandu au milieu de toi.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ አንቺ ባደረግሽው ስስት በመካከልሽም በነበረው ደም ላይ እጄን አጨበጨብሁ።

verses.en: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the Lord have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.fr: Ton coeur sera-t-il ferme, tes mains auront-elles de la force dans les jours où j''agirai contre toi? Moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé, et j''agirai.
verses.am: በውኑ እኔ በማደርግብሽ ወራት ልብሽ ይታገሣልን? ወይስ እጅሽ ትጸናለችን? እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ አደርገውማለሁ።

verses.en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
verses.fr: Je te disperserai parmi les nations, je te répandrai en divers pays, et je ferai disparaître ton impureté du milieu de toi.
verses.am: ወደ አሕዛብም እበትንሻለሁ ወደ አገሮችም እዘራሻለሁ፥ ርኵሰትሽንም ከአንቺ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu seras souillée par toi-même aux yeux des nations, et tu sauras que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በአሕዛብም ፊት አንቺ ትረክሻለሽ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂአለሽ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, la maison d''Israël est devenue pour moi comme des scories; ils sont tous de l''airain, de l''étain, du fer, du plomb, dans le creuset; ce sont des scories d''argent.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ቤት ለእኔ እንደ አተላ ሆኑብኝ፤ እነርሱ ሁሉ በከውር ውስጥ መዳብና ቈርቈሮ ብረትና እርሳስ ናቸው፤ የብር አተላ ናቸው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que vous êtes tous devenus comme des scories, voici, je vous rassemblerai au milieu de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሁላችሁ አተላ ሆናችኋልና ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ እሰበስባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
verses.fr: Comme on rassemble l''argent, l''airain, le fer, le plomb et l''étain, dans le creuset, et qu''on souffle le feu pour les fondre, ainsi je vous rassemblerai dans ma colère et dans ma fureur, et je vous mettrai au creuset pour vous fondre.
verses.am: እንዲያቀልጡት እሳት ያናፉበት ዘንድ ብርንና መዳብን ብረትንና እርሳስን ቈርቈሮንም በከውር እንደሚሰበስቡ፥ እንዲሁ በቍጣዬና በመዓቴ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፥ በዚያም ውስጥ እጨምራችኋለሁ አቀልጣችሁማለሁ።

verses.en: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst therof.
verses.fr: Je vous rassemblerai, et je soufflerai contre vous avec le feu de ma fureur; et vous serez fondus au milieu de Jérusalem.
verses.am: አሰበስባችሁማለሁ የመዓቴንም እሳት አናፋባችኋለሁ በውስጡም ትቀልጣላችሁ።

verses.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the Lord have poured out my fury upon you.
verses.fr: Comme l''argent fond dans le creuset, ainsi vous serez fondus au milieu d''elle. Et vous saurez que moi, l''Eternel, j''ai répandu ma fureur sur vous.
verses.am: ብርም በከውር ውስጥ እንደሚቀልጥ፥ እንዲሁ በውስጡዋ ትቀልጣላችሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር መዓቴን እንዳፈሰስሁባችሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, dis à Jérusalem: Tu es une terre qui n''est pas purifiée, qui n''est pas arrosée de pluie au jour de la colère.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ። አንቺ ያልነጻሽ በቍጣም ቀን ያልዘነበብሽ ምድር ነሽ በላት።

verses.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
verses.fr: Ses prophètes conspirent dans son sein; comme des lions rugissants qui déchirent leur proie, ils dévorent les âmes, ils s''emparent des richesses et des choses précieuses, ils multiplient les veuves au milieu d''elle.
verses.am: በውስጥዋ ያሉ ነቢያት እንደሚጮኽና እንደሚናጠቅ አንበሳ አንድ ሆነው ተማማሉ፤ ነፍሶችን በልተዋል፥ ብልጥግናና ሀብትን ወስደዋል፥ በውስጥዋም መበለቶችን አብዝተዋል።

verses.en: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.fr: Ses sacrificateurs violent ma loi et profanent mes sanctuaires, ils ne distinguent pas ce qui est saint de ce qui est profane, ils ne font pas connaître la différence entre ce qui est impur et ce qui est pur, ils détournent les yeux de mes sabbats, et je suis profané au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ካህናቶችዋም ሕጌን በድለዋል ቅድሳቴንም አርክሰዋል፤ ቅዱስ በሆነና ቅዱስ ባልሆነ መካከልም አልለዩም፥ በንጹሕና በርኩስ መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት አላስታወቁም፤ ዓይናቸውንም ከሰንበታቴ ሰወሩ እኔም በመካከላቸው ረከስሁ።

verses.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
verses.fr: Ses chefs sont dans son sein comme des loups qui déchirent leur proie; ils répandent le sang, perdent les âmes, pour assouvir leur cupidité.
verses.am: በውስጥዋ ያሉ አለቆችዋ የስስትን ትርፍ ለማግኘት ሲሉ ደምን ያፈስሱ ዘንድ ነፍሶችንም ያጠፉ ዘንድ እንደሚናጠቁ ተኵላዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken.
verses.fr: Et ses prophètes ont pour eux des enduits de plâtre, de vaines visions, des oracles menteurs; ils disent: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel! Et l''Eternel ne leur a point parlé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሳይናገር ነቢያቶችዋ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል እያሉ ከንቱን ራእይ በማየት የሐሰትንም ምዋርት ለእነርሱ በማምዋረት ያለ ገለባ በጭቃ ይመርጓቸዋል።

verses.en: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
verses.fr: Le peuple du pays se livre à la violence, commet des rapines, opprime le malheureux et l''indigent, foule l''étranger contre toute justice.
verses.am: የምድርን ሕዝብ ግፍ አደረጉ ቅሚያም ሠሩ፤ ድሆችንና ችግረኞችን አስጨነቁ፥ መጻተኛውንም በደሉ።

verses.en: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
verses.fr: Je cherche parmi eux un homme qui élève un mur, qui se tienne à la brèche devant moi en faveur du pays, afin que je ne le détruise pas; mais je n''en trouve point.
verses.am: ቅጥርን የሚጠግንን፥ ምድሪቱንም እንዳላጠፋት በፈረሰበት በኩል በፊቴ የሚቆምላትን ሰው በመካከላቸው ፈለግሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላገኘሁም።

verses.en: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Je répandrai sur eux ma fureur, je les consumerai par le feu de ma colère, je ferai retomber leurs oeuvres sur leur tête, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ቍጣዬን አፈሰስሁባቸው፥ በመዓቴም እሳት አጠፋኋቸው፤ መንገዳቸውንም በራሳቸው ላይ መለስሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, il y avait deux femmes, Filles d''une même mère.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የአንዲት እናት ልጆች የሆኑ ሁለት ሴቶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.fr: Elles se sont prostituées en Egypte, Elles se sont prostituées dans leur jeunesse; Là leurs mamelles ont été pressées, Là leur sein virginal a été touché.
verses.am: በግብጽም አመነዘሩ፥ በኰረዳነታቸው አመነዘሩ፤ በዚያ ጡቶቻቸው ምዋሸሹ በዚያም የድንግልናቸውን ጡቶች ዳበሱ።

verses.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.fr: L''aînée s''appelait Ohola, Et sa soeur Oholiba; Elles étaient à moi, Et elles ont enfanté des fils et des filles. Ohola, c''est Samarie; Oholiba, c''est Jérusalem.
verses.am: ስማቸውም የታላቂቱ ኦሖላ የእኅትዋም ኦሖሊባ ነበረ፥ ለእኔም ሆኑ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ወለዱ። ስማቸውም ኦሖላ ሰማርያ ናት፤ ኦሖሊባ ደግሞ ኢየሩሳሌም ናት።

verses.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
verses.fr: Ohola me fut infidèle; Elle s''enflamma pour ses amants, Les Assyriens ses voisins,
verses.am: ኦሖላም ገለሞተችብኝ፥ ውሽሞችዋንም ጎረቤቶችዋን አሦራውያንን በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው።

verses.en: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.fr: Vêtus d''étoffes teintes en bleu, Gouverneurs et chefs, Tous jeunes et charmants, Cavaliers montés sur des chevaux.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሰማያዊ ሐር የለበሱ አለቆችና ሹማምቶች፥ መልከ መልካሞች ጐበዛዝት፥ በፈረስ ላይ የሚቀመጡ ፈረሰኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.fr: Elle s''est prostituée à eux, A toute l''élite des enfants de l''Assyrie; Elle s''est souillée avec tous ceux pour lesquels elle s''était enflammée, Elle s''est souillée avec toutes leurs idoles.
verses.am: ግልሙትናዋንም ከተመረጡ ከአሦር ሰዎች ሁሉ ጋር አደረገች፥ በፍቅር በተከተለቻቸውም ጣዖቶቻቸው ሁሉ ረከሰች።

verses.en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.fr: Elle n''a pas renoncé à ses prostitutions d''Egypte: Car ils avaient couché avec elle dans sa jeunesse, Ils avaient touché son sein virginal, Et ils avaient répandu sur elle leurs prostitutions.
verses.am: በግብጽም የነበረውን ግልሙትናዋን አልተወችም፤ በዚያ በኰረዳነትዋ ጊዜ ከእርስዋ ጋር ተኝተው ነበር፥ የድንግልናዋንም ጡቶች ዳብሰው ነበር፥ ግልሙትናቸውንም አፍስሰውባት ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je l''ai livrée entre les mains de ses amants, Entre les mains des enfants de l''Assyrie, Pour lesquels elle s''était enflammée.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በፍቅር በተከተለቻቸው በውሽሞችዋ በአሦራውያን እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጠኋት።

verses.en: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.fr: Ils ont découvert sa nudité, Ils ont pris ses fils et ses filles, Ils l''ont fait périr elle-même avec l''épée; Elle a été en renom parmi les femmes, Après les jugements exercés sur elle.
verses.am: እነርሱም ኅፍረተ ሥጋዋን ገለጡ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችዋንም ማርከው ወሰዱ፥ እርስዋንም በሰይፍ ገደሉ፤ ፍርድንም ስላደረጉባት በሴቶች መካከል መተረቻ ሆነች።

verses.en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
verses.fr: Sa soeur Oholiba vit cela, Et fut plus déréglée qu''elle dans sa passion; Ses prostitutions dépassèrent celles de sa soeur.
verses.am: እኅትዋም ኦሖሊባ ይህን አየች፤ ሆኖም ከእርስዋ ይልቅ በፍቅር በመከተልዋ ረከሰች፥ ግልሙትናዋም ከእኅትዋ ግልሙትና ይልቅ በዛ።

verses.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.fr: Elle s''enflamma pour les enfants de l''Assyrie, Gouverneurs et chefs, ses voisins, Vêtus magnifiquement, Cavaliers montés sur des chevaux, Tous jeunes et charmants.
verses.am: አለቆችንና ሹማምቶችን ጎረቤቶችዋን ጌጠኛ ልብስ የለበሱትን በፈረሶች ላይ የሚቀመጡትን ፈረሰኞች፥ ሁሉም መልከ መልካሞችን ጐበዛዝት አሦራውያንን በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው።

verses.en: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
verses.fr: Je vis qu''elle s''était souillée, Que l''une et l''autre avaient suivi la même voie.
verses.am: የረከሰችም እንደ ሆነች አየሁ፥ ሁለቱም አንድ መንገድ ሄደዋል።

verses.en: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
verses.fr: Elle alla même plus loin dans ses prostitutions. Elle aperçut contre les murailles des peintures d''hommes, Des images de Chaldéens peints en couleur rouge,
verses.am: ግልሙትናዋንም አበዛች፤ በቀይ ቀለምም የተሳለችውን የከለዳውያንን ስዕል፥ በናስ ላይ የተሳሉትን ሰዎች አየች።

verses.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
verses.fr: Avec des ceintures autour des reins, Avec des turbans de couleurs variées flottant sur la tête, Tous ayant l''apparence de chefs, Et figurant des enfants de Babylone, De la Chaldée, leur patrie;
verses.am: በወገባቸው ዝናር የታጠቁ ራሳቸውንም በቀለማዊ መጠምጠሚያ የጠመጠሙ ነበሩ፤ ሁሉም ከተወለዱባት አገር የሆኑትን የከለዳውያንን ልጆች መስለው መሳፍንትን ይመስሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
verses.fr: Elle s''enflamma pour eux, au premier regard, Et leur envoya des messagers en Chaldée.
verses.am: ባየቻቸውም ጊዜ በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው፥ ወደ ከላውዴዎን ምድር ወደ እነርሱ መልእክተኞችን ላከች።
