verses.en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
verses.fr: Et les enfants de Babylone se rendirent auprès d''elle, Pour partager le lit des amours, Et ils la souillèrent par leurs prostitutions. Elle s''est souillée avec eux, Puis son coeur s''est détaché d''eux.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ሰዎች ወደ እርስዋ ፍቅር ወዳለበት መኝታ መጡ በግልሙትናቸውም አረከሱአት፤ እርስዋም ከእነርሱ ጋር ረከሰች ነፍስዋም ከእነርሱ ተለየች።

verses.en: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
verses.fr: Elle a mis à nu son impudicité, Elle a découvert sa nudité; Et mon coeur s''est détaché d''elle, Comme mon coeur s''était détaché de sa soeur.
verses.am: ግልሙትናዋንም ገለጠች ኅፍረተ ሥጋዋንም አሳየች፤ ነፍሴም ከእኅትዋ እንደ ተለየች እንዲሁ ነፍሴ ከእርስዋ ተለየች።

verses.en: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Elle a multiplié ses prostitutions, En pensant aux jours de sa jeunesse, Lorsqu''elle se prostituait au pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በግብጽ ምድር የገለሞተችበትን የኰረዳነትዋን ዘመን አስባ ግልሙትናዋን አበዛች።

verses.en: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
verses.fr: Elle s''est enflammée pour des impudiques, Dont la chair était comme celle des ânes, Et l''approche comme celle des chevaux.
verses.am: ሥጋቸውም እንደ አህዮች ሥጋ ዘራቸውም እንደ ፈረሶች ዘር የሆነውን እነዚያን ምልምሎች በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው።

verses.en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
verses.fr: Tu t''es souvenue des crimes de ta jeunesse, Lorsque les Egyptiens pressaient tes mamelles, A cause de ton sein virginal.
verses.am: ስለ ኰረዳነትሽ ምክንያት ግብጻውያን ጡቶችሽን በዳበሱ ጊዜ የኰረዳነትሽን ሴሰኝነት አሰብሽ።

verses.en: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, Oholiba, ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''excite contre toi tes amants, Ceux dont ton coeur s''est détaché, Et je les amène de toutes parts contre toi;
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ኦሖሊባ ሆይ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ነፍስሽ ከእነርሱ የተለየች ውሽሞችሽን አስነሣብሻለሁ፥ በዙሪያሽም በአንቺ ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
verses.fr: Les enfants de Babylone et tous les Chaldéens, Nobles, princes et seigneurs, Et tous les enfants de l''Assyrie avec eux, Jeunes et charmants, Tous gouverneurs et chefs, Chefs illustres, Tous montés sur des chevaux.
verses.am: እነርሱም የባቢሎን ሰዎች ከለዳውያንም ሁሉ፥ ፋቁድ፥ ሱሔ፥ ቆዓ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር አሦራውያን ሁሉ፥ መልከ መልካሞች ጐበዛዝት፥ አለቆችና ሹማምቶች ሁሉ፥ መሳፍንቶችና አማካሪዎች ሁሉ፥ በፈረስ ላይ የተቀመጡ ናቸው።

verses.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
verses.fr: Ils marchent contre toi avec des armes, des chars et des roues, Et une multitude de peuples; Avec le grand bouclier et le petit bouclier, avec les casques, Ils s''avancent de toutes parts contre toi. Je leur remets le jugement, Et ils te jugeront selon leurs lois.
verses.am: በመሣሪያና በሰረገላ በመንኰራኵርም በአሕዛብም ጉባኤ ይመጡብሻል፤ ጋሻና አላባሽ ጋሻ ራስ ቍርም ይዘው በዙሪያሽ ይዘጋጁብሻል፤ ፍርድንም እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ ፍርዳቸውም ይፈርዱብሻል።

verses.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
verses.fr: Je répands ma colère sur toi, Et ils te traiteront avec fureur. Ils te couperont le nez et les oreilles, Et ce qui reste de toi tombera par l''épée; Ils prendront tes fils et tes filles, Et ce qui reste de toi sera dévoré par le feu.
verses.am: ቅንዓቴንም በአንቺ ላይ አደርጋለሁ በመዓትም ያደርጉብሻል፤ አፍንጫሽንና ጆሮሽንም ከአንቺ ይቈርጣሉ፥ ከአንቺም የቀረ በሰይፍ ይወድቃል፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም ማርከው ይወስዳሉ፥ ከአንቺም የቀረውን እሳት ትበላቸዋለች።

verses.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
verses.fr: Ils te dépouilleront de tes vêtements, Et ils enlèveront les ornements dont tu te pares.
verses.am: ልብስሽንም ይገፍፉሻል የክብርሽንም ጌጥ ይወስዳሉ።

verses.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
verses.fr: Je mettrai fin à tes crimes Et à tes prostitutions du pays d''Egypte; Tu ne porteras plus tes regards vers eux, Tu ne penseras plus à l''Egypte.
verses.am: ሴሰኝነትሽንም፥ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣሽውን ግልሙትናሽንም ከአንቺ አስቀራለሁ፤ ዓይንሽንም ወደ እነርሱ አታነሺም ግብጽንም ከዚያ ወዲያ አታስቢም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, je te livre entre les mains de ceux que tu hais, Entre les mains de ceux dont ton coeur s''est détaché.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ በጠላሻቸው እጅ፥ ነፍስሽ በተለየቻቸው እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጥሻለሁ፤

verses.en: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.fr: Ils te traiteront avec haine; Ils enlèveront toutes tes richesses, Et te laisseront nue, entièrement nue; La honte de tes impudicités sera découverte, De tes crimes et de tes prostitutions.
verses.am: እነርሱም በጥል ያደርጉብሻል፥ የደከምሽበትንም ሁሉ ይወስዳሉ፥ ዕራቁትሽንና ዕርቃንሽን አድርገውም ይተዉሻል፤ የግልሙትናሽም ነውር፥ ሴሰኝነትሽና ግልሙትናሽም ሁሉ ይገለጣል።

verses.en: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
verses.fr: Ces choses t''arriveront, Parce que tu t''es prostituée aux nations, Parce que tu t''es souillée par leurs idoles.
verses.am: ከአሕዛብ ጋር ስላመነዘርሽ በጣዖቶቻቸውም ስለ ረከስሽ ይህን ያደረጉብሻል።

verses.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
verses.fr: Tu as marché dans la voie de ta soeur, Et je mets sa coupe dans ta main.
verses.am: በእኅትሽ መንገድ ሄደሻል፤ ስለዚህ ጽዋዋን በእጅሽ እሰጥሻለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Tu boiras la coupe de ta soeur, Tu la boiras large et profonde; Elle te rendra un objet de risée et de moquerie; Elle contient beaucoup.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የጠለቀውንና የሰፋውን ብዙም የሚይዘውን የእኅትሽን ጽዋ ትጠጪአለሽ፤ መሳቂያና መሳለቂያም ትሆኛለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
verses.fr: Tu seras remplie d''ivresse et de douleur; C''est la coupe de désolation et de destruction, La coupe de ta soeur Samarie.
verses.am: በእኅትሽ በሰማርያ ጽዋ፥ በድንጋጤና በጥፋት ጽዋ፥ በስካርና በውርደት ትሞልያለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Tu la boiras, tu la videras, Tu la briseras en morceaux, Et tu te déchireras le sein. Car j''ai parlé, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ትጠጪዋለሽ ትጨልጪውማለሽ ገሉንም ታኝኪዋለሽ ጡትሽንም ትሸነትሪዋለሽ፤ እኔ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que tu m''as oublié, Parce que tu m''as rejeté derrière ton dos, Porte donc aussi la peine de tes crimes et de tes prostitutions.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዘንግተሽኛልና፥ ወደ ኋላሽም ጥለሽኛልና አንቺ ደግሞ ሴሰኝነትሽንና ግልሙትናሽን ተሸከሚ።

verses.en: The Lord said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Fils de l''homme, jugeras-tu Ohola et Oholiba? Déclare-leur leurs abominations!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በኦሖላና በኦሖሊባ ትፈርዳለህን? ኃጢአታቸውንም ታስታውቃቸዋለህ?

verses.en: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
verses.fr: Elles se sont livrées à l''adultère, et il y a du sang à leurs mains: Elles ont commis adultère avec leurs idoles; Et les enfants qu''elles m''avaient enfantés, Elles les ont fait passer par le feu Pour qu''ils leur servent d''aliment.
verses.am: አመንዝረዋልና፥ ደምም በእጃቸው አለና፥ ከጣዖቶቻቸውም ጋር አመንዝረዋልና፥ ለእኔም የወለዱአቸውን ልጆቻቸውን መብል እንዲሆኑላቸው በእሳት አሳልፈዋቸዋልና።

verses.en: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.fr: Voici encore ce qu''elles m''ont fait: Elles ont souillé mon sanctuaire dans le même jour, Et elles ont profané mes sabbats.
verses.am: ይህን ደግሞ አድርገውብኛል፤ በዚያ ቀን መቅደሴን አርክሰዋል ሰንበታቴንም ሽረዋል።

verses.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
verses.fr: Elles ont immolé leurs enfants à leurs idoles, Et elles sont allées le même jour dans mon sanctuaire, Pour le profaner. C''est là ce qu''elles ont fait dans ma maison.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውንም ለጣዖቶቻቸው በሠዉ ጊዜ፥ በዚያው ቀን ያረክሱት ዘንድ ወደ መቅደሴ ገቡ፤ እነሆም፥ በቤቴ ውስጥ እንደዚህ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
verses.fr: Et même elles ont fait chercher des hommes venant de loin, Elles leur ont envoyé des messagers, et voici, ils sont venus. Pour eux tu t''es lavée, tu as mis du fard à tes yeux, Tu t''es parée de tes ornements;
verses.am: ደግሞ መልእክተኛ ወደ ተላከባቸው ከሩቅም ወደሚመጡ ሰዎች ልካችኋል፤ እነሆም መጡ፥ አንቺም ታጠብሽላቸው ዓይኖችሽንም ተኳልሽ ጌጥም አጌጥሽ፤

verses.en: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
verses.fr: Tu t''es assise sur un lit magnifique, Devant lequel une table était dressée, Et tu as placé sur cette table mon encens et mon huile.
verses.am: በክብር አልጋ ላይ ተቀመጥሽ፥ በፊት ለፊትዋም ማዕድ ተዘጋጅታ ነበር፥ ዕጣኔንና ዘይቴንም አኖርሽባት።

verses.en: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
verses.fr: On entendait les cris d''une multitude joyeuse; Et parmi cette foule d''hommes On a fait venir du désert des Sabéens, Qui ont mis des bracelets aux mains des deux soeurs Et de superbes couronnes sur leurs têtes.
verses.am: የደስተኞችም ድምፅ በእርስዋ ዘንድ ነበረ፤ ከብዙም ሰዎች ጉባኤ ጋር ሰካራሞቹ ከምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ በእጃቸው አንበር በራሳቸውም የተዋበ አክሊል አደረጉ።

verses.en: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
verses.fr: Je dis alors au sujet de celle qui a vieilli dans l''adultère: Continuera-t-elle maintenant ses prostitutions, et viendra-t-on à elle?
verses.am: እኔም በምንዝር ላረጀችው። አሁን ከእርስዋ ጋር ያመነዝራሉ እርስዋም ከእነርሱ ጋር ታመነዝራለች አልሁ።

verses.en: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
verses.fr: Et l''on est venu vers elle comme l''on va chez une prostituée; C''est ainsi qu''on est allé vers Ohola et Oholiba, Ces femmes criminelles.
verses.am: ወደ ጋለሞታም እንደሚገቡ ወደ እርስዋ ገቡ፤ እንዲሁ ይሰስኑ ዘንድ ወደ ኦሖላና ወደ ኦሖሊባ ገቡ።

verses.en: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.fr: Mais des hommes justes les jugeront, Comme on juge les femmes adultères, Comme on juge celles qui répandent le sang; Car elles sont adultères, et il y a du sang à leurs mains.
verses.am: ሴቶቹ አመንዝሮች ናቸውና፥ በእጃቸውም ደም አለና ጻጽቃን ሰዎች በአመንዝሮቹና በደም አፍሳሾቹ ሴቶች ላይ በሚፈረደው ፍርድ ይፈርዱባቸዋል።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Je ferai monter contre elles une multitude, Et je les livrerai à la terreur et au pillage.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጉባኤን አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ለመበተንና ለመበዝበዝም አሳልፌ አሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.fr: Cette multitude les lapidera, Et les abattra à coups d''épée; On tuera leurs fils et leurs filles, On brûlera leurs maisons par le feu.
verses.am: ጉባኤውም በድንጋይ ይወግሩአቸዋል በሰይፋቸውም ይቈርጡአቸዋል፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ይገድላሉ፥ ቤቶቻቸውንም በእሳት ያቃጥላሉ።

verses.en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.fr: Je ferai cesser ainsi le crime dans le pays; Toutes les femmes recevront instruction, Et ne commettront pas de crime comme le vôtre.
verses.am: ሴቶችም ሁሉ እንደ ሴሰኝነታችሁ እንዳይሠሩ ይማሩ ዘንድ ሴሰኝነትን ከምድር ላይ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.fr: On fera retomber votre crime sur vous, Et vous porterez les péchés de vos idoles. Et vous saurez que je suis le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሴሰኝነታችሁንም በላያችሁ ላይ ይመልሳሉ፥ እናንተም የጣዖቶቻችሁን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La neuvième année, le dixième jour du dixième mois, la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, mets par écrit la date de ce jour, de ce jour-ci! Le roi de Babylone s''approche de Jérusalem en ce jour même.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የዚህን ቀን፥ የዛሬን ቀን ስም ጻፍ፤ በዚህ ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ቀረበ።

verses.en: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
verses.fr: Propose une parabole à la famille de rebelles, et dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Place, place la chaudière, et verses-y de l''eau.
verses.am: ለዓመፀኛውም ቤት ምሳሌን ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጣድ፥ ምንቸቲቱን ጣድ፥ ውኃም ጨምርባት።

verses.en: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
verses.fr: Mets-y les morceaux, tous les bons morceaux, la cuisse, l''épaule; remplis-la des meilleurs os.
verses.am: ቍራጭዋንም፥ መልካሙን ቍራጭ ሁሉ፥ ጭኑንና ወርቹን በእርስዋ ውስጥ ሰብስብ፥ የተመረጡትንም አጥንቶች ሙላባት።

verses.en: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
verses.fr: Choisis dans le troupeau, et entasse du bois sous la chaudière; fais bouillir à gros bouillons, et que les os qui sont dedans cuisent aussi.
verses.am: ከመንጋው የተመረጠውን ውሰድ፥ አጥንቶቹም እንዲበስሉ እንጨት በበታችዋ ማግድ፤ አጥንቶቹም በውስጥዋ ይቀቀሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Malheur à la ville sanguinaire, chaudière pleine de rouille, et dont la rouille ne se détache pas! Tires-en les morceaux les uns après les autres, sans recourir au sort.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዝገትዋ ላለባት ዝገትዋም ከእርስዋ ላልወጣ ምንቸት፥ ለደም ከተማ ወዮላት! ቍራጭ ቍራጩን አውጣ፤ ዕጣ አልወደቀባትም።

verses.en: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
verses.fr: Car le sang qu''elle a versé est au milieu d''elle; elle l''a mis sur le roc nu, elle ne l''a pas répandu sur la terre pour le couvrir de poussière.
verses.am: ደምዋ በውስጥዋ አለ። በተራቈተ ድንጋይ ላይ አደረገችው እንጂ በአፈር ይከደን ዘንድ በመሬት ላይ አላፈሰሰችውም፤

verses.en: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.fr: Afin de montrer ma fureur, afin de me venger, j''ai répandu son sang sur le roc nu, pour qu''il ne fût pas couvert.
verses.am: መዓቴን አወጣ ዘንድ፥ በቀሌንም እበቀል ዘንድ፥ ደምዋ እንዳይከደን በተራቈተ ድንጋይ ላይ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Malheur à la ville sanguinaire! Moi aussi je veux faire un grand bûcher.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለደም ከተማ ወዮላት! እኔ ደግሞ ማገዶዋን ታላቅ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
verses.fr: Entasse le bois, allume le feu, cuis bien la chair, assaisonne-la, et que les os soient brûlés.
verses.am: እንጨቱን አብዛ፤ እሳቱን አንድድ፤ ሥጋውን ቀቅል፤ መረቁን አጣፍጠው፤ አጥንቶቹ ይቃጠሉ።

verses.en: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
verses.fr: Puis mets la chaudière vide sur les charbons, afin qu''elle s''échauffe, que son airain devienne brûlant, que sa souillure se fonde au dedans, et que sa rouille se consume.
verses.am: ትሞቅም ዘንድ ናስዋም ትግል ዘንድ ርኵሰትዋም በውስጥዋ ይቀልጥ ዘንድ ዝገትዋም ይጠፋ ዘንድ ባዶዋን በፍም ላይ አድርጋት።

verses.en: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
verses.fr: Les efforts sont inutiles, la rouille dont elle est pleine ne se détache pas; la rouille ne s''en ira que par le feu.
verses.am: በከንቱ ደከመች፤ ሆኖም ዝገትዋ በእሳት ስንኳ አልለቀቀም።

verses.en: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
verses.fr: Le crime est dans ta souillure; parce que j''ai voulu te purifier et que tu n''es pas devenue pure, tu ne seras plus purifiée de ta souillure jusqu''à ce que j''aie assouvi sur toi ma fureur.
verses.am: በርኵሰትሽ ሴሰኝነት አለ፤ አነጻሁሽ አልነጻሽምና መዓቴን በላይሽ እስክጨርስ ድረስ እንግዲህ ከርኵሰትሽ አትነጺም።

verses.en: I the Lord have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé; cela arrivera, et je l''exécuterai; je ne reculerai pas, et je n''aurai ni pitié ni repentir. On te jugera selon ta conduite et selon tes actions, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ፤ ይመጣል፥ እኔም አደርገዋለሁ፤ አልመለስም፥ አልራራም፥ አልጸጸትም፤ እንደ መንገድሽና እንደ ሥራሽ ይፈርዱብሻል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Also the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, voici, je t''enlève par une mort soudaine ce qui fait les délices de tes yeux. Tu ne te lamenteras point, tu ne pleureras point, et tes larmes ne couleront pas.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ የዓይንህን አምሮት በመቅሠፍት እወስድብሃለሁ፤ አንተም ወይ አትበል አታልቅስም እንባህንም አታፍስስ።

verses.en: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
verses.fr: Soupire en silence, ne prends pas le deuil des morts, attache ton turban, mets ta chaussure à tes pieds, ne te couvre pas la barbe, et ne mange pas le pain des autres.
verses.am: በቀስታ ተክዝ፤ ለምዋቾችም አታልቅስ፥ መጠምጠሚያህን በራስህ ላይ አድርግ፥ ጫማህንም በእግርህ አጥልቅ፥ ከንፈሮችህንም አትሸፍን የሰዎችንም እንጀራ አትብላ።

verses.en: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.fr: J''avais parlé au peuple le matin, et ma femme mourut le soir. Le lendemain matin, je fis ce qui m''avait été ordonné.
verses.am: እኔም በማለዳ ለሕዝቡ ተናገርሁ፥ ወደ ማታም ሚስቴ ሞተች፤ በነጋውም እንደ ታዘዝሁ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
verses.fr: Le peuple me dit: Ne nous expliqueras-tu pas ce que signifie pour nous ce que tu fais?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። ይህ የምታደርገው ነገር ለእኛ ምን እንደ ሆነ አትነግረንምን? አሉኝ።

verses.en: Then I answered them, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Je leur répondis: La parole de l''Eternel m''a été adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: እኔም እንዲህ አልኋቸው። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
verses.fr: Dis à la maison d''Israël: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, je vais profaner mon sanctuaire, l''orgueil de votre force, les délices de vos yeux, l''objet de votre amour; et vos fils et vos filles que vous avez laissés tomberont par l''épée.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ቤት ተናገር እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የኃይላችሁን ትምክሕት፥ የዓይናችሁን አምሮት፥ የነፍሳችሁን ምኞት መቅደሴን አረክሳለሁ፤ ያስቀራችኋቸውም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.fr: Vous ferez alors comme j''ai fait. Vous ne vous couvrirez pas la barbe, vous ne mangerez pas le pain des autres,
verses.am: እኔም እንዳደረግሁ እናንተ ታደርጋላችሁ፤ ከንፈራችሁን አትሸፍኑም የሰዎችንም እንጀራ አትበሉም።

verses.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
verses.fr: vous aurez vos turbans sur la tête et vos chaussures aux pieds, vous ne vous lamenterez pas et vous ne pleurerez pas; mais vous serez frappés de langueur pour vos iniquités, et vous gémirez entre vous.
verses.am: መጠምጠሚያችሁም በራሳችሁ ጫማችሁም በእግራችሁ ይሆናል፤ ዋይ አትሉም አታለቅሱምም፤ በኃጢአታችሁም ትሰለስላላችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁም ታንጐራጕራላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.fr: Ezéchiel sera pour vous un signe. Vous ferez entièrement comme il a fait. Et quand ces choses arriveront, vous saurez que je suis le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሕዝቅኤልም ምልክት ይሆናችኋል፤ እርሱ እንዳደረገ ሁሉ እናንተ ታደርጋላችሁ፤ ይህም በመጣ ጊዜ እኔ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, le jour où je leur enlèverai ce qui fait leur force, leur joie et leur gloire, les délices de leurs yeux et l''objet de leur amour, leurs fils et leurs filles,
verses.am: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ኃይላቸውን፥ የተመኩበትንም ደስታ፥ የዓይናቸውን አምሮት፥ የነፍሳቸውንም ምኞት፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን በወሰድሁባቸው ቀን፥

verses.en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
verses.fr: ce jour-là un fuyard viendra vers toi pour l''annoncer à tes oreilles.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ያመለጠው ይህን ነገር በጆሮህ ያሰማ ዘንድ ወደ አንተ ይመጣል።

verses.en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: En ce jour, ta bouche s''ouvrira avec le fuyard, et tu parleras, tu ne seras plus muet; tu seras pour eux un signe, et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን አፍህ ላመለጠው ይከፈታል፥ አንተም ትናገራለህ ከዚያ ወዲያም ዲዳ አትሆንም፤ ምልክትም ትሆናቸዋለህ፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tourne ta face vers les enfants d''Ammon, Et prophétise contre eux!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ አሞን ልጆች አቅንተህ ትንቢት ተናገርባቸው።

verses.en: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
verses.fr: Tu diras aux enfants d''Ammon: Ecoutez la parole du Seigneur, de l''Eternel! Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que tu as dit: Ah! ah! Sur mon sanctuaire qui était profané, Sur la terre d''Israël qui était dévastée, Et sur la maison de Juda qui allait en captivité,
verses.am: ለአሞንም ልጆች እንዲህ በል። የጌታን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መቅደሴ በረከሰ ጊዜ የእስራኤልም ምድር ባድማ በሆነች ጊዜ የይሁዳም ቤት በተማረኩ ጊዜ ስለ እነርሱ እሰይ ብለሃልና

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
verses.fr: Voici, je te donne en possession aux fils de l''Orient; Ils établiront au milieu de toi leurs enclos, Et ils y placeront leurs demeures; Ils mangeront tes fruits, Ils boiront ton lait.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ርስት አድርጌ ለምሥራቅ ልጆች አሳልፌ አሰጥሃለሁ፥ እነርሱም በአንተ ውስጥ ይሰፍራሉ፥ ማደሪያዎቻቸውንም በአንተ ዘንድ ይሠራሉ፤ ፍሬህን ይበላሉ ወተትህንም ይጠጣሉ፤

verses.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couching place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Je ferai de Rabba un parc pour les chameaux, Et du pays des enfants d''Ammon un bercail pour les brebis. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአሞንን ከተማ ለግመሎች ማሰማርያ፥ የአሞንንም ልጆች ለመንጋ መመሰጊያ አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que tu as battu des mains Et frappé du pied, Parce que tu t''es réjoui dédaigneusement et du fond de l''âme Au sujet de la terre d''Israël,
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በእጅህ አጨብጭበሃልና፥ በእግርህም አሸብሽበሃልና፥ በእስራኤልም ምድር ላይ በነፍስህ ንቀት ሁሉ ደስ ብሎሃልና

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici, j''étends ma main sur toi, Et je te livre en proie aux nations; Je t''extermine du milieu des peuples, Je te retranche du nombre des pays, Je te détruis. Et tu sauras que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ እጄን ዘርግቼብሃለህ፥ ለአሕዛብም አስበዘብዝሃለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም ለይቼ እቈርጥሃለሁ፥ ከአገሮችም አጠፋሃለሁ እፈጅህማለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que Moab et Séir ont dit: Voici, la maison de Juda est comme toutes les nations!
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሞዓብና ሴይር። እነሆ፥ የይሁዳ ቤት እንደ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ነው ብለዋልና

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.fr: A cause de cela, voici, j''ouvre le territoire de Moab Du côté des villes, de ses villes frontières, L''ornement du pays, Beth-Jeschimoth, Baal-Meon et Kirjathaïm,
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሞዓብን ጫንቃ ከከተሞቹ፥ በዳርቻው ካሉት የምድሩ ትምክሕት ከሆኑት ከተሞቹ፥ ከቤትየሺሞት፥ ከበኣልሜዎን፥

verses.en: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.fr: Je l''ouvre aux fils de l''orient Qui marchent contre les enfants d''Ammon, Et je le leur donne en possession, Afin que les enfants d''Ammon ne soient plus comptés parmi les nations.
verses.am: ከቂርያታይም፥ ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለምሥራቅ ልጆች እከፍታለሁ። የአሞን ልጆች በአሕዛብ መካከል ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳይታሰቡ ርስት አድርጌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: J''exercerai mes jugements contre Moab. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሞዓብም ላይ ፍርድን አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce qu''Edom s''est livré à la vengeance Envers la maison de Juda, Parce qu''il s''est rendu coupable Et s''est vengé d''elle,
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ኤዶምያስ በይሁዳ ቤት ላይ በቀል አድርጎአልና፥ ቂም ይዞአልና፥ ብድራትንም አስከፍሎአልና

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: J''étends ma main sur Edom, J''en extermine les hommes et les bêtes, J''en fais un désert, de Théman à Dedan; Ils tomberont par l''épée.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እጄን በኤዶምያስ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ ከእርስዋም ዘንድ ሰውንና እንስሳን አጠፋለሁ፥ ከቴማንም ጀምሮ ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ፥ እስከ ድዳንም ድረስ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: J''exercerai ma vengeance sur Edom Par la main de mon peuple d''Israël; Il traitera Edom selon ma colère et ma fureur; Et ils reconnaîtront ma vengeance, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል እጅ ኤዶምያስን እበቀላለሁ፤ እንደ ቍጣዬና እንደ መዓቴም መጠን በኤዶምያስ ያደርጋሉ፤ በቀሌንም ያውቃሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que les Philistins se sont livrés à la vengeance, Parce qu''ils se sont vengés dédaigneusement et du fond de l''âme, Voulant tout détruire, dans leur haine éternelle,
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ፍልስጥኤማውያን በቀልን አድርገዋልና፥ በዘወትርም ጠላትነት ያጠፉ ዘንድ በነፍሳቸው ንቀት ተበቅለዋልና

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''étends ma main sur les Philistins, J''extermine les Kéréthiens, Et je détruis ce qui reste sur la côte de la mer.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እጄን በፍልስጥኤማውያን ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፥ ከሊታውያንንም እቈርጣለሁ፥ የባሕሩንም ዳር ቅሬታ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.fr: J''exercerai sur eux de grandes vengeances, En les châtiant avec fureur. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel, Quand j''exercerai sur eux ma vengeance.
verses.am: በመዓት መቅሠፍትም ታላቅ በቀል አደርግባቸዋለሁ፤ በቀሌንም በላያቸው ባደረግሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La onzième année, le premier jour du mois, la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በአሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ከወሩ በመጀመሪያው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, parce que Tyr a dit sur Jérusalem: Ah! ah! Elle est brisée, la porte des peuples! On se tourne vers moi, Je me remplirai, elle est déserte!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጢሮስ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ። እሰይ፥ የአሕዛብ በር የነበረች ተሰብራለች ወደ እኔም ተመልሳለች፤ እርስዋ ፈርሳለችና እኔ እሞላለሁ ብላለችና

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
verses.fr: A cause de cela, ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''en veux à toi, Tyr! Je ferai monter contre toi des nations nombreuses, Comme la mer fait monter ses flots.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጢሮስ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፥ ባሕርም ሞገድዋን እንደምታወጣ እንዲሁ ብዙ አሕዛብን አወጣብሻለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.fr: Elles détruiront les murs de Tyr, Elles abattront ses tours, Et j''en raclerai la poussière; Je ferai d''elle un rocher nu;
verses.am: የጢሮስንም ቅጥሮች ያጠፋሉ ግንቦችዋንም ያፈርሳሉ፤ ትቢያዋንም ከእርስዋ እፍቃለሁ፥ የተራቈተ ድንጋይም አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.fr: Elle sera dans la mer un lieu où l''on étendra les filets; Car j''ai parlé, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel. Elle sera la proie des nations.
verses.am: በባሕር ውስጥ የመረብ ማስጫ ትሆናለች፤ እኔ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለአሕዛብም ብዝበዛ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Ses filles sur son territoire Seront tuées par l''épée. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሜዳ ያሉትም ሴቶች ልጆችዋ በሰይፍ ይገደላሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''amène du septentrion contre Tyr Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, le roi des rois, avec des chevaux, des chars, des cavaliers, et une grande multitude de peuples.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን የነገሥታት ንጉሥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን ከፈረሶችና ከሰረገሎች ከፈረሰኞችም ከጉባኤና ከብዙ ሕዝብ ጋር በጢሮስ ላይ አመጣለሁ።

verses.en: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
verses.fr: Il tuera par l''épée tes filles sur ton territoire; il fera contre toi des retranchements, il élèvera contre toi des terrasses, et il dressera contre toi le bouclier.
verses.am: በሜዳ ያሉትን ሴቶች ልጆችሽን በሰይፍ ይገድላቸዋል፥ አምባም ይሠራብሻል አፈርንም ይደለድልብሻል ጋሻም ያነሣብሻል።

verses.en: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
verses.fr: Il dirigera les coups de son bélier contre tes murs, et il renversera tes tours avec ses machines.
verses.am: ማፍረሻውን በቅጥርሽ ላይ ያደርጋል፥ ግንቦችሽንም በምሳር ያፈርሳል።

verses.en: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.fr: La multitude de ses chevaux te couvrira de poussière; tes murs trembleront au bruit des cavaliers, des roues et des chars, lorsqu''il entrera dans tes portes comme on entre dans une ville conquise.
verses.am: ከፈረሶቹም ብዛት የተነሣ ትቢያቸው ይከድንሻል፤ ሰዎችም በተናደች ቅጥር ወደ ከተማ እንደሚገቡ እርሱ በበሮችሽ ሲገባ፥ ከፈረሰኞችና ከመንኰራኵሮች ከሰረገሎችም ድምፅ የተነሣ ቅጥርሽ ትናወጣለች።

verses.en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
verses.fr: Il foulera toutes tes rues avec les sabots de ses chevaux, il tuera ton peuple par l''épée, et les monuments de ton orgueil tomberont à terre.
verses.am: በፈረሶቹ ኮቴ ጎዳናዎችሽን ሁሉ ይረመርማል፥ ሕዝብሽንም በሰይፍ ይገድላል፥ የብርታትሽም ሐውልት ወደ ምድር ይወድቃል።

verses.en: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
verses.fr: On enlèvera tes richesses, on pillera tes marchandises, on abattra tes murs, on renversera tes maisons de plaisance, et l''on jettera au milieu des eaux tes pierres, ton bois, et ta poussière.
verses.am: ብልጥግናሽንም ይማርካሉ፥ ሸቀጥሽንም ይበዘብዛሉ፤ ቅጥርሽንም ያፈርሳሉ፥ ተድላ የምታደርጊባቸውን ቤቶችሽን ያጠፋሉ፤ ድንጋይሽንና እንጨትሽን መሬትሽንም በባሕር ውስጥ ይጥላሉ።

verses.en: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
verses.fr: Je ferai cesser le bruit de tes chants, et l''on n''entendra plus le son de tes harpes.
verses.am: የዘፋኞችሽንም ብዛት ዝም አሰኛለሁ፤ የመሰንቆሽም ድምፅ ከዚያ ወዲያ አይሰማም።

verses.en: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the Lord have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Je ferai de toi un rocher nu; tu seras un lieu où l''on étendra les filets; tu ne seras plus rebâtie. Car moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: የተራቈተ ድንጋይ አደርግሻለሁ የመረብም ማስጫ ትሆኛለሽ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትሠሪም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
verses.fr: Ainsi parle à Tyr le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Au bruit de ta chute, Quand les mourants gémissent, Quand le carnage est dans ton sein, Les îles tremblent.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጢሮስን እንዲህ ይላታል። የተወጉት ባንቋረሩ ጊዜ፥ በውስጥሽ እልቂት በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ከውድቀትሽ ድምፅ የተነሣ ደሴቶች ይነዋወጡ የለምን?

verses.en: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.
verses.fr: Tous les princes de la mer descendent de leurs trônes, Ils ôtent leurs manteaux, Et quittent leurs vêtements brodés; Ils s''enveloppent de frayeur, et s''asseyent sur la terre; A chaque instant l''épouvante les saisit, Et ils sont consternés à cause de toi.
verses.am: የባሕርም አለቆች ሁሉ ከዙፋኖቻቸው ይወርዳሉ፤ መጐናጸፊያቸውን ያወጣሉ ወርቀ ዘቦ ልብሳቸውንም ያወልቃሉ፤ መንቀጥቀጥን ለብሰው በመሬት ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ይንቀጠቀጣሉ በአንቺም ይደነቃሉ።

verses.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
verses.fr: Ils prononcent sur toi une complainte, et te disent: Eh quoi! tu es détruite, Toi que peuplaient ceux qui parcourent les mers, Ville célèbre, qui étais puissante sur la mer! Elle est détruite avec ses habitants, Qui inspiraient la terreur à tous ceux d''alentour!
verses.am: በአንቺም ላይ ሙሾ ያሞሻሉ፥ እንዲህም ይሉሻል። በባሕር የተቀመጥሽ በባሕርም ውስጥ የጸናሽ፥ ከሚቀመጡብሽም ጋር በዙሪያሽ የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ያስፈራሽ፥ የከበርሽ ከተማ ሆይ፥ እንዴት ጠፋሽ!

verses.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
verses.fr: Maintenant les îles tremblent au jour de ta chute, Les îles de la mer sont épouvantées de ta fin.
verses.am: አሁን በውድቀትሽ ቀን ደሴቶች ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፥ በባሕርም ውስጥ ያለ ደሴቶች ከመጥፋትሽ የተነሣ ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Quand je ferai de toi une ville déserte, Comme les villes qui n''ont point d''habitants, Quand je ferai monter contre toi l''abîme, Et que les grandes eaux te couvriront,
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰው እንደሌለባቸው ከተሞች ባድማ ከተማ ባደረግሁሽ ጊዜ፥ ቀላዩንም ባወጣሁብሽ ጊዜ ብዙ ውኆችም በከደኑሽ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
verses.fr: Je te précipiterai avec ceux qui sont descendus dans la fosse, Vers le peuple d''autrefois, Je te placerai dans les profondeurs de la terre, Dans les solitudes éternelles, Près de ceux qui sont descendus dans la fosse, Afin que tu ne sois plus habitée; Et je réserverai la gloire pour le pays des vivants.
verses.am: የቀድሞ ሕዝብ ወዳሉበት ወደ ጕድጓድ ከሚወርዱት ጋር አወርድሻለሁ፤ የሚኖርብሽም እንዳይገኝ ወደ ጕድጓድ ከሚወርዱ ጋር ቀድሞ በፈረሰችው ስፍራ፥ በታችኛይቱ ምድር አኖርሻለሁ፤ ጌጥሽንም በሕያዋን ምድር አላኖርም።

verses.en: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Je te réduirai au néant, et tu ne seras plus; On te cherchera, et l''on ne te trouvera plus jamais, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለድንጋጤ አደርግሻለሁ እንግዲህም አትኖሪም፤ ትፈለጊአለሽ ለዘላለምም አትገኚም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, Prononce sur Tyr une complainte!
verses.am: አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ስለ ጢሮስ ሙሾ አድርግ፥

verses.en: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord God; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.
verses.fr: Tu diras à Tyr: O toi qui es assise au bord de la mer, Et qui trafiques avec les peuples d''un grand nombre d''îles! Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Tyr, tu disais: Je suis parfaite en beauté!
verses.am: በባሕር መግቢያ የምትኖር በብዙም ደሴቶች ላይ ከሚኖሩ አሕዛብ ጋር ንግድን የምታደርግ ጢሮስንም እንዲህ በላት። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጢሮስ ሆይ፥ አንቺ። በውበት ፍጹም ነኝ ብለሻል።

verses.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
verses.fr: Ton territoire est au coeur des mers; Ceux qui t''ont bâtie t''ont rendue parfaite en beauté.
verses.am: ዳርቻሽ በባሕር ውስጥ ነው፤ ሠሪዎችሽ ውበትሽን ፈጽመዋል።

verses.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
verses.fr: Avec des cyprès de Senir ils ont fait tous tes lambris; Ils ont pris des cèdres du Liban pour t''élever un mât;
verses.am: ሳንቃዎችሽን ሁሉ ከሳኔር ጥድ ሠርተዋል፥ ደቀልንም ይሠሩልሽ ዘንድ ከሊባኖስ ዝግባ ወስደዋል።

verses.en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
verses.fr: Ils ont fabriqué tes rames avec des chênes de Basan, Et tes bancs avec de l''ivoire travaillé dans du buis, Et apporté des îles de Kittim.
verses.am: ከባሳን ኮምቦል መቅዘፊያሽን ሠርተዋል፥ በዝሆን ጥርስ ከታሻበ ከኪቲም ደሴቶች ዛፍ መቀመጫዎችሽን ሠርተዋል።

verses.en: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
verses.fr: Le fin lin d''Egypte avec des broderies Te servait de voiles et de pavillon; Des étoffes teintes en bleu et en pourpre des îles d''Elischa Formaient tes tentures.
verses.am: ዓላማ እንዲሆንልሽ ሸራሽ ከግብጽ በፍታና ከወርቅ ዘቦ ተሠርቶአል፥ መደረቢያሽም ከኤሊሳ ደሴቶች ሰማያዊና ቀይ ሐር ተሠርቶአል።

verses.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
verses.fr: Les habitants de Sidon et d''Arvad étaient tes rameurs, Et les plus experts du milieu de toi, ô Tyr, étaient tes pilotes.
verses.am: የሲዶናና የአራድ ሰዎች ቀዛፎችሽ ነበሩ፤ ጢሮስ ሆይ፥ ጥበበኞችሽ በአንቺ ዘንድ ነበሩ የመርከቦችሽም መሪዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
verses.fr: Les anciens de Guebal et ses ouvriers habiles étaient chez toi, Pour réparer tes fissures; Tous les navires de la mer et leurs mariniers étaient chez toi, Pour faire l''échange de tes marchandises.
verses.am: በአንቺ ውስጥ የነበሩ የጌባል ሽማግሌዎችና ጥበበኞችዋ ስብራትሽን ይጠግኑ ነበር፤ ከአንቺም ጋር ይነግዱ ዘንድ የባሕር መርከቦች ሁሉና መርከበኞቻቸው በመካከልሽ ነበሩ።

verses.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
verses.fr: Ceux de Perse, de Lud et de Puth, servaient dans ton armée, C''étaient des hommes de guerre; Ils suspendaient chez toi le bouclier et le casque, Ils te donnaient de la splendeur.
verses.am: ፋርስና ሉድ ፉጥም በሠራዊትሽ ሰልፈኞችሽ ነበሩ፤ ጋሻና ራስ ቍርም በአንቺ ውስጥ ያንጠለጥሉ ነበር፤ እነርሱም ውበትሽን ሰጡ።

verses.en: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Arvad et tes guerriers garnissaient tes murs, Et de vaillants hommes occupaient tes tours; Ils suspendaient leurs boucliers à tous tes murs, Ils rendaient ta beauté parfaite.
verses.am: የአራድ ሰዎችና ሠራዊቶችሽ በቅጥሮችሽ ላይ በዙሪያ ነበሩ፥ ገማዳውያንም በግንቦችሽ ውስጥ ነበሩ፤ ጋሻቸውንም በዙሪያ በቅጥርሽ ላይ አንጠለጠሉ፥ ውበትሽንም ፈጽመዋል።

verses.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
verses.fr: Ceux de Tarsis trafiquaient avec toi, A cause de tous les biens que tu avais en abondance; D''argent, de fer, d''étain et de plomb, Ils pourvoyaient tes marchés.
verses.am: ከብልጥግናሽ ሁሉ ብዛት የተነሣ ተርሴስ ነጋዴሽ ነበረች፤ በብርና በብረት በቈርቈሮና በእርሳስ ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
verses.fr: Javan, Tubal et Méschec trafiquaient avec toi; Ils donnaient des esclaves et des ustensiles d''airain En échange de tes marchandises.
verses.am: ያዋንና ቶቤል ሞሳሕም ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ የሰዎችን ነፍሳትና የናሱን ዕቃ ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
verses.fr: Ceux de la maison de Togarma Pourvoyaient tes marchés de chevaux, de cavaliers et de mulets.
verses.am: ከቴርጋማ ቤትም የነበሩት ሰዎች በፈረሶችና በፈረሰኞች በበቅሎዎችም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.fr: Les enfants de Dedan trafiquaient avec toi; Le commerce de beaucoup d''îles passait par tes mains; On te payait avec des cornes d''ivoire et de l''ébène.
verses.am: የድዳን ሰዎች ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ። ብዙ ደሴቶች የእጅሽ ገበያዎች ነበሩ፤ ይለውጡ ዘንድ የዝሆን ጥርስና ዞጲ አመጡልሽ።

verses.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
verses.fr: La Syrie trafiquait avec toi, A cause du grand nombre de tes produits; D''escarboucles, de pourpre, de broderies, De byssus, de corail et de rubis, Elle pourvoyait tes marchés.
verses.am: ከሥራሽ ብዛት የተነሣ ሶርያ ነጋዴሽ ነበረች በበሉርና በቀይ ሐር በወርቀ ዘቦም በጥሩ በፍታም በዛጐልም በቀይ ዕንቍም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.fr: Juda et le pays d''Israël trafiquaient avec toi; Ils donnaient le froment de Minnith, La pâtisserie, le miel, l''huile et le baume, En échange de tes marchandises.
verses.am: ይሁዳና የእስራኤል ምድር ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ የሚኒትን ስንዴ ጣፋጭም እንጐቻ፥ ማር ዘይትም በለሳንም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.fr: Damas trafiquait avec toi, A cause du grand nombre de tes produits, A cause de tous les biens que tu avais en abondance; Elle te fournissait du vin de Helbon et de la laine blanche.
verses.am: ከሥራሽ ብዛትና ከብልጥግናሽ ሁሉ ብዛት የተነሣ ደማስቆ ነጋዴሽ ነበረች፤ በኬልቦን የወይን ጠጅ በነጭም በግ ጠጕር ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
verses.fr: Vedan et Javan, depuis Uzal, Pourvoyaient tes marchés; Le fer travaillé, la casse et le roseau aromatique, Etaient échangés avec toi.
verses.am: ዌንዳንና ያዋን ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር፤ ከኦሴል የተሠራ ብረትና ብርጕድ ቀረፋም ሸቀጥሽ ነበረ።

verses.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
verses.fr: Dedan trafiquait avec toi En couvertures pour s''asseoir à cheval.
verses.am: ድዳን በከብት ላይ ለመቀመጥ በመረሻት ነጋዴሽ ነበረች።

verses.en: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.
verses.fr: L''Arabie et tous les princes de Kédar trafiquaient avec toi, Et faisaient le commerce en agneaux, en béliers et en boucs.
verses.am: ዓረብና የቄዳር አለቆች ሁሉ የእጅሽ ነጋዴዎች ነበሩ፤ በጠቦቶችና በአውራ በጎች በፍየሎችም በእነዚህ ከአንቺ ጋር ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.fr: Les marchands de Séba et de Raema trafiquaient avec toi; De tous les meilleurs aromates, De toute espèce de pierres précieuses et d''or, Ils pourvoyaient tes marchés.
verses.am: የሳባና የራዕማ ነጋዴዎች እነዚህ ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ በጥሩ ሽቶና በክብር ድንጋይ ሁሉ በወርቅም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
verses.fr: Charan, Canné et Eden, Les marchands de Séba, d''Assyrie, de Kilmad, Trafiquaient avec toi;
verses.am: ካራንና ካኔ ዔድንም ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ አሦርና ኪልማድ ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ።

verses.en: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
verses.fr: Ils trafiquaient avec toi en belles marchandises, En manteaux teints en bleu, en broderies, En riches étoffes contenues dans des coffres Attachés avec des cordes, faits en bois de cèdre, Et amenés sur tes marchés.
verses.am: እነዚህ ባማረ ልብስ በሰማያዊ ካባ በወርቀ ዘቦም፥ በዝግባ በተሠራች በገመድም በታሰረች በግምጃም በተሞላች ሳጥን በገበያሽ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.en: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.fr: Les navires de Tarsis naviguaient pour ton commerce; Tu étais au comble de la richesse et de la gloire, Au coeur des mers.
verses.am: የተርሴስ መርከቦች ሸቀጥሽን የሚሸከሙ ነበሩ፤ አንቺም ተሞልተሽ ነበር በባሕርም ውስጥ እጅግ ከበርሽ።

verses.en: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
verses.fr: Tes rameurs t''ont fait voguer sur les grandes eaux: Un vent d''orient t''a brisée au coeur des mers.
verses.am: ቀዛፊዎችሽ ወደ ትልቁ ወኃ አመጡሽ፤ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ በባሕር ውስጥ ሰበረሽ።

verses.en: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
verses.fr: Tes richesses, tes marchés et tes marchandises, Tes mariniers et tes pilotes, Ceux qui réparent tes fissures Et ceux qui s''occupent de ton commerce, Tous tes hommes de guerre qui sont chez toi Et toute la multitude qui est au milieu de toi Tomberont dans le coeur des mers, Au jour de ta chute.
verses.am: ብልጥግናሽና ሸቀጥሽ ንግድሽም መርከበኞችሽም መርከብ መሪዎችሽም ሰባራሽንም የሚጠግኑ ነጋዴዎችሽም በአንቺም ዘንድ ያሉ ሰልፈኞችሽ ሁሉ በውስጥሽ ካሉት ጉባኤ ሁሉ ጋር በወደቅሽበት ቀን በባሕር ውስጥ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
verses.fr: Aux cris de tes pilotes, Les plages d''alentour trembleront;
verses.am: ከመርከብ መሪዎች ጩኸት ድምፅ የተነሣ በዙሪያሽ ያሉ ሁሉ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ።

verses.en: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
verses.fr: Et tous ceux qui manient la rame descendront de leurs navires, Les mariniers, tous les pilotes de la mer. Ils se tiendront sur la terre;
verses.am: ቀዛፊዎችም ሁሉ መርከበኞችም መርከብ መሪዎችም ሁሉ ከመርከቦቻቸው ይወርዳሉ በመሬትም ላይ ይቆማሉ፤

verses.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.fr: Ils feront entendre leurs voix sur toi, Et pousseront des cris amers; Ils jetteront de la poussière sur leurs têtes Et se rouleront dans la cendre;
verses.am: ድምፃቸውንም በአንቺ ላይ ያሰማሉ፥ ምርር ብለውም ይጮኻሉ፥ በራሳቸውም ላይ ትቢያ ይነሰንሳሉ፥ በአመድም ውስጥ ይንከባለላሉ፤

verses.en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
verses.fr: Ils se raseront la tête à cause de toi, Ils se revêtiront de sacs, Et ils pleureront sur toi dans l''amertume de leur âme, Avec une vive affliction.
verses.am: ስለ አንቺም የራሳቸውን ጠጕር ይላጫሉ ማቅም ያሸርጣሉ በነፍስ ምሬትም ስለ አንቺ መራራ ልቅሶ ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.en: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.fr: Dans leur douleur, ils diront une complainte sur toi, Ils se lamenteront sur toi: Qui était comme Tyr, Comme cette ville détruite au milieu de la mer?
verses.am: በትካዜያቸውም ልቅሶ ያነሡልሻል፥ ስለ አንቺም ሙሾ ያሞሻሉ እንዲህም ይላሉ። በባሕር መካከል ጠፍቶ እንደ ቀረ እንደ ጢሮስ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
verses.fr: Quand tes produits sortaient des mers, Tu rassasiais un grand nombre de peuples; Par l''abondance de tes biens et de tes marchandises, Tu enrichissais les rois de la terre.
verses.am: ሸቀጥሽ ከባሕር በወጣ ጊዜ ብዙ አሕዛብን አጥግበሻል፤ በብልጥግናሽና በንግድሽ ብዛት የምድርን ነገሥታት ባለ ጠጎች አድርገሻል።

verses.en: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
verses.fr: Et quand tu as été brisée par les mers, Quand tu as disparu dans les profondeurs des eaux, Tes marchandises et toute ta multitude Sont tombées avec toi.
verses.am: አሁን ግን በጥልቅ ውኃ ውስጥ በባህር ተሰብረሻል ንግድሽና ጉባኤሽ ሁሉ በመካከልሽ ወድቀዋል።

verses.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
verses.fr: Tous les habitants des îles sont dans la stupeur à cause de toi, Leurs rois sont saisis d''épouvante, Leur visage est bouleversé.
verses.am: በደሴቶሽ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ተደንቀውብሻል፥ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም እጅግ ፈርተዋል ፊታቸውም ተለውጦአል።

verses.en: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
verses.fr: Les marchands parmi les peuples sifflent sur toi; Tu es réduite au néant, tu ne seras plus à jamais!
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ነጋዴዎች አፍዋጩብሽ፤ አንቺ ለድንጋጤ ሆነሻል፥ እስከ ዘላለምም አትገኚም።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord God; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, dis au prince de Tyr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Ton coeur s''est élevé, et tu as dit: Je suis Dieu, Je suis assis sur le siège de Dieu, au sein des mers! Toi, tu es homme et non Dieu, Et tu prends ta volonté pour la volonté de Dieu.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የጢሮስን ገዥ እንዲህ በለው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ልብህ ኰርቶአል አንተም። እኔ አምላክ ነኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ወንበር በባሕር መካከል ተቀምጫለሁ ብለሃል፤ ነገር ግን ልብህን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ልብ ብታደርግም አንተ ሰው ነህ እንጂ አምላክ አይደለህም።

verses.en: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
verses.fr: Voici, tu es plus sage que Daniel, Rien de secret n''est caché pour toi;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከዳንኤል ይልቅ ጥበበኛ ነህ፥ ምሥጢርም ሁሉ ከአንተ የተሸሸገ አይደለም።

verses.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
verses.fr: Par ta sagesse et par ton intelligence Tu t''es acquis des richesses, Tu as amassé de l''or et de l''argent Dans tes trésors;
verses.am: በጥበብህና በማስተዋልህ ብልጥግናን ለራስህ አግኝተሃል ወርቅና ብርም በግምጃ ቤትህ ውስጥ ሰብስበሃል።

verses.en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
verses.fr: Par ta grande sagesse et par ton commerce Tu as accru tes richesses, Et par tes richesses ton coeur s''est élevé.
verses.am: በታላቅ ጥበብህና በንግድህ ብልጥግናህን አብዝተሃል በብልጥግናህም ልብህ ኰርቶአል።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Parce que tu prends ta volonté pour la volonté de Dieu,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ልብህን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ልብ አድርገሃልና

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
verses.fr: Voici, je ferai venir contre toi des étrangers, Les plus violents d''entre les peuples; Ils tireront l''épée contre ton éclatante sagesse, Et ils souilleront ta beauté.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሌላ አገር ሰዎችን፥ የአሕዛብን ጨካኞች፥ አመጣብሃለሁ፤ ሰይፋቸውንም በጥበብህ ውበት ላይ ይመዝዛሉ ክብርህንም ያረክሳሉ።

verses.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
verses.fr: Ils te précipiteront dans la fosse, Et tu mourras comme ceux qui tombent percés de coups, Au milieu des mers.
verses.am: ወደ ጕድጓድ ያወርዱሃል፤ ተገድለው እንደ ሞቱ በባሕር ውስጥ ትሞታለህ።

verses.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
verses.fr: En face de ton meurtrier, diras-tu: Je suis Dieu? Tu seras homme et non Dieu Sous la main de celui qui te tuera.
verses.am: በውኑ በገዳይህ ፊት። እኔ አምላክ ነኝ ትላለህን? ነገር ግን በገዳይህ እጅ ሰው ነህ እንጂ አምላክ አይደለህም።

verses.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Tu mourras de la mort des incirconcis, Par la main des étrangers. Car moi, j''ai parlé, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእንግዶች እጅ ያልተገረዙትን ሰዎች ሞት ትሞታለህ፤ እኔ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, Prononce une complainte sur le roi de Tyr! Tu lui diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Tu mettais le sceau à la perfection, Tu étais plein de sagesse, parfait en beauté.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በጢሮስ ንጉሥ ላይ ሙሾ አሞሽተህ እንዲህ በለው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጥበብን የተሞላህ ውበትህም የተፈጸመ መደምደሚያ አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
verses.fr: Tu étais en Eden, le jardin de Dieu; Tu étais couvert de toute espèce de pierres précieuses, De sardoine, de topaze, de diamant, De chrysolithe, d''onyx, de jaspe, De saphir, d''escarboucle, d''émeraude, et d''or; Tes tambourins et tes flûtes étaient à ton service, Préparés pour le jour où tu fus créé.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ገነት በዔድን ነበርህ፤ የከበረ ዕንቍስ ሁሉ፥ ሰርድዮን፥ ቶጳዝዮን፥ አልማዝ፥ ቢረሌ፥ መረግድ፥ ኢያስጲድ፥ ሰንፔር፥ በሉር፥ የሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፥ ወርቅ፥ ልብስህ ነበረ፤ የከበሮህና የእንቢልታህ ሥራ በአንተ ዘንድ ነበረ፤ በተፈጠርህበት ቀን ተዘጋጅተው ነበር።

verses.en: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.fr: Tu étais un chérubin protecteur, aux ailes déployées; Je t''avais placé et tu étais sur la sainte montagne de Dieu; Tu marchais au milieu des pierres étincelantes.
verses.am: አንተ ልትጋርድ የተቀባህ ኪሩብ ነበርህ በተቀደሰው በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ላይ አኖርሁህ፤ በእሳት ድንጋዮች መካከል ተመላለስህ።

verses.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
verses.fr: Tu as été intègre dans tes voies, Depuis le jour où tu fus créé Jusqu''à celui où l''iniquité a été trouvée chez toi.
verses.am: ከተፈጠርህበት ቀን ጀምረህ በደል እስኪገኝብህ ድረስ በመንገድህ ፍጹም ነበርህ።

verses.en: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.fr: Par la grandeur de ton commerce Tu as été rempli de violence, et tu as péché; Je te précipite de la montagne de Dieu, Et je te fais disparaître, chérubin protecteur, Du milieu des pierres étincelantes.
verses.am: በንግድህ ብዛት ግፍ በውስጥህ ተሞላ ኃጢአትንም ሠራህ፤ ስለዚህ እንደ ርኩስ ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ጣልሁህ፤ የምትጋርድ ኪሩብ ሆይ፥ ከእሳት ድንጋዮች መካከል አጠፋሁህ።

verses.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
verses.fr: Ton coeur s''est élevé à cause de ta beauté, Tu as corrompu ta sagesse par ton éclat; Je te jette par terre, Je te livre en spectacle aux rois.
verses.am: በውበትህ ምክንያት ልብህ ኰርቶአል፤ ከክብርህ የተነሣ ጥበብህን አረከስህ፤ በምድር ላይ ጣልሁህ ያዩህም ዘንድ በነገሥታት ፊት ሰጠሁህ።

verses.en: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
verses.fr: Par la multitude de tes iniquités, Par l''injustice de ton commerce, Tu as profané tes sanctuaires; Je fais sortir du milieu de toi un feu qui te dévore, Je te réduis en cendre sur la terre, Aux yeux de tous ceux qui te regardent.
verses.am: በበደልህ ብዛት በንግድህም ኃጢአት መቅደስህን አረከስህ፤ ስለዚህ እሳትን ከውስጥህ አውጥቻለሁ እርስዋም በልታሃለች፥ በሚያዩህም ሁሉ ፊት በምድር ላይ አመድ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui te connaissent parmi les peuples Sont dans la stupeur à cause de toi; Tu es réduit au néant, tu ne seras plus à jamais!
verses.am: በአሕዛብም ውስጥ የሚያውቁህ ሁሉ ይደነቁብሃል፤ አንተም ለድንጋጤ ሆነሃል፥ እስከ ዘላለምም አትገኝም።

verses.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tourne ta face vers Sidon, Et prophétise contre elle!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ ሲዶና አቅንተህ ትንቢት ተናገርባት፥ እንዲህም በል።

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''en veux à toi, Sidon! Je serai glorifié au milieu de toi; Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel, Quand j''exercerai mes jugements contre elle, Quand je manifesterai ma sainteté au milieu d''elle.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሲዶና ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፥ በውስጥሽም እከብራለሁ፤ ፍርድንም ባደረግሁባት ጊዜ በተቀደስሁባትም ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: J''enverrai la peste dans son sein, Je ferai couler le sang dans ses rues; Les morts tomberont au milieu d''elle Par l''épée qui de toutes parts viendra la frapper. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ቸነፈርንም በእርስዋ ላይ፥ ደምንም በጎዳናዋ እሰድዳለሁ፤ ከዙሪያዋ በላይዋ ባለ ሰይፍ የተወጉ በመካከልዋ ይወድቃሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.fr: Alors elle ne sera plus pour la maison d''Israël Une épine qui blesse, une ronce déchirante, Parmi tous ceux qui l''entourent et qui la méprisent. Et ils sauront que je suis le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ ለእስራኤል ቤት የሚወጋ እሾህ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ካሉ ካናቋቸው ሁሉ የሚያቈስል ኵርንችት አይሆንም፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Lorsque je rassemblerai la maison d''Israël du milieu des peuples où elle est dispersée, je manifesterai en elle ma sainteté aux yeux des nations, et ils habiteront leur pays que j''ai donné à mon serviteur Jacob.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤልን ቤት ከተበተኑባቸው አሕዛብ ዘንድ በሰበሰብሁ ጊዜ፥ በአሕዛብም ፊት በተቀደስሁባቸው ጊዜ፥ ለባሪያዬ ለያዕቆብ በሰጠኋት ምድራቸው ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the Lord their God.
verses.fr: Ils y habiteront en sécurité, et ils bâtiront des maisons et planteront des vignes; ils y habiteront en sécurité, quand j''exercerai mes jugements contre tous ceux qui les entourent et qui les méprisent. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel, leur Dieu.
verses.am: ተዘልለውም ይቀመጡባታል፤ ቤቶችንም ይሠራሉ ወይኑንም ይተክላሉ በዙሪያቸውም ባሉ በሚንቋቸው ሁሉ ላይ ፍርድን ባደረግሁ ጊዜ ተዘልለው ይቀመጣሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La dixième année, le douzième jour du dixième mois, la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: በአሥረኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tourne ta face vers Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, Et prophétise contre lui et contre toute l''Egypte!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን በግብጽ ንጉሥ በፈርዖን ላይ አድርግ፥ በእርሱና በግብጽ ሁሉ ላይም ትንቢት ተናገር፥

verses.en: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
verses.fr: Parle, et tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''en veux à toi, Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, Grand crocodile, qui te couches au milieu de tes fleuves, Et qui dis: Mon fleuve est à moi, c''est moi qui l''ai fait!
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በወንዞች መካከል የምትተኛና። ወንዙ የእኔ ነው ለራሴም ሠርቼዋለሁ የምትል ታላቅ አዞ፥ የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ።

verses.en: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
verses.fr: Je mettrai une boucle à tes mâchoires, J''attacherai à tes écailles les poissons de tes fleuves, Et je te tirerai du milieu de tes fleuves, Avec tous les poissons qui s''y trouvent Et qui seront attachés à tes écailles.
verses.am: በመንጋጋህ መቃጥን አገባብሃለሁ፥ የወንዞችህንም ዓሦች ወደ ቅርፊትህ አጣብቃለሁ፤ ከወንዞችህም መካከል አወጣሃለሁ፥ የወንዞችህም ዓሦች ሁሉ ወደ ቅርፊትህ ይጣበቃሉ።

verses.en: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
verses.fr: Je te jetterai dans le désert, Toi et tous les poissons de tes fleuves. Tu tomberas sur la face des champs, Tu ne seras ni relevé ni ramassé; Aux bêtes de la terre et aux oiseaux du ciel Je te donnerai pour pâture.
verses.am: አንተንና የወንዞችህን ዓሦች ሁሉ ወደ ምድረ በዳ እጥላለሁ፥ በምድርም ፊት ላይ ትወድቃለህ እንጂ አትከማችም አትሰበሰብም መብልም አድርጌ ለምድር አራዊትና ለሰማይ ወፎች ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the Lord, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Et tous les habitants de l''Egypte sauront que je suis l''Eternel, Parce qu''ils ont été un soutien de roseau pour la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: በግብጽም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ቤት የሸንበቆ በትር ሆነዋልና እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils t''ont pris dans la main, tu t''es rompu, Et tu leur as déchiré toute l''épaule; Lorsqu''ils se sont appuyés sur toi, tu t''es brisé, Et tu as rendu leurs reins immobiles.
verses.am: በእጅ በያዙህ ጊዜ ተሰበርህ ጫንቃቸውንም ሁሉ አቈሰልህ፤ በተደገፉብህም ጊዜ ተሰበርህ ወገባቸውንም ሁሉ አንቀጠቀጥህ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, je ferai venir contre toi l''épée, Et j''exterminerai du milieu de toi les hommes et les bêtes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሰይፍ አመጣብሃለሁ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳንም ከአንተ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the Lord: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
verses.fr: Le pays d''Egypte deviendra une solitude et un désert. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel, Parce qu''il a dit: Le fleuve est à moi, c''est moi qui l''ai fait!
verses.am: የግብጽም ምድር ባድማና ውድማ ትሆናለች፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ አንተ። ወንዙ የእኔ ነው የሠራሁትም እኔ ነኝ ብለሃልና።

verses.en: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, j''en veux à toi et à tes fleuves, Et je ferai du pays d''Egypte un désert et une solitude, Depuis Migdol jusqu''à Syène et aux frontières de l''Ethiopie.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንተና በወንዞችህ ላይ ነኝ፥ የግብጽንም ምድር ከሚግዶል ጀምሮ እስከ ሴዌኔና እስከ ኢትዮጵያ ዳርቻ ድረስ ውድማና ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.en: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
verses.fr: Nul pied d''homme n''y passera, Nul pied d''animal n''y passera, Et il restera quarante ans sans être habité.
verses.am: የሰው እግር አያልፍባትም የእንስሳም ኮቴ አያልፍባትም፥ እስከ አርባ ዓመትም ድረስ ማንም አይኖርባትም።

verses.en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.fr: Je ferai du pays d''Egypte une solitude entre les pays dévastés, Et ses villes seront désertes entre les villes désertes, Pendant quarante ans. Je répandrai les Egyptiens parmi les nations, Je les disperserai en divers pays.
verses.am: ባድማም በሆኑ ምድሮች መካከል የግብጽን ምድር ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ፥ በፈረሱትም ከተሞች መካከል ከተሞችዋ አርባ ዓመደ ፈርሰው ይቀመጣሉ፤ ግብጻውያንንም ወደ አሕዛብ እበትናቸዋለሁ በአገሮችም እዘራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Yet thus saith the Lord God; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Au bout de quarante ans je rassemblerai les Egyptiens Du milieu des peuples où ils auront été dispersés.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከአርባ ዓመት በኋላ ግብጻውያንን ከተበተኑባቸው አሕዛብ ዘንድ እሰበስባለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
verses.fr: Je ramènerai les captifs de l''Egypte, Je les ramènerai dans le pays de Pathros, Dans le pays de leur origine, Et là ils formeront un faible royaume.
verses.am: የግብጽንም ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ወደ ተወለዱባትም ምድር ወደ ጳትሮስ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ በዚያም የተዋረደች መንግሥት ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
verses.fr: Ce sera le moindre des royaumes, Et il ne s''élèvera plus au-dessus des nations, Je les diminuerai, afin qu''ils ne dominent pas sur les nations.
verses.am: ከሌሎች መንግሥታት ሁሉ ይልቅ የተዋረደች ትሆናለች፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ በአሕዛብ ላይ ከፍ አትልም፤ በአሕዛብም ላይ እንዳይገዙ አሳንሳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.fr: Ce royaume ne sera plus pour la maison d''Israël un sujet de confiance; Il lui rappellera son iniquité, quand elle se tournait vers eux. Et ils sauront que je suis le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት እነርሱን በተከተሉ ጊዜ እርስዋ በደልን ታሳስባለች፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ መታመኛ አትሆንላቸውም፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La vingt-septième année, le premier jour du premier mois, la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሀያ ሰባተኛው ዓመት በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, A fait faire à son armée un service pénible contre Tyr; Toutes les têtes sont chauves, toutes les épaules sont écorchées; Et il n''a retiré de Tyr aucun salaire, ni lui, ni son armée, Pour le service qu''il a fait contre elle.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ሠራዊቱን በጢሮስ ላይ ጽኑ አገልግሎት አስገለገለ፤ ራስ ሁሉ የተላጨ ጫንቃም ሁሉ የተላጠ ሆኖአል፤ ነገር ግን በላይዋ ስላገለገለው አገልግሎት እርሱና ሠራዊቱ ደመወዝ ከጢሮስ አልተቀበሉም።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, je donne à Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, Le pays d''Egypte; Il en emportera les richesses, Il en prendra les dépouilles, Il en pillera le butin; Ce sera un salaire pour son armée.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የግብጽን ምድር ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እሰጠዋለሁ፥ ብዛትዋንም ይወስዳል ምርኮዋንም ይማርካል ብዝበዛዋንም ይበዘብዛል፤ ይህም ለሠራዊቱ ደመወዝ ይሆናል።

verses.en: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Pour prix du service qu''il a fait contre Tyr, Je lui donne le pays d''Egypte; Car ils ont travaillé pour moi, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለ እኔ ሠርተዋልና ስለ አገልግሎቱ ደመወዝ የግብጽን ምድር ሰጥቼዋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, je donnerai de la force à la maison d''Israël, Et je t''ouvrirai la bouche au milieu d''eux; Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ለእስራኤል ቤት ቀንድን አበቅላለሁ፥ በመካከላቸውም ለአንተ የተከፈተ አፍን እሰጣለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, prophétise, et dis: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Gémissez!... Malheureux jour!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ትንቢት ተናገር እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዋይ! በሉ፥ ለቀኑ ወዮ! ቀኑ ቅርብ ነው፥

verses.en: For the day is near, even the day of the Lord is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
verses.fr: Car le jour approche, le jour de l''Eternel approche, Jour ténébreux: ce sera le temps des nations.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቅርብ ነው፥ የደመና ቀን፥ የአሕዛብ ጊዜ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
verses.fr: L''épée fondra sur l''Egypte, Et l''épouvante sera dans l''Ethiopie, Quand les morts tomberont en Egypte, Quand on enlèvera ses richesses, Et que ses fondements seront renversés.
verses.am: ሰይፍ በግብጽ ላይ ይመጣል፥ ሁከትም በኢትዮጵያ ይሆናል፤ የተገደሉትም በግብጽ ውስጥ ይወድቃሉ፥ ብዛትዋንም ይወስዳሉ፥ መሠረትዋም ይፈርሳል።

verses.en: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
verses.fr: L''Ethiopie, Puth, Lud, toute l''Arabie, Cub, Et les fils du pays allié, Tomberont avec eux par l''épée.
verses.am: ኢትዮጵያና ፉጥ ሉድም የተደባለቀም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ኩብም ቃል ኪዳንም የገባችው ምድር ልጆች ከእነርሱ ጋር በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Ils tomberont, les soutiens de l''Egypte, Et l''orgueil de sa force périra; De Migdol à Syène ils tomberont par l''épée, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ግብጽን የሚደግፉ ይወድቃሉ፥ የኃይልዋም ትዕቢት ይወርዳል፤ ከሚግዶል ጀምሮ እስከ ሴዌኔ ድረስ በእርስዋ ውስጥ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
verses.fr: Ils seront dévastés entre les pays dévastés, Et ses villes seront entre les villes désertes.
verses.am: ባድማም በሆኑ አገሮች መካከል ባድማ ይሆናሉ፥ ከተሞችዋም በፈረሱ ከተሞች መካከል ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
verses.fr: Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel, Quand je mettrai le feu dans l''Egypte, Et que tous ses soutiens seront brisés.
verses.am: እሳትንም በግብጽ ባነደድሁ ጊዜ ረዳቶችዋም ሁሉ በተሰበሩ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, des messagers iront de ma part sur des navires Troubler l''Ethiopie dans sa sécurité; Et l''épouvante sera parmi eux au jour de l''Egypte, Car voici, ces choses arrivent!
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን መልእክተኞች ተዘልለው የሚኖሩትን ኢትዮጵያውያንን ለማስፈራት ከፊቴ በመርከብ ይወጣሉ፤ እንደ ግብጽም ቀን ሁከት ይሆንባቸዋል፤ እነሆ፥ ይመጣልና።
