verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከኃጢአታችሁ ሁሉ ባነጻኋችሁበት ቀን በከተሞች ሰዎችን አኖራለሁ ባድማዎቹም ስፍራዎች ይሠራሉ።

verses.en: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.fr: la terre dévastée sera cultivée, tandis qu''elle était déserte aux yeux de tous les passants;
verses.am: ባድማ የነበረች በመንገደኛም ሁሉ ዓይን ዘንድ ባድማ የነበረች ምድር ትታረሳለች።

verses.en: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
verses.fr: et l''on dira: Cette terre dévastée est devenue comme un jardin d''Eden; et ces villes ruinées, désertes et abattues, sont fortifiées et habitées.
verses.am: ሰዎችም። ባድማ የነበረች ይህች ምድር እንደ ዔድን ገነት ሆናለች፤ የፈረሱት ባድማ የሆኑት የጠፉትም ከተሞች ተመሽገዋል ሰውም የሚኖርባቸው ሆነዋል ይላሉ።

verses.en: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the Lord build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.fr: Et les nations qui resteront autour de vous sauront que moi, l''Eternel, j''ai rebâti ce qui était abattu, et planté ce qui était dévasté. Moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé, et j''agirai.
verses.am: በዙሪያችሁም የቀሩት አሕዛብ እኔ እግዚአብሔር የፈረሱትን ስፍራዎች እንደ ሠራሁ ውድማ የሆነውንም እንደ ተከልሁ ያውቃሉ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ፥ እኔም አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici encore sur quoi je me laisserai fléchir par la maison d''Israël, voici ce que je ferai pour eux; je multiplierai les hommes comme un troupeau.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለዚህ ደግሞ አደርግላቸው ዘንድ የእስራኤል ቤት ይሹኛል ሰውንም እንደ መንጋ አበዛላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Les villes en ruines seront remplies de troupeaux d''hommes, pareils aux troupeaux consacrés, aux troupeaux qu''on amène à Jérusalem pendant ses fêtes solennelles. Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ ተቀደሱ በጎች፥ በበዓላቶችዋ ቀን እንደሚሆኑ እንደ ኢየሩሳሌም በጎች፥ እንዲሁ የፈለሱት ከተሞች በሰዎች መንጋ ይሞላሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
verses.fr: La main de l''Eternel fut sur moi, et l''Eternel me transporta en esprit, et me déposa dans le milieu d''une vallée remplie d''ossements.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ በላዬ ነበረ እግዚአብሔርም በመንፈሱ አወጣኝ አጥንቶችም በሞሉባት ሸለቆ መካከል አኖረኝ።

verses.en: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.fr: Il me fit passer auprès d''eux, tout autour; et voici, ils étaient fort nombreux, à la surface de la vallée, et ils étaient complètement secs.
verses.am: በእነርሱም አንጻር በዙሪያቸው አሳለፈኝ፤ እነሆም፥ በሸለቆው ፊት እጅግ ብዙ ነበሩ፥ እነሆም፥ እጅግ ደርቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord God, thou knowest.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Fils de l''homme, ces os pourront-ils revivre? Je répondis: Seigneur Eternel, tu le sais.
verses.am: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ አጥንቶች በሕይወት ይኖራሉን? አለኝ። እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አንተ ታውቃለህ አልሁ።

verses.en: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Prophétise sur ces os, et dis-leur: Ossements desséchés, écoutez la parole de l''Eternel!
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። በእነዚህ አጥንቶች ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። እናንተ የደረቃችሁ አጥንቶች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel, à ces os: Voici, je vais faire entrer en vous un esprit, et vous vivrez;
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለእነዚህ አጥንቶች እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ትንፋሽን አገባባችኋለሁ በሕይወትም ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.en: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: je vous donnerai des nerfs, je ferai croître sur vous de la chair, je vous couvrirai de peau, je mettrai en vous un esprit, et vous vivrez. Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጅማትም እሰጣችኋለሁ ሥጋንም አወጣባችኋለሁ በእናንተም ላይ ቁርበትን እዘረጋለሁ ትንፋሽንም አገባባችኋለሁ በሕይወትም ትኖራላችሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verses.fr: Je prophétisai, selon l''ordre que j''avais reçu. Et comme je prophétisais, il y eut un bruit, et voici, il se fit un mouvement, et les os s''approchèrent les uns des autres.
verses.am: እንዳዘዘኝም ትንቢት ተናገርሁ፤ ስናገርም ድምፅ ሆነ፥ እነሆም፥ መናወጥ ሆነ፥ አጥንቶችም አጥንት ከአጥንት ጋር ተቀራረቡ።

verses.en: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
verses.fr: Je regardai, et voici, il leur vint des nerfs, la chair crût, et la peau les couvrit par-dessus; mais il n''y avait point en eux d''esprit.
verses.am: እኔም አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ጅማት ነበረባቸው ሥጋም ወጣ ቁርበትም በላያቸው ተዘረጋ፥ ትንፋሽ ግን አልነበረባቸውም።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord God; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Prophétise, et parle à l''esprit! prophétise, fils de l''homme, et dis à l''esprit: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Esprit, viens des quatre vents, souffle sur ces morts, et qu''ils revivent!
verses.am: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ትንቢት ተናገር፥ ለነፋስ ትንቢት ተናገር፥ ለነፋስም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ነፋስ ሆይ፥ ከአራቱ ነፋሳት ዘንድ ና፥ እነዚህም የተገደሉት በሕይወት ይኖሩ ዘንድ እፍ በልባቸው በል አለኝ።

verses.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
verses.fr: Je prophétisai, selon l''ordre qu''il m''avait donné. Et l''esprit entra en eux, et ils reprirent vie, et ils se tinrent sur leurs pieds: c''était une armée nombreuse, très nombreuse.
verses.am: እንዳዘዘኝም ትንቢት ተናገርሁ፥ ትንፋሽም ገባባቸው ሕያዋንም ሆኑ፥ እጅግም ታላቅ ሠራዊት ሆነው በእግራቸው ቆሙ።

verses.en: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Fils de l''homme, ces os, c''est toute la maison d''Israël. Voici, ils disent: Nos os sont desséchés, notre espérance est détruite, nous sommes perdus!
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ አጥንቶች የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ናቸው፤ እነሆ። አጥንቶቻችን ደርቀዋል ተስፋችንም ጠፍቶአል ፈጽመንም ተቈርጠናል ብለዋል።

verses.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.fr: Prophétise donc, et dis-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''ouvrirai vos sépulcres, je vous ferai sortir de vos sépulcres, ô mon peuple, et je vous ramènerai dans le pays d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ትንቢት ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ መቃብራችሁን እከፍታለሁ ከመቃብራችሁም አወጣችኋለሁ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ምድር አገባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
verses.fr: Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel, lorsque j''ouvrirai vos sépulcres, et que je vous ferai sortir de vos sépulcres, ô mon peuple!
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ መቃብራችሁን በከፈትሁ ጊዜ ከመቃብራችሁም ባወጣኋችሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the Lord have spoken it, and performed it, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je mettrai mon esprit en vous, et vous vivrez; je vous rétablirai dans votre pays, et vous saurez que moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé et agi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: መንፈሴንም በውስጣችሁ አሳድራለሁ፥ እናንተም በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ፥ በገዛ ምድራችሁም አኖራችኋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገርሁ እንዳደረግሁም ታውቃላችሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim and for all the house of Israel his companions:
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, prends une pièce de bois, et écris dessus: Pour Juda et pour les enfants d''Israël qui lui sont associés. Prends une autre pièce de bois, et écris dessus: Pour Joseph, bois d''Ephraïm et de toute la maison d''Israël qui lui est associée.
verses.am: አንተ፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ አንድ በትር ውሰድና። ለይሁዳና ለባልንጀሮቹ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ብለህ በላዩ ጻፍ፤ ሌላም በትር ውሰድና። የኤፍሬም በትር ለዮሴፍና ለባልንጀሮቹ ለእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ብለህ በላዩ ጻፍ።

verses.en: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
verses.fr: Rapproche-les l''une et l''autre pour en former une seule pièce, en sorte qu''elles soient unies dans ta main.
verses.am: አንድ በትርም እንዲሆኑ አንዱን ከሁለተኛው ጋር ለአንተ አጋጥም፥ በእጅህም ውስጥ አንድ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
verses.fr: Et lorsque les enfants de ton peuple te diront: Ne nous expliqueras-tu pas ce que cela signifie?
verses.am: የሕዝብህም ልጆች። ይህ የምታደርገው ነገር ምን ማለት እንደሆነ አትነግረንምን? ብለው በተናገሩህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
verses.fr: réponds-leur: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, je prendrai le bois de Joseph qui est dans la main d''Ephraïm, et les tribus d''Israël qui lui sont associées; je les joindrai au bois de Juda, et j''en formerai un seul bois, en sorte qu''ils ne soient qu''un dans ma main.
verses.am: አንተ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በኤፍሬም እጅ ያለውን የዮሴፍን በትር ባልንጀሮቹንም የእስራኤልን ነገዶች እወስዳለሁ፥ ከእርሱም ከይሁዳ በትር ጋር አጋጥማቸዋለሁ አንድ በትርም አደርጋቸዋለሁ፥ በእጄም ውስጥ አንድ ይሆናሉ በላቸው።

verses.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
verses.fr: Les bois sur lesquels tu écriras seront dans ta main, sous leurs yeux.
verses.am: የምትጽፍባቸውም በትሮች በዓይናቸው ፊት በእጅህ ውስጥ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
verses.fr: Et tu leur diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, je prendrai les enfants d''Israël du milieu des nations où ils sont allés, je les rassemblerai de toutes parts, et je les ramènerai dans leur pays.
verses.am: አንተም እንዲህ ትላቸዋለህ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከሄዱባቸው ከአሕዛብ መካከል እወስዳለሁ ከስፍራም ሁሉ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ ወደ ገዛ ምድራቸውም አመጣቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
verses.fr: Je ferai d''eux une seule nation dans le pays, dans les montagnes d''Israël; ils auront tous un même roi, ils ne formeront plus deux nations, et ne seront plus divisés en deux royaumes.
verses.am: በምድርም ላይ በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ አንድ ሕዝብ አደርጋቸዋለሁ፥ አንድ ንጉሥም በሁላቸው ላይ ይነግሣል፤ ከዚያ ወዲያ ሁለት ሕዝብ አይሆኑም፥ ከዚያ ወዲያም ሁለት መንግሥቶች ሆነው አይለዩም።

verses.en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.fr: Ils ne se souilleront plus par leurs idoles, par leurs abominations, et par toutes leurs transgressions; je les retirerai de tous les lieux qu''ils ont habités et où ils ont péché, et je les purifierai; ils seront mon peuple, et je serai leur Dieu.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያም በጣዖቶቻቸውና በርኵሰታቸው በመተላለፋቸውም ሁሉ አይረክሱም፥ ኃጢአትም ከሠሩባት ዓመፅ ሁሉ አድናቸዋለሁ አነጻቸውማለሁ፤ ሕዝብም ይሆኑኛል እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
verses.fr: Mon serviteur David sera leur roi, et ils auront tous un seul pasteur. Ils suivront mes ordonnances, ils observeront mes lois et les mettront en pratique.
verses.am: ባሪያዬም ዳዊት ንጉሥ ይሆናቸዋል፤ ለሁሉም አንድ እረኛ ይሆንላቸዋል፤ በፍርዴም ይሄዳሉ ትእዛዜንም ይጠብቃሉ ያደርጓትማል።

verses.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.
verses.fr: Ils habiteront le pays que j''ai donné à mon serviteur Jacob, et qu''ont habité vos pères; ils y habiteront, eux, leurs enfants, et les enfants de leurs enfants, à perpétuité; et mon serviteur David sera leur prince pour toujours.
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁም በኖሩበት ለባሪያዬ ለያዕቆብ በሰጠኋት ምድር ይኖራሉ፤ እነርሱና ልጆቻቸው የልጅ ልጆቻቸውም ለዘላለም ይኖሩባታል፤ ባሪያዬም ዳዊት ለዘላለም አለቃ ይሆናቸዋል።

verses.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.fr: Je traiterai avec eux une alliance de paix, et il y aura une alliance éternelle avec eux; je les établirai, je les multiplierai, et je placerai mon sanctuaire au milieu d''eux pour toujours.
verses.am: የሰላምም ቃል ኪዳን ከእነርሱ ጋር አደርጋለሁ፥ የዘላለምም ቃል ኪዳን ይሆንላቸዋል፤ እኔም እባርካቸዋለሁ አበዛቸውማለሁ መቅደሴንም ለዘላለም በመካከላቸው አኖራለሁ።

verses.en: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.fr: Ma demeure sera parmi eux; je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront mon peuple.
verses.am: ማደሪያዬም በላያቸው ላይ ይሆናል፤ እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል።

verses.en: And the heathen shall know that I the Lord do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.fr: Et les nations sauront que je suis l''Eternel, qui sanctifie Israël, lorsque mon sanctuaire sera pour toujours au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: መቅደሴም ለዘላለም በመካከላቸው በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እስራኤልን የምቀድሰው እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ አሕዛብ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.fr: Fils de l''homme, tourne ta face vers Gog, au pays de Magog, Vers le prince de Rosch, de Méschec et de Tubal, Et prophétise contre lui!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን በጎግ ላይና በማጎግ ምድር ላይ፥ በሞሳሕና በቶቤል ዋነኛ አለቃ ላይ አቅናበት፥ ትንቢትም ተናገርበት፥

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''en veux à toi, Gog, Prince de Rosch, de Méschec et de Tubal!
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሞሳሕና የቶቢል ዋነኛ አለቃ ጎግ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ።

verses.en: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:
verses.fr: Je t''entraînerai, et je mettrai une boucle à tes mâchoires; Je te ferai sortir, toi et toute ton armée, Chevaux et cavaliers, Tous vêtus magnifiquement, Troupe nombreuse portant le grand et le petit bouclier, Tous maniant l''épée;
verses.am: እመልስህማለሁ በመንጋጋህም ልጓም አገባብሃለሁ፥ አንተንና ሠራዊትህንም ሁሉ፥ ፈረሶችንና ፈረሰኞችን የጦር ልብስ የለበሱትን ሁሉ፥ ጋሻና ራስ ቍርን ሰይፍንም ያያዙትን ሁሉ፥ ታላቁን ወገን አወጣለሁ፥

verses.en: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
verses.fr: Et avec eux ceux de Perse, d''Ethiopie et de Puth, Tous portant le bouclier et le casque;
verses.am: ፋርስንና ኢትዮጵያን ፉጥንም ከእነርሱ ጋር ጋሻና የራስ ቍርን የለበሱትን ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.
verses.fr: Gomer et toutes ses troupes, La maison de Togarma, A l''extrémité du septentrion, Et toutes ses troupes, Peuples nombreux qui sont avec toi.
verses.am: ጋሜርንና ጭፍሮቹን ሁሉ፥ በሰሜን ዳርቻም ያለውን የቴርጋማን ቤትና ጭፍሮቹን ሁሉ፥ ብዙዎችንም ሕዝቦች ከአንተ ጋር አወጣለሁ።

verses.en: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.
verses.fr: Prépare-toi, tiens-toi prêt, Toi, et toute ta multitude assemblée autour de toi! Sois leur chef!
verses.am: አንተና ወደ አንተ የተሰበሰቡ ወገኖችህ ሁሉ ተዘጋጁ፥ አንተም ራስህን አዘጋጅተህ አለቃ ሁናቸው።

verses.en: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.
verses.fr: Après bien des jours, tu seras à leur tête; Dans la suite des années, tu marcheras contre le pays Dont les habitants, échappés à l''épée, Auront été rassemblés d''entre plusieurs peuples Sur les montagnes d''Israël longtemps désertes; Retirés du milieu des peuples, Ils seront tous en sécurité dans leurs demeures.
verses.am: ከብዙ ዘመንም በኋላ ትፈለጋለህ፤ በኋለኛውም ዘመን፥ የዘላለም ባድማ በነበሩ በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ ከብዙ ሕዝብ ውስጥ ወደ ተሰበሰበች፥ ከሰይፍ ወደ ተመለሰች ምድር ትገባለህ፤ እርስዋም ከሕዝብ ውስጥ ወጥታለች ሁሉም ሳይፈሩ ይቀመጡባታል።

verses.en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.
verses.fr: Tu monteras, tu t''avanceras comme une tempête, Tu seras comme une nuée qui va couvrir le pays, Toi et toutes tes troupes, et les nombreux peuples avec toi.
verses.am: አንተም ትወጣለህ፥ እንደ ዐወሎ ነፋስም ትመጣለህ፤ አንተና ጭፍሮችህ ሁሉ ከአንተም ጋር ብዙ ሕዝብ ምድርን እንደ ደመና ትሸፍናላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: En ce jour-là, des pensées s''élèveront dans ton coeur, Et tu formeras de mauvais desseins.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚያ ቀን ነገር ወደ ልብህ ይገባል፥

verses.en: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
verses.fr: Tu diras: Je monterai contre un pays ouvert, Je fondrai sur des hommes tranquilles, En sécurité dans leurs demeures, Tous dans des habitations sans murailles, Et n''ayant ni verrous ni portes;
verses.am: ክፉ አሳብንም ታስባለህ፥ እንዲህም ትላለህ። ቅጥርን ወደሌላቸው መንደሮች እወጣለሁ፤ ተዘልለው ወደሚኖሩ፥ ሁላቸው ሳይፈሩ ያለ ቅጥርና ያለ መወርወሪያ ያለ መዝጊያም ወደሚቀመጡ እገባለሁ፤

verses.en: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.
verses.fr: J''irai faire du butin et me livrer au pillage, Porter la main sur des ruines maintenant habitées, Sur un peuple recueilli du milieu des nations, Ayant des troupeaux et des propriétés, Et occupant les lieux élevés du pays.
verses.am: ምርኮን ትማርክ ዘንድ ብዝበዛንም ትበዘብዝ ዘንድ፥ ባድማም በነበሩ አሁንም ሰዎች በሚኖሩባቸው ስፍራዎች ላይ፥ ከአሕዛብም በተሰበሰበ፥ ከብትና ዕቃንም ባገኘ፥ በምድርም መካከል በተቀመጠ ሕዝብ ላይ እጅህን ትዘረጋ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?
verses.fr: Séba et Dedan, les marchands de Tarsis, Et tous leurs lionceaux, te diront: Viens-tu pour faire du butin? Est-ce pour piller que tu as rassemblé ta multitude, Pour emporter de l''argent et de l''or, Pour prendre des troupeaux et des biens, Pour faire un grand butin?
verses.am: ሳባና ድዳን የተርሴስም ነጋዴዎች መንደሮችዋም ሁሉ። ምርኮን ትማርክ ዘንድ መጥተሃልን? ብዝበዛንስ ትበዘብዝ ዘንድ ብርንና ወርቅንስ ትወስድ ዘንድ ከብትንና ዕቃንስ ትወስድ ዘንድ እጅግስ ብዙ ምርኮ ትማርክ ዘንድ ወገንህን ሰብስበሃልን? ይሉሃል።

verses.en: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord God; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi prophétise, fils de l''homme, et dis à Gog: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Oui, le jour où mon peuple d''Israël vivra en sécurité, Tu le sauras.
verses.am: አንተ፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ትንቢት ተናገር ጎግንም እንዲህ በለው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚያ ቀን ሕዝቤ እስራኤል ሳይፈራ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ አንተ አታውቀውምን?

verses.en: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:
verses.fr: Alors tu partiras de ton pays, des extrémités du septentrion, Toi et de nombreux peuples avec toi, Tous montés sur des chevaux, Une grande multitude, une armée puissante.
verses.am: አንተም፥ ከአንተም ጋር ብዙ ሕዝብ ሁላቸው በፈረሶች ላይ የተቀመጡ፥ ታላቅ ወገንና ብርቱ ሠራዊት፥ ከሰሜን ዳርቻ ከስፍራችሁ ትመጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.
verses.fr: Tu t''avanceras contre mon peuple d''Israël, Comme une nuée qui va couvrir le pays. Dans la suite des jours, je te ferai marcher contre mon pays, Afin que les nations me connaissent, Quand je serai sanctifié par toi sous leurs yeux, ô Gog!
verses.am: ምድርንም ትሸፍን ዘንድ እንደ ደመና በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ ትወጣለህ። በኋለኛው ዘመን ይሆናል፥ ጎግ ሆይ፥ በዓይናቸው ፊት በተቀደስሁብህ ጊዜ አሕዛብ ያውቁኝ ዘንድ በምድሬ ላይ አመጣሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Est-ce toi de qui j''ai parlé jadis Par mes serviteurs les prophètes d''Israël, Qui ont prophétisé alors, pendant des années, Que je t''amènerais contre eux?
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእነርሱ ላይ እንደማመጣህ በዚያች ዘመን ብዙ ዓመት ትንቢት በተናገሩ በባሪያዎቼ በእስራኤል ነቢያቶች በቀደመው ዘመን ስለ እርሱ የተናገርሁ አንተ ነህን?

verses.en: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord God, that my fury shall come up in my face.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, le jour où Gog marchera contre la terre d''Israël, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, La fureur me montera dans les narines.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ጎግ በእስራኤል ምድር ላይ በመጣ ጊዜ መቅሠፍቴ በመዓቴ ይመጣል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
verses.fr: Je le déclare, dans ma jalousie et dans le feu de ma colère, En ce jour-là, il y aura un grand tumulte Dans le pays d''Israël.
verses.am: በቅንዓቴና በመዓቴ እሳት ተናግሬአለሁ። በእርግጥ በዚያ ቀን በእስራኤል ምድር ጽኑ መናወጥ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
verses.fr: Les poissons de la mer et les oiseaux du ciel trembleront devant moi, Et les bêtes des champs et tous les reptiles qui rampent sur la terre, Et tous les hommes qui sont à la surface de la terre; Les montagnes seront renversées, Les parois des rochers s''écrouleront, Et toutes les murailles tomberont par terre.
verses.am: ከፊቴም የተነሣ የባሕር ዓሣዎችና የሰማይ ወፎች የምድረ በዳም አራዊት በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ በምድርም ላይ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፥ ተራሮችም ይገለባበጣሉ ገደላገደሎችም ይወድቃሉ ቅጥርም ሁሉ ወደ ምድር ይወድቃል።

verses.en: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord God: every man's sword shall be against his brother.
verses.fr: J''appellerai l''épée contre lui sur toutes mes montagnes, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel; L''épée de chacun se tournera contre son frère.
verses.am: በተራሮቼም ሁሉ በእርሱ ላይ ሰይፍን እጠራለሁ፥ የሰውም ሁሉ ሰይፍ በወንድሙ ላይ ይሆናል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
verses.fr: J''exercerai mes jugements contre lui par la peste et par le sang, Par une pluie violente et par des pierres de grêle; Je ferai pleuvoir le feu et le soufre sur lui et sur ses troupes, Et sur les peuples nombreux qui seront avec lui.
verses.am: በቸነፈርና በደም እፈርድበታለሁ፤ ዶፍም የበረዶም ድንጋይ እሳትና ድኝም በእርሱና በጭፍሮቹ ከእርሱም ጋር ባሉ በብዙ ሕዝብ ላይ አዘንባለሁ።

verses.en: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Je manifesterai ma grandeur et ma sainteté, Je me ferai connaître aux yeux de la multitude des nations, Et elles sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ታላቅ እሆናለሁ እቀደስማለሁ በብዙ አሕዛብም ዓይን የታወቅሁ እሆናለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, prophétise contre Gog! Tu diras: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''en veux à toi, Gog, Prince de Rosch, de Méschec et de Tubal!
verses.am: አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በጎግ ላይ ትንቢትን ተናገር እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሞሳሕና የቶቤል ዋነኛ አለቃ ጎግ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፤

verses.en: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
verses.fr: Je t''entraînerai, je te conduirai, Je te ferai monter des extrémités du septentrion, Et je t''amènerai sur les montagnes d''Israël.
verses.am: እመልስሃለሁ፥ እነዳህማለሁ፥ ከሰሜንም ዳርቻ እጐትትሃለሁ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ተራሮች አመጣሃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
verses.fr: J''abattrai ton arc de ta main gauche, Et je ferai tomber tes flèches de ta main droite.
verses.am: ከግራ እጅህም ቀስትህን አስጥልሃለሁ፥ ከቀኝ እጅህም ፍላጾችህን አስረግፍሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
verses.fr: Tu tomberas sur les montagnes d''Israël, Toi et toutes tes troupes, Et les peuples qui seront avec toi; Aux oiseaux de proie, à tout ce qui a des ailes, Et aux bêtes des champs je te donnerai pour pâture.
verses.am: አንተና ጭፍሮችህ ሁሉ ከአንተም ጋር ያሉ ሕዝብ በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ ትወድቃላችሁ፤ ለሚናጠቁ ወፎች ሁሉና ለምድር አራዊትም መብል አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Tu tomberas sur la face de la terre, Car j''ai parlé, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: አንተ በምድር ፊት ላይ ትወድቃለህ፤ እኔ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: J''enverrai le feu dans Magog, Et parmi ceux qui habitent en sécurité les îles; Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በማጎግም ላይ ሳይፈሩም በደሴቶች በሚቀመጡ ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.
verses.fr: Je ferai connaître mon saint nom au milieu de mon peuple d''Israël, Et je ne laisserai plus profaner mon saint nom; Et les nations sauront que je suis l''Eternel, Le Saint en Israël.
verses.am: ቅዱሱም ስሜ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል መካከል ይታወቅ ዘንድ አደርጋለሁ፥ ቅዱሱንም ስሜን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አላስረክስም፤ አሕዛብም እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord God; this is the day whereof I have spoken.
verses.fr: Voici, ces choses viennent, elles arrivent, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel; C''est le jour dont j''ai parlé.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይመጣል ይሆንማል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ያልሁት ቀን ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
verses.fr: Alors les habitants des villes d''Israël sortiront, Ils brûleront et livreront aux flammes les armes, Les petits et les grands boucliers, Les arcs et les flèches, Les piques et les lances; Ils en feront du feu pendant sept ans.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ከተሞች የሚኖሩ ይወጣሉ፥ የጦር መሣሪያዎችንም በእሳት ያቃጥላሉ፤ አላባሽ ጋሻንና ጋሻን፥ ቀስትንና ፍላጻዎችን፥ ጎመድንና ጦርንም ያቃጥላሉ፤ ሰባት ዓመት በእሳት ያቃጥሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Ils ne prendront point de bois dans les champs, Et ils n''en couperont point dans les forêts, Car c''est avec les armes qu''ils feront du feu. Ils dépouilleront ceux qui les ont dépouillés, Ils pilleront ceux qui les ont pillés, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በጦር መሣሪያው እሳትን ያነድዳሉ እንጂ እንጨትን ከምድረ በዳ አይወስዱም ከዱርም አይቈርጡም፤ የገፈፉአቸውንም ይገፍፋሉ የበዘበዙአቸውንም ይበዘብዛሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamongog.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Je donnerai à Gog un lieu qui lui servira de sépulcre en Israël, La vallée des voyageurs, à l''orient de la mer; Ce sépulcre fermera le passage aux voyageurs. C''est là qu''on enterrera Gog et toute sa multitude, Et on appellera cette vallée la vallée de la multitude de Gog.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በእስራኤል ዘንድ በባሕር ምሥራቅ የሚያልፉበትን ሸለቆ የመቃብርን ስፍራ ለጎግ እሰጣለሁ፥ የሚያልፉትንም ይከለክላል፤ በዚያም ጎግንና ብዛቱን ሁሉ ይቀብራሉ፤ የሸለቆውንም ስም ሐሞንጎግ ብለው ይጠሩታል።

verses.en: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
verses.fr: La maison d''Israël les enterrera, Afin de purifier le pays; Et cela durera sept mois.
verses.am: ምድሩንም ያጸዱ ዘንድ የእስራኤል ቤት ሰዎች ሰባት ወር ይቀብሩአቸዋል፥

verses.en: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple du pays les enterrera, Et il en aura du renom, Le jour où je serai glorifié, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: የምድርም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይቀብሩአቸዋል፥ በተመሰገንሁበትም ቀን ለክብር ይሆንላችኋል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
verses.fr: Ils choisiront des hommes qui seront sans cesse à parcourir le pays, Et qui enterreront, avec l''aide des voyageurs, Les corps restés à la surface de la terre; Ils purifieront le pays, Et ils seront à la recherche pendant sept mois entiers.
verses.am: ምድርንም ለማጽዳት በምድሩ ላይ ወድቀው የቀሩትን የሚቀብሩ፥ ዘወትር በምድሩ ላይ የሚዞሩትን ሰዎች ይቀጥራሉ፤ ከሰባት ወርም በኋላ ይመረምራሉ።

verses.en: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamongog.
verses.fr: Ils parcourront le pays; Et quand l''un d''eux verra les ossements d''un homme, Il mettra près de là un signe, Jusqu''à ce que les fossoyeurs l''enterrent Dans la vallée de la multitude de Gog.
verses.am: በምድርም የሚዞሩት ያልፋሉ፤ የሰውንም አጥንት ቢያዩ፥ ቀባሪዎች በሐሞን ጎግ ሸለቆ እስኪቀብሩት ድረስ ምልክት ያኖሩበታል።

verses.en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
verses.fr: Il y aura aussi une ville appelée Hamona. C''est ainsi qu''on purifiera le pays.
verses.am: ደግሞም የከተማይቱ ስም ሐሞና ይባላል። እንዲሁ ምድሪቱን ያጸዳሉ።

verses.en: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.
verses.fr: Et toi, fils de l''homme, ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Dis aux oiseaux, à tout ce qui a des ailes, Et à toutes les bêtes des champs: Réunissez-vous, venez, rassemblez-vous de toutes parts, Pour le sacrifice où j''immole pour vous des victimes, Grand sacrifice sur les montagnes d''Israël! Vous mangerez de la chair, et vous boirez du sang.
verses.am: አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለወፎች ሁሉና ለምድር አራዊት ሁሉ እንዲህ በላቸው። ኑ፥ ተከማቹ፥ ሥጋንም ትበሉ ዘንድ ደምንም ትጠጡ ዘንድ በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ ወደማርድላችሁ መሥዋዕት፥ እርሱም ታላቅ መሥዋዕት፥ ከየስፍራው ሁሉ ተሰብሰቡ።

verses.en: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez la chair des héros, Et vous boirez le sang des princes de la terre, Béliers, agneaux, boucs, Taureaux engraissés sur le Basan.
verses.am: የኃያላኑን ሥጋ ትበላላችሁ የምድርንም አለቆች፥ የአውራ በጎችንና የጠቦቶችን፥ የፍየሎችንና የወይፈኖችን፥ የባሳንን ፍሪዳዎች ሁሉ፥ ደም ትጠጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez de la graisse jusqu''à vous en rassasier, Et vous boirez du sang jusqu''à vous enivrer, A ce festin de victimes que j''immolerai pour vous.
verses.am: እኔም ከማርድላችሁ መሥዋዕት እስክትጠግቡ ድረስ ጮማ ትበላላችሁ እስክትሰክሩም ድረስ ደም ትጠጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Vous vous rassasierez à ma table de la chair des chevaux et des cavaliers, De la chair des héros et de tous les hommes de guerre, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሰደቃዬም ከፈረሶችና ከፈረሰኞች፥ ከኃያላንና ከሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ትጠግባላችሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
verses.fr: Je manifesterai ma gloire parmi les nations; Et toutes les nations verront les jugements que j''exercerai, Et les châtiments dont ma main les frappera.
verses.am: ክብሬንም በአሕዛብ መካከል አኖራለሁ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ያደርግሁትን ፍርዴን፥ በላያቸውም ያኖርኋትን እጄን ያያሉ።

verses.en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God from that day and forward.
verses.fr: La maison d''Israël saura que je suis l''Eternel, son Dieu, Dès ce jour et à l''avenir.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ የእስራኤል ቤት እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.
verses.fr: Et les nations sauront que c''est à cause de ses iniquités Que la maison d''Israël a été conduite en captivité, A cause de ses infidélités envers moi; Aussi je leur ai caché ma face, Et je les ai livrés entre les mains de leurs ennemis, Afin qu''ils périssent tous par l''épée.
verses.am: አሕዛብም የእስራኤል ቤት በኃጢአታቸው ምክንያት እንደ ተማረኩ ያውቃሉ፤ ስለ በደሉኝ እኔም ፊቴን ከእነርሱ ስለ ሸሸግሁ፥ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጠኋቸው፥ እነርሱም ሁሉ በሰይፍ ወደቁ።

verses.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.
verses.fr: Je les ai traités selon leurs souillures et leurs transgressions, Et je leur ai caché ma face.
verses.am: እንደ ርኵሰታቸውም እንደ መተላለፋቸውም መጠን አደረግሁባቸው ፊቴንም ከእነርሱ ሸሸግሁ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Maintenant je ramènerai les captifs de Jacob, J''aurai pitié de toute la maison d''Israël, Et je serai jaloux de mon saint nom.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አሁን የያዕቆብን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ ለእስራኤልም ቤት ሁሉ እራራለሁ፥ ስለ ቅዱስ ስሜም እቀናለሁ።

verses.en: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.
verses.fr: Alors ils oublieront leur opprobre, Et toutes les infidélités qu''ils ont commises envers moi, Lorsqu''ils habitaient en sécurité leur pays, Et qu''il n''y avait personne pour les troubler.
verses.am: እኔም ወደ አሕዛብ አስማርኬአቸዋለሁና፥ ወደ ገዛ ምድራቸውም ሰብስቤአቸዋለሁና እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ በዚያም ከእነርሱ አንድ ሰው ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ አልተውም፥

verses.en: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
verses.fr: Quand je les ramènerai d''entre les peuples, Quand je les rassemblerai du pays de leurs ennemis, Je serai sanctifié par eux aux yeux de beaucoup de nations.
verses.am: እኔም ወደ አሕዛብ አስማርኬአቸዋለሁና፥ ወደ ገዛ ምድራቸውም ሰብስቤአቸዋለሁና እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ በዚያም ከእነርሱ አንድ ሰው ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ አልተውም፥

verses.en: Then shall they know that I am the Lord their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
verses.fr: Et ils sauront que je suis l''Eternel, leur Dieu, Qui les avait emmenés captifs parmi les nations, Et qui les rassemble dans leur pays; Je ne laisserai chez elles aucun d''eux,
verses.am: ፊቴንም ከእነርሱ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አልሸሽግም፤ መንፈሴን በእስራኤል ቤት ላይ አፍስሻለሁና፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Et je ne leur cacherai plus ma face, Car je répandrai mon esprit sur la maison d''Israël, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፤ ፊቴንም ከእነርሱ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አልሸሽግም፤ መንፈሴን በእስራኤል ቤት ላይ አፍስሻለሁና፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the Lord was upon me, and brought me thither.
verses.fr: La vingt-cinquième année de notre captivité, au commencement de l''année, le dixième jour du mois, quatorze ans après la ruine de la ville, en ce même jour, la main de l''Eternel fut sur moi, et il me transporta
verses.am: በተማረክን በሀያ አምስተኛው ዓመት በዓመቱ መጀመሪያ ከወሩ በአሥረኛው ቀን፥ ከተማይቱ ከተመታች በኋላ በአሥራ አራተኛው ዓመት፥ በዚያው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በእኔ ላይ ነበረ እርሱም ወደዚያ ወሰደኝ።

verses.en: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.
verses.fr: dans le pays d''Israël. Il m''y transporta, dans des visions divines, et me déposa sur une montagne très élevée, où se trouvait au midi comme une ville construite.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ራእይ ወደ እስራኤል ምድር አመጣኝ እጅግም በረዘመ ተራራ ላይ አኖረኝ፥ በዚያም ላይ በደቡብ ወገን እንደ ከተማ ሆኖ የተሠራ ነገር ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit là; et voici, il y avait un homme dont l''aspect était comme l''aspect de l''airain; il avait dans la main un cordeau de lin et une canne pour mesurer, et il se tenait à la porte.
verses.am: ወደዚያም አመጣኝ፥ እነሆም፥ መልኩ እንደ ናስ መልክ የመሰለ አንድ ሰው በዚያ ነበረ፥ በእጁም የተልባ እግር ገመድና የመለኪያ ዘንግ ነበረ፤ እርሱም በበሩ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Cet homme me dit: Fils de l''homme, regarde de tes yeux, et écoute de tes oreilles! Applique ton attention à toutes les choses que je te montrerai, car tu as été amené ici afin que je te les montre. Fais connaître à la maison d''Israël tout ce que tu verras.
verses.am: ሰውዬውም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ይህን አሳይህ ዘንድ አንተ ወደዚህ ተመርተሃልና በዓይንህ እይ በጆሮህም ስማ በማሳይህም ሁሉ ላይ ልብህን አድርግ፤ የምታየውንም ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ቤት ንገር አለኝ።

verses.en: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
verses.fr: Voici, un mur extérieur entourait la maison de tous côtés. Dans la main de l''homme était une canne de six coudées pour mesurer, chaque coudée ayant un palme de plus que la coudée ordinaire. Il mesura la largeur du mur, qui était d''une canne, et la hauteur, qui était d''une canne.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በቤቱ ውጭ በዙሪያው ቅጥር ነበረ፥ በሰውዬውም እጅ የክንዱ ልክ አንድ ክንድ ከጋት የሆነ ስድስት ክንድ ያለበት የመለኪያ ዘንግ ነበረ፤ የቅጥሩንም ስፋት አንድ ዘንግ ቁመቱንም አንድ ዘንግ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.
verses.fr: Il alla vers la porte orientale, et il en monta les degrés. Il mesura le seuil de la porte, qui avait une canne en largeur, et l''autre seuil, qui avait une canne en largeur.
verses.am: ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደሚመለከተውም በር መጣ በደረጃዎቹም ላይ ወጣ፥ በበሩ በኩል ያለውንም የመድረኩን ወለል ወርዱን አንድ ዘንግ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.
verses.fr: Chaque chambre était longue d''une canne, et large d''une canne. Il y avait entre les chambres un espace de cinq coudées. Le seuil de la porte, près du vestibule de la porte, à l''intérieur, avait une canne.
verses.am: የዘበኛውም ጓዳ ሁሉ ርዝመቱ አንድ ዘንግ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ዘንግ ነበረ፤ በዘበኛውም ጓዳዎች መካከል አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፤ በበሩም ደጀ ሰላም በስተ ውስጥ በኩል የሚገኝ የበሩ የመድረክ ወለል አንድ ዘንግ ነበረ።

verses.en: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
verses.fr: Il mesura le vestibule de la porte, à l''intérieur; il avait une canne.
verses.am: በስተ ውስጥም ያለውን የበሩን ደጀ ሰላም አንድ ዘንግ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
verses.fr: Il mesura le vestibule de la porte; il avait huit coudées, et ses poteaux en avaient deux; le vestibule de la porte était en dedans.
verses.am: የበሩንም ደጀ ሰላም ስምንት ክንድ፥ የግንቡንም አዕማድ ወርድ ሁለት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ የበሩም ደጀ ሰላም በስተ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
verses.fr: Les chambres de la porte orientale étaient au nombre de trois d''un côté et de trois de l''autre; toutes les trois avaient la même mesure, et les poteaux de chaque côté avaient aussi la même mesure.
verses.am: የምሥራቁም በር የዘበኛ ጓዳዎች በዚህ በኩል ሦስት በዚያም በኩል ሦስት ነበሩ፥ ለሦስቱም አንድ ልክ ነበረ፤ የግንቡም አዕማድ ወርድ በዚህ በኩልና በዚያ በኩል አንድ ልክ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
verses.fr: Il mesura la largeur de l''ouverture de la porte, qui était de dix coudées, et la hauteur de la porte, qui était de treize coudées.
verses.am: የበሩንም መግቢያ ወርድ አሥር ክንድ የበሩንም ርዝመት አሥራ ሦስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
verses.fr: Il y avait devant les chambres un espace d''une coudée de chaque côté et d''autre; chaque chambre avait six coudées d''un côté, et six coudées de l''autre.
verses.am: በዘበኛ ጓዳዎችም ፊት በዚህ በኩል አንድ ክንድ በዚያም በኩል አንድ ክንድ የሆነ ዳርቻ ነበረ፤ የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹም በዚህ በኩል ስድስት ክንድ በዚያም በኩል ስድስት ክንድ ነበሩ።

verses.en: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
verses.fr: Il mesura la porte depuis le toit d''une chambre jusqu''au toit de l''autre; il y avait une largeur de vingt-cinq coudées entre les deux ouvertures opposées.
verses.am: ከአንዱም የዘበኛ ጓዳ ደርብ ጀምሮ እስከ ሌላው ደርብ ድረስ የበሩን ወርድ ሀያ አምስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ መዝጊያውና መዝጊያውም ትይዩ ነበረ።

verses.en: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
verses.fr: Il compta soixante coudées pour les poteaux, près desquels était une cour, autour de la porte.
verses.am: ደጀ ሰላሙንም ሀያ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ በበሩም ደጀ ሰላም ዙሪያ አደባባይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
verses.fr: L''espace entre la porte d''entrée et le vestibule de la porte intérieure était de cinquante coudées.
verses.am: ከበሩም መግቢያ ፊት ጀምሮ እስከ ውስጠኛው የበሩ ደጀ ሰላም መጨረሻ ድረስ አምሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.
verses.fr: Il y avait des fenêtres grillées aux chambres et à leurs poteaux à l''intérieur de la porte tout autour; il y avait aussi des fenêtres dans les vestibules tout autour intérieurement; des palmes étaient sculptées sur les poteaux.
verses.am: በዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹም በበሩ ውስጥ በዙሪያው በነበሩትም በግንቡ አዕማድ የዓይነ ርግብ መስኮቶች ነበሩባቸው፤ ደግሞም በደጀ ሰላሙ ውስጥ በዙሪያው መስኮቶች ነበሩ፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ሁሉ ላይ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit dans le parvis extérieur, où se trouvaient des chambres et un pavé tout autour; il y avait trente chambres sur ce pavé.
verses.am: ወደ ውጭውም አደባባይ አመጣኝ፥ እነሆም፥ በአደባባዩ ዙሪያ የተሠሩ ዕቃ ቤቶችና ወለል ነበሩ፤ በወለሉም ላይ ሠላሳ ዕቃ ቤቶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
verses.fr: Le pavé était au côté des portes, et répondait à la longueur des portes; c''était le pavé inférieur.
verses.am: ወለሉም በበሮች አጠገብ ነበረ ይህም ታችኛው ወለል እንደ በሮቹ ርዝመት መጠን ነበረ።

verses.en: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.
verses.fr: Il mesura la largeur depuis la porte d''en bas jusqu''au parvis intérieur en dehors; il y avait cent coudées, à l''orient et au septentrion.
verses.am: ከታችኛውም በር ፊት ጀምሮ እስከ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ ፊት ድረስ ወርዱን አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
verses.fr: Il mesura la longueur et la largeur de la porte septentrionale du parvis extérieur.
verses.am: ወደ ሰሜንም መራኝ፥ እነሆም፥ በውጭው አደባባይ ያለ ወደ ሰሜን የሚመለከት በር ነበረ፤ ርዝመቱንና ወርዱንም ለካ፥

verses.en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.fr: Ses chambres, au nombre de trois d''un côté et de trois de l''autre, ses poteaux et ses vestibules, avaient la même mesure que la première porte, cinquante coudées en longueur et vingt-cinq coudées en largeur.
verses.am: የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹም በዚህ በኩል ሦስት በዚያም በኩል ሦስት ነበሩ፤ የግንቡ አዕማድና መዛነቢያዎቹም እንደ ፊተኛው በር ልክ ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.
verses.fr: Ses fenêtres, son vestibule, ses palmes, avaient la même mesure que la porte orientale; on y montait par sept degrés, devant lesquels était son vestibule.
verses.am: መስኮቶቹም መዛነቢያዎቹም የዘንባባ ዛፎቹም ወደ ምሥራቅ እንደሚመለከተው በር ልክ ነበሩ። ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ሰባት ደረጃዎች ነበሩ መዛነቢያዎቹም በፊቱ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
verses.fr: Il y avait une porte au parvis intérieur, vis-à-vis de la porte septentrionale et vis-à-vis de la porte orientale; il mesura d''une porte à l''autre cent coudées.
verses.am: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በሰሜኑና በምሥራቁ በኩል በሌላው በር አንጻር በር ነበረ፤ ከበርም ወደ በር አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit du côté du midi, où se trouvait la porte méridionale. Il en mesura les poteaux et les vestibules, qui avaient la même mesure.
verses.am: ወደ ደቡብም መራኝ፥ እነሆም፥ ወደ ደቡብ የሚመለከት በር ነበረ፤ የግንቡን አዕማድና መዛነቢያዎቹንም እንደዚያው መጠን አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.fr: Cette porte et ses vestibules avaient des fenêtres tout autour, comme les autres fenêtres, cinquante coudées en longueur et vingt-cinq coudées en largeur.
verses.am: በእርሱና በመዛነቢያዎቹም ዙሪያ እንደ እነዚያ መስኮቶች የሚመስሉ መስኮቶች ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
verses.fr: On y montait par sept degrés, devant lesquels était son vestibule; il y avait de chaque côté des palmes sur ses poteaux.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ሰባት ደረጃዎች ነበሩ፥ መዛነቢያዎቹም በፊቱ ነበሩ፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ አንዱ በዚህ አንዱም በዚያ ወገን ሆኖ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
verses.fr: Le parvis intérieur avait une porte du côté du midi; il mesura d''une porte à l''autre au midi cent coudées.
verses.am: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በደቡብ በኩል በር ነበረ፤ ከበር እስከ በር ድረስ በደቡብ በኩል መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
verses.fr: Il me conduisit dans le parvis intérieur, par la porte du midi. Il mesura la porte du midi, qui avait la même mesure.
verses.am: በደቡብም በር በኩል ወደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ አገባኝ፤ እንደዚያውም መጠን አድርጎ የደቡብን በር ለካ፤

verses.en: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.fr: Ses chambres, ses poteaux et ses vestibules, avaient la même mesure. Cette porte et ses vestibules avaient des fenêtres tout autour, cinquante coudées en longueur et vingt-cinq coudées en largeur.
verses.am: እንደዚያውም መጠን አድርጎ የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹንና የግንቡን አዕማድ መዛነቢያዎቹንም ለካ፤ በእርሱና በመዛነቢያዎቹም ዙሪያ መስኮቶች ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
verses.fr: Il y avait tout autour des vestibules de vingt-cinq coudées de longueur et de cinq de largeur.
verses.am: በዙሪያውም ደጀ ሰላሞች ነበሩ፤ ርዝመታቸውም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ወርዳቸውም አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.fr: Les vestibules de la porte aboutissaient au parvis extérieur; il y avait des palmes sur ses poteaux, et huit degrés pour y monter.
verses.am: መዛነቢያዎቹም ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾ ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ስምንት ደረጃዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit dans le parvis intérieur, par l''entrée orientale. Il mesura la porte, qui avait la même mesure.
verses.am: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በምሥራቅ በኩል አገባኝ፥ እንደዚያውም መጠን በሩን ለካ፤

verses.en: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.fr: Ses chambres, ses poteaux et ses vestibules, avaient la même mesure. Cette porte et ses vestibules avaient des fenêtres tout autour, cinquante coudées en longueur et vingt-cinq coudées en largeur.
verses.am: እንደዚያውም መጠን የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹንና የግንቡን አዕማድ መዛነቢያዎቹንም ለካ፤ በእርሱና በመዛነቢያዎቹም ዙሪያ መስኮቶች ነበሩ፥ ርዝመቱም አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.fr: Ses vestibules aboutissaient au parvis extérieur; il y avait de chaque côté des palmes sur ses poteaux, et huit degrés pour y monter.
verses.am: መዛነቢያዎቹም በስተ ውጭ ወዳለው አደባባይ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ በዚህና በዚያ ወገን የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾ ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ስምንት ደረጃዎች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;
verses.fr: Il me conduisit vers la porte septentrionale. Il la mesura, et trouva la même mesure,
verses.am: በሰሜንም ወዳለው በር አመጣኝ፥ እንደዚያውም መጠን ለካው፤

verses.en: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.fr: ainsi qu''à ses chambres, à ses poteaux et à ses vestibules; elle avait des fenêtres tout autour; cinquante coudées en longueur et vingt-cinq coudées en largeur.
verses.am: የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹንና የግንቡን አዕማድ መዛነቢያዎቹንም ለካ፤ በዙሪያውም መስኮቶች ነበሩበት፥ ርዝመቱም አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.fr: Ses vestibules aboutissaient au parvis extérieur; il y avait de chaque côté des palmes sur ses poteaux, et huit degrés pour y monter.
verses.am: የግንቡም አዕማድ ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ በዚህና በዚያ ወገን የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾ ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ስምንት ደረጃዎች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
verses.fr: Il y avait une chambre qui s''ouvrait vers les poteaux des portes, et où l''on devait laver les holocaustes.
verses.am: በበሮቹም በግንብ አዕማድ አጠገብ ዕቃ ቤቱና መዝጊያው ነበሩ፤ በዚያም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያጥቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
verses.fr: Dans le vestibule de la porte se trouvaient de chaque côté deux tables, sur lesquelles on devait égorger l''holocauste, le sacrifice d''expiation et le sacrifice de culpabilité.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት የኃጢአቱንና የበደሉንም መሥዋዕት ያርዱባቸው ዘንድ፥ በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም በዚህ ወገን ሁለት ገበታዎች፥ በዚያም ወገን ሁለት ገበታዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.
verses.fr: A l''un des côtés extérieurs par où l''on montait, à l''entrée de la porte septentrionale, il y avait deux tables; et à l''autre côté, vers le vestibule de la porte, il y avait deux tables.
verses.am: በሰሜን በኩል ባለው በር በስተ ውጭው፥ በመወጣጫው ደረጃዎች አጠገብ፥ በአንድ ወገን ሁለት ገበታዎች ነበሩ፥ በሌላውም ወገን በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም በኩል ሁለት ገበታዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.
verses.fr: Il se trouvait ainsi, aux côtés de la porte, quatre tables d''une part et quatre tables de l''autre, en tout huit tables, sur lesquelles on devait égorger les victimes.
verses.am: በበሩ አጠገብ በዚህ ወገን አራት ገበታዎች በዚያም ወገን አራት ገበታዎች ነበሩ፤ መሥዋዕት የሚያርዱባቸው ገበታዎች ስምንት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
verses.fr: Il y avait encore pour les holocaustes quatre tables en pierres de taille, longues d''une coudée et demie, larges d''une coudée et demie, et hautes d''une coudée; on devait mettre sur ces tables les instruments avec lesquels on égorgeait les victimes pour les holocaustes et pour les autres sacrifices.
verses.am: ስለሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ርዝመታቸው ክንድ ተኩል ወርዳቸውም ክንድ ተኩል ቁመታቸውም አንድ ክንድ የሆኑ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕቱን የሚያርዱበትን ዕቃ ያኖሩባቸው ዘንድ፥ ከተጠረበ ድንጋይ የተሠሩ አራት ገበታዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.
verses.fr: Des rebords de quatre doigts étaient adaptés à la maison tout autour; et la chair des sacrifices devait être mise sur les tables.
verses.am: በዙሪያውም አንድ ጋት የሆነ ክፈፍ ወደ ውስጥ ተቀልብሶ ነበር፤ በገበታዎቹም ላይ የቍርባኑ ሥጋ ነበረባቸው።

verses.en: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
verses.fr: En dehors de la porte intérieure il y avait des chambres pour les chantres, dans le parvis intérieur: l''une était à côté de la porte septentrionale et avait la face au midi, l''autre était à côté de la porte orientale et avait la face au septentrion.
verses.am: ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ አገባኝ፥ እነሆም፥ ሁለት ቤቶች ነበሩ፤ አንዱ ወደ ሰሜን በሚመለከት በር አጠገብ ነበረ፥ መግቢያውም ወደ ደቡብ ይመለከት ነበር፤ ሌላውም ወደ ደቡብ በሚመለከተው በር አጠገብ ነበረ፥ መግቢያውም ወደ ሰሜን ይመለከት ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Cette chambre, dont la face est au midi, est pour les sacrificateurs qui ont la garde de la maison;
verses.am: ሰውዬውም። ይህ ወደ ደቡብ የሚመለከት ቤት ለማገልገል ለሚተጉ ካህናት ነው።

verses.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the Lord to minister unto him.
verses.fr: et la chambre dont la face est au septentrion est pour les sacrificateurs qui ont la garde de l''autel. Ce sont les fils de Tsadok, qui, parmi les fils de Lévi, s''approchent de l''Eternel pour le servir.
verses.am: ወደ ሰሜንም የሚመለከተው ቤት መሠዊያውን ለማገልገል ለሚተጉ ካህናት ነው፤ እነዚህ ከሌዊ ልጆች መካከል ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚቀርቡ የሳዶቅ ልጆች ናቸው አለኝ።

verses.en: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.
verses.fr: Il mesura le parvis, qui avait cent coudées de longueur et cent coudées de largeur, en carré. L''autel était devant la maison.
verses.am: አደባባዩንም በአራት ማዕዘኑ ርዝመቱን መቶ ክንድ ወርዱንም መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ መሠዊያውም በቤቱ ፊት ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit dans le vestibule de la maison. Il mesura les poteaux du vestibule, et trouva cinq coudées d''un côté et cinq coudées de l''autre. La largeur de la porte était de trois coudées d''un côté et de trois coudées de l''autre.
verses.am: ወደ ቤቱም ደጀ ሰላም አመጣኝ፥ የደጀ ሰላሙንም የግንብ አዕማድ ወርድ በዚህ ወገን አምስት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን አምስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ የበሩም ወርድ አሥራ አራት ክንድ ነበረ፥ በበሩም በዚህ ወገንና በዚያ ወገን የነበሩት ግንቦች ሦስት ሦስት ክንድ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits, and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
verses.fr: Le vestibule avait une longueur de vingt coudées et une largeur de onze coudées; on y montait par des degrés. Il y avait des colonnes près des poteaux, l''une d''un côté, et l''autre de l''autre.
verses.am: የደጀ ሰላሙም ርዝመት ሀያ ክንድ ወርዱም አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ አሥር ደረጃዎች ነበሩ፤ አንድ በዚህ ወገን አንድም በዚያ ወገን ሆነው በመቃኖቹ አጠገብ የግንብ አዕማድ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit dans le temple. Il mesura les poteaux; il y avait six coudées de largeur d''un côté, et six coudées de largeur de l''autre, largeur de la tente.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደሱም አገባኝ፥ የግንቡንም አዕማድ ወርድ በዚህ ወገን ስድስት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን ስድስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.
verses.fr: La largeur de la porte était de dix coudées; il y avait cinq coudées d''un côté de la porte, et cinq coudées de l''autre. Il mesura la longueur du temple, quarante coudées, et la largeur, vingt coudées.
verses.am: የመግቢያውም ወርድ አሥር ክንድ ነበረ፥ የመግቢያውም መቃኖች በዚህ ወገን አምስት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን አምስት ክንድ ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱንም አርባ ክንድ ወርዱንም ሀያ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
verses.fr: Puis il entra dans l''intérieur. Il mesura les poteaux de la porte, deux coudées, la porte, six coudées, et la largeur de la porte, sept coudées.
verses.am: ወደ ውስጥም ገባ፥ የመግቢያውንም የግንብ አዕማድ ወርድ ሁለት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ የመግቢያውም ወርድ ስድስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የመግቢያውም ግንብ ወርድ በዚህ ወገን ሰባት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን ሰባት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.
verses.fr: Il mesura une longueur de vingt coudées, et une largeur de vingt coudées, sur le devant du temple; et il me dit: C''est ici le lieu très saint.
verses.am: በመቅደሱም ፊት ርዘመቱን ሀያ ክንድ ወርዱንም ሀያ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካና። ይህ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ነው አለኝ።

verses.en: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
verses.fr: Il mesura le mur de la maison, six coudées, et la largeur des chambres latérales tout autour de la maison, quatre coudées.
verses.am: የመቅደሱንም ግንብ ስድስት ክንድ አድርጎ፥ በመቅደሱም ዙሪያ ሁሉ ያሉትን የጓዳዎቹን ሁሉ ወርድ አራት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.
verses.fr: Les chambres latérales étaient les unes à côté des autres, au nombre de trente, et il y avait trois étages; elles entraient dans un mur construit pour ces chambres tout autour de la maison, elles y étaient appuyées sans entrer dans le mur même de la maison.
verses.am: ጓዳዎቹም አንዱ ከአንዱ በላይ በሦስት ደርብ ነበሩ፥ በእያንዳንዱም ደርብ ሠላሳ ጓዳዎች ነበሩ። በመቅደሱም ግንብ ዙሪያ ደገፋዎች ይሆኑ ዘንድ አረፍቶች ነበሩ፥ በመቅደሱም ግንብ ውስጥ ደገፋዎች አልነበሩም።

verses.en: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.
verses.fr: Les chambres occupaient plus d''espace, à mesure qu''elles s''élevaient, et l''on allait en tournant; car on montait autour de la maison par un escalier tournant. Il y avait ainsi plus d''espace dans le haut de la maison, et l''on montait de l''étage inférieur à l''étage supérieur par celui du milieu.
verses.am: በቤቱም ዙሪያ ባለ ግንብ ውስጥ በነበሩት አረፍቶች ምክንያት ላይኞቹ ጓዳዎች ከታችኞቹ ጓዳዎች ይበልጡ ነበር፤ ከታችኛውም ደርብ ወደ መካከለኛው ከመካከለኛውም ደርብ ወደ ላይኛው የሚወጣበት ደረጃ ነበረ።

verses.en: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.
verses.fr: Je considérai la hauteur autour de la maison. Les chambres latérales, à partir de leur fondement, avaient une canne pleine, six grandes coudées.
verses.am: ለመቅደሱም ከፍ ያለ ወለል በዙሪያው እንዳለው አየሁ፤ የጓዳዎቹም መሠረት ቁመቱ ሙሉ ዘንግ የሚያህል ስድስት ትልቅ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.
verses.fr: Le mur extérieur des chambres latérales avait une épaisseur de cinq coudées. L''espace libre entre les chambres latérales de la maison
verses.am: የጓዳዎቹም የውጭው ግንብ ውፍረት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፤ በመቅደሱም ጓዳዎች አጠገብ የቀረ አንድ ባዶ ስፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
verses.fr: et les chambres autour de la maison, avait une largeur de vingt coudées, tout autour.
verses.am: በምዕራብም በኩል በልዩ ስፍራ አንጻር የነበረ ግቢ ስፋቱ ሰባ ክንድ ነበረ። በግቢውም ዙሪያ የነበረ ግንብ ውፍረቱ አምስት ክንድ ርዝመቱም ዘጠና ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.
verses.fr: L''entrée des chambres latérales donnait sur l''espace libre, une entrée au septentrion, et une entrée au midi; et la largeur de l''espace libre était de cinq coudées tout autour.
verses.am: በምዕራብም በኩል በልዩ ስፍራ አንጻር የነበረ ግቢ ስፋቱ ሰባ ክንድ ነበረ። በግቢውም ዙሪያ የነበረ ግንብ ውፍረቱ አምስት ክንድ ርዝመቱም ዘጠና ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
verses.fr: Le bâtiment qui était devant la place vide, du côté de l''occident, avait une largeur de soixante-dix coudées, un mur de cinq coudées d''épaisseur tout autour, et une longueur de quatre-vingt-dix coudées.
verses.am: የመቅደሱንም ርዝመት መቶ ክንድ፥ የልዩውን ስፍራና ግቢውን ከግንቡ ጋር አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;
verses.fr: Il mesura la maison, qui avait cent coudées de longueur. La place vide, le bâtiment et ses murs, avaient une longueur de cent coudées.
verses.am: ደግሞም በምሥራቅ በኩል የነበረውን የመቅደሱንና የልዩውን ስፍራ ወርድ አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
verses.fr: La largeur de la face de la maison et de la place vide, du côté de l''orient, était de cent coudées.
verses.am: ወደ ኋላውም ባለው በልዩ ስፍራ አንጻር የነበረውን የግቢውን ርዝመት በዚህና በዚያም ከነበሩት ከግንቦቹ ጋር አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
verses.fr: Il mesura la longueur du bâtiment devant la place vide, sur le derrière, et ses galeries de chaque côté: il y avait cent coudées. Le temple intérieur, les vestibules extérieurs,
verses.am: መድረኮቹ፥ መቅደሱና በስተ ውስጥ ያለው ክፍል ደጀ ሰላሙም በእንጨት ተለብጠው ነበር፥ በሦስቱም ዙሪያ የዓይነ ርግብ መስኮቶች ነበሩ። መቅደሱም በመድረኩ አንጻር ከመሬት ጀምሮ እስከ መስኮቶቹ ድረስ በእንጨት ተለብጦ ነበር፤ መስኮቶቹም የዓይነ ርግብ ነበሩ፤

verses.en: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;
verses.fr: les seuils, les fenêtres grillées, les galeries du pourtour aux trois étages, en face des seuils, étaient recouverts de bois tout autour. Depuis le sol jusqu''aux fenêtres fermées,
verses.am: በደጁም ላይ እስከ ውስጠኛው ክፍል ድረስ፥ በውጭም ግንቡ ሁሉ ውስጡም ውጭውም ተለብጦ ነበር።

verses.en: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
verses.fr: jusqu''au-dessus de la porte, le dedans de la maison, le dehors, toute la muraille du pourtour, à l''intérieur et à l''extérieur, tout était d''après la mesure,
verses.am: ኪሩቤልና የዘንባባው ዛፎች ተቀርጸውበት ነበር፤ የዘንባባውም ዛፍ ከኪሩብና ከኪሩብ መካከል ነበረ፤ ለእያንዳንዱም ኪሩብ ሁለት ፊት ነበረው።

verses.en: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;
verses.fr: et orné de chérubins et de palmes. Il y avait une palme entre deux chérubins. Chaque chérubin avait deux visages,
verses.am: በአንድ ወገን ወዳለው የዘንባባ ዛፍ የሰው ፊት ይመለከት ነበር፥ በሌላውም ወገን ወዳለው የዘንባባ ዛፍ የአንበሳ ፊት ይመለከት ነበር፤ በቤቱ ሁሉ ዙሪያ እንደዚህ ተደርጎ ነበር።

verses.en: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.
verses.fr: une face d''homme tournée d''un côté vers la palme, et une face de lion tournée de l''autre côté vers l''autre palme; il en était ainsi tout autour de la maison.
verses.am: ከመሬት አንሥቶ እስከ ደጁ ራስ ድረስ ኪሩቤልና የዘንባባ ዛፎች ተቀርጸው ነበር። የመቅደሱ ግንብ እንደዚህ ነበረ።

verses.en: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.
verses.fr: Depuis le sol jusqu''au-dessus de la porte, il y avait des chérubins et des palmes, et aussi sur la muraille du temple.
verses.am: የመቅደሱ መቃኖችም አራት ማዕዘን ነበሩ፥ የመቅደሱ ፊትም መልኩ እንደ ሌላው መልክ ነበረ።

verses.en: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.
verses.fr: Les poteaux du temple étaient carrés, et la face du sanctuaire avait le même aspect.
verses.am: መሠዊያውም ቁመቱ ሦስት ክንድ ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ወርዱም ሁለት ክንድ ሆኖ ከእንጨት ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ ማዕዘኖቹም እግሩም አገዳዎቹም ከእንጨት ተሠርተው ነበር፤ እርሱም። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለችው ገበታ ይህች ናት አለኝ።

verses.en: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the Lord.
verses.fr: L''autel était de bois, haut de trois coudées, et long de deux coudées. Ses angles, ses pieds, et ses côtés étaient de bois. L''homme me dit: C''est ici la table qui est devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለመቅደሱና ለተቀደሰው ስፍራ ሁለት መዝጊያዎች ነበሩአቸው።

verses.en: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
verses.fr: Le temple et le sanctuaire avaient deux portes.
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱ መዝጊያም ሁለት ተዘዋዋሪ ሳንቃዎች ነበሩት፤ ለአንዱ መዝጊያ ሁለት ለሌላውም መዝጊያ ሁለት ሳንቃዎች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
verses.fr: Il y avait aux portes deux battants, qui tous deux tournaient sur les portes, deux battants pour une porte et deux pour l''autre.
verses.am: በግንቡም ላይ በተቀረጹት ዓይነት በእነዚህ በመቅደሱ መዝጊያዎች ላይ ኪሩቤልና የዘንባባ ዛፎች ተቀርጸው ነበር፤ በስተ ውጭም ባለው በደጀ ሰላሙ ፊት የእንጨት መድረክ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
verses.fr: Des chérubins et des palmes étaient sculptés sur les portes du temple, comme sur les murs. Un entablement en bois était sur le front du vestibule en dehors.
verses.am: በደጀ ሰላሙም በሁለቱ ወገን በዚህና በዚያ የዓይነ ርግብ መስኮቶችና የተቀረጹ የዘንባባ ዛፎች ነበሩበት፤ የመቅደሱም ጓዳዎችና የእንጨቱ መድረክ እንዲሁ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
verses.fr: Il y avait des fenêtres fermées, et il y avait des palmes de part et d''autre, ainsi qu''aux côtés du vestibule, aux chambres latérales de la maison, et aux entablements.
verses.am: ፤ በደጀ ሰላሙም በሁለቱ ወገን በዚህና በዚያ የዓይነ ርግብ መስኮቶችና የተቀረጹ የዘንባባ ዛፎች ነበሩበት፤ የመቅደሱም ጓዳዎችና የእንጨቱ መድረክ እንዲሁ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.
verses.fr: Il me fit sortir vers le parvis extérieur du côté du septentrion, et il me conduisit aux chambres qui étaient vis-à-vis de la place vide et vis-à-vis du bâtiment, au septentrion.
verses.am: በውጭም አደባባይ በሰሜኑ መንገድ አወጣኝ፥ በልዩውም ስፍራ አንጻርና በሰሜን በኩል ባለው ግቢ ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ዕቃ ቤት አገባኝ።

verses.en: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.
verses.fr: Sur la face, où se trouvait la porte septentrionale, il y avait une longueur de cent coudées; et la largeur était de cinquante coudées.
verses.am: መቶ ክንድ በሆነው ርዝመት ፊት በሰሜን በኩል መዝጊያ ነበረ ወርዱም አምሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
verses.fr: C''était vis-à-vis des vingt coudées du parvis intérieur, et vis-à-vis du pavé du parvis extérieur, là où se trouvaient les galeries des trois étages.
verses.am: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በሀያው ክንድ አንጻር በውጭውም አደባባይ በወለሉ አንጻር በሦስት ደርብ በትይዩ የተሠራ መተላለፊያ ነበረ።

verses.en: And before the chambers was a walk to ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
verses.fr: Devant les chambres, il y avait une allée large de dix coudées, et une voie d''une coudée; leurs portes donnaient au septentrion.
verses.am: በዕቃ ቤቶቹም ፊት በስተ ውስጥ ወርዱ አሥር ክንድ ርዝመቱ መቶ ክንድ የሆነ መንገድ ነበረ፤ መዝጊያዎቻቸውም ወደ ሰሜን ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
verses.fr: Les chambres supérieures étaient plus étroites que les inférieures et que celles du milieu du bâtiment, parce que les galeries leur ôtaient de la place.
verses.am: መተላለፊያውም አሳጥሮአቸዋልና ላይኞቹ ዕቃ ቤቶች ከመካከለኞቹና ከታችኞቹ ይልቅ አጫጭር ነበሩ።

verses.en: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
verses.fr: Il y avait trois étages, mais il n''y avait point de colonnes, comme les colonnes des parvis; c''est pourquoi, à partir du sol, les chambres du haut étaient plus étroites que celles du bas et du milieu.
verses.am: በሦስትም ደርብ ተሠርተው ነበርና፥ በአደባባዩም እንዳሉት አዕማድ፥ አዕማድ አልነበሩላቸውምና ስለዚህ ላይኞቹ ከመካከለኞቹና ከታችኞቹ ይልቅ ጠባብ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
verses.fr: Le mur extérieur parallèle aux chambres, du côté du parvis extérieur, devant les chambres, avait cinquante coudées de longueur;
verses.am: በውጭ በዕቃ ቤቶቹ አጠገብ ያለው፥ ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ የሚመለከተው ቅጥር፥ በዕቃ ቤቶች ትይዩ የሆነ፥ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.
verses.fr: car la longueur des chambres du côté du parvis extérieur était de cinquante coudées. Mais sur la face du temple il y avait cent coudées.
verses.am: በመቅደሱ ፊት የነበሩት ዕቃ ቤቶች ርዝመታቸው መቶ ክንድ ሲሆን በውጭው አደባባይ በኩል የነበሩት ዕቃ ቤቶች ርዝመታቸው አምሳ ክንድ ነበረና።

verses.en: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
verses.fr: Au bas de ces chambres était l''entrée de l''orient, quand on y venait du parvis extérieur.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም ዕቃ ቤቶች በታች በስተ ምሥራቅ በኩል፥ ሰው ከውጭው አደባባይ የሚገባበት መግቢያ ነበረ። ይህም በቅጥሩ ራስ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
verses.fr: Il y avait encore des chambres sur la largeur du mur du parvis du côté de l''orient, vis-à-vis de la place vide et vis-à-vis du bâtiment.
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል በልዩው ስፍራና በግቢው አንጻር ዕቃ ቤቶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
verses.fr: Devant elles, il y avait une allée, comme devant les chambres qui étaient du côté du septentrion. La longueur et la largeur étaient les mêmes; leurs issues, leur disposition et leurs portes étaient semblables.
verses.am: በስተ ፊታቸውም የነበረ መንገድ በሰሜን በኩል እንደ ነበረው እንደ ዕቃ ቤቶቹ መንገድ ምስያ ነበረ። ርዝመታቸውም ወርዳቸውም መውጫቸውም ሥርዓታቸውም መዝጊያዎቻቸውም በዚያው ልክ ነበረ።

verses.en: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
verses.fr: Il en était de même pour les portes des chambres du côté du midi. Il y avait une porte à la tête de l''allée, de l''allée qui se trouvait droit devant le mur du côté de l''orient, par où l''on y entrait.
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል ካሉት ዕቃ ቤቶች በታች በምሥራቅ በኩል በቅጥሩ ራስ አጠገብ መግቢያ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the Lord shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Les chambres du septentrion et les chambres du midi, qui sont devant la place vide, ce sont les chambres saintes, où les sacrificateurs qui s''approchent de l''Eternel mangeront les choses très saintes; ils y déposeront les choses très saintes, les offrandes, les victimes présentées dans les sacrifices d''expiation et de culpabilité; car le lieu est saint.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለኝ። በልዩ ስፍራ አንጻር በሰሜንና በደቡብ በኩል ያሉ ዕቃ ቤቶች፥ እነርሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚቀርቡ ካህናት ከሁሉ ይልቅ የተቀደሰውን ምግብ የሚበሉባቸው ቤቶች ናቸው። ስፍራው ቅዱስ ነውና በዚያ የተቀደሰውን ነገር የእህሉን ቍርባን የኃጢአቱንና የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ያኖራሉ።

verses.en: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.
verses.fr: Quand les sacrificateurs seront entrés, ils ne sortiront pas du sanctuaire pour aller dans le parvis extérieur, mais ils déposeront là les vêtements avec lesquels ils font le service, car ces vêtements sont saints; ils en mettront d''autres pour s''approcher du peuple.
verses.am: ካህናቱም በገቡ ጊዜ ከመቅደሱ በውጭው አደባባይ አይወጡም፤ የሚያገለግሉበትን ልብሳቸውን ግን ቅዱስ ነውና በዚያ ያኖሩታል፥ ሌላም ልብስ ለብሰው ወደ ሕዝብ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut achevé de mesurer la maison intérieure, il me fit sortir par la porte qui était du côté de l''orient, et il mesura l''enceinte tout autour.
verses.am: ውስጠኛውንም ቤት ለክቶ በፈጸመ ጊዜ ወደ ምሥራቅ በሚመለከት በር መንገድ አወጣኝ እርሱንም በዙሪያው ለካው።

verses.en: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.fr: Il mesura le côté de l''orient avec la canne qui servait de mesure, et il y avait tout autour cinq cents cannes.
verses.am: የምሥራቁን ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.fr: Il mesura le côté du septentrion avec la canne qui servait de mesure, et il y avait tout autour cinq cents cannes.
verses.am: ዞረም፥ የሰሜኑንም ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።
