verses.en: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
verses.fr: Il mesura le côté du midi avec la canne qui servait de mesure, et il y avait cinq cents cannes.
verses.am: ዞረም፥ የደቡቡንም ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.fr: Il se tourna du côté de l''occident, et mesura cinq cents cannes avec la canne qui servait de mesure.
verses.am: ዞረም፥ የምዕራቡንም ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.en: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
verses.fr: Il mesura des quatre côtés le mur formant l''enceinte de la maison; la longueur était de cinq cents cannes, et la largeur de cinq cents cannes; ce mur marquait la séparation entre le saint et le profane.
verses.am: በአራቱ ወገን ለካው። የተቀደሰውንና ያልተቀደሰውን ይለይ ዘንድ ርዝመቱ አምስት መቶ ክንድ ወርዱም አምስት መቶ ክንድ የሆነ ቅጥር በዙሪያው ነበረ።

verses.en: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:
verses.fr: Il me conduisit à la porte, à la porte qui était du côté de l''orient.
verses.am: ወደ ምሥራቅም ወደሚመለከተው በር አመጣኝ።

verses.en: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
verses.fr: Et voici, la gloire du Dieu d''Israël s''avançait de l''orient. Sa voix était pareille au bruit des grandes eaux, et la terre resplendissait de sa gloire.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ ክብር ከምሥራቅ መንገድ መጣ፤ ድምፁም እንደ ብዙ ውኆች ይተምም ነበር፥ ከክብሩም የተነሣ ምድር ታበራ ነበር።

verses.en: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
verses.fr: Cette vision était semblable à celle que j''avais eue lorsque j''étais venu pour détruire la ville; et ces visions étaient semblables à celle que j''avais eue près du fleuve du Kebar. Et je tombai sur ma face.
verses.am: ያየሁትም ራእይ ከተማይቱን ለማጥፋት በመጣሁ ጊዜ እንዳየሁት ራእይ ነበረ፤ ራእዩም በኮበር ወንዝ እንዳየሁት ራእይ ነበረ፤ እኔም በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ።

verses.en: And the glory of the Lord came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
verses.fr: La gloire de l''Eternel entra dans la maison par la porte qui était du côté de l''orient.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ወደ ምሥራቅ በሚመለከት በር ወደ መቅደሱ ገባ።

verses.en: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house.
verses.fr: Alors, l''esprit m''enleva et me transporta dans le parvis intérieur. Et voici, la gloire de l''Eternel remplissait la maison.
verses.am: መንፈሱም አነሣኝ ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ አገባኝ፤ እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር መቅደሱን ሞልቶት ነበር።

verses.en: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
verses.fr: J''entendis quelqu''un qui me parlait depuis la maison, et un homme se tenait près de moi.
verses.am: በመቅደሱም ሆኖ የሚናገረኝን ሰማሁ፥ በአጠገቤም ሰው ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Fils de l''homme, c''est ici le lieu de mon trône, le lieu où je poserai la plante de mes pieds; j''y habiterai éternellement au milieu des enfants d''Israël. La maison d''Israël et ses rois ne souilleront plus mon saint nom par leurs prostitutions et par les cadavres de leurs rois sur leurs hauts lieux.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለዘላለም የምቀመጥበት የዙፋኔ ስፍራና የእግሬ ጫማ መረገጫ ይህ ነው። ዳግመኛም የእስራኤል ቤትና ነገሥታቶቻቸው በግልሙትናቸውና በከፍታዎቻቸው ባለው በነገሥታቶቻቸው ሬሳ ቅዱስ ስሜን አያረክሱም፤

verses.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.
verses.fr: Ils mettaient leur seuil près de mon seuil, leurs poteaux près de mes poteaux, et il n''y avait qu''un mur entre moi et eux; ils ont ainsi souillé mon saint nom par les abominations qu''ils ont commises; c''est pourquoi je les ai consumés dans ma colère.
verses.am: መድረካቸውን በመድረኬ አጠገብ፥ መቃናቸውንም በመቃኔ አጠገብ አድርገዋልና። በእኔና በእነርሱም መካከል ግንብ ብቻ ነበረ፤ በሠሩትም ርኵሰት ቅዱስ ስሜን አረከሱ፤ ስለዚህ በቍጣዬ አጠፋኋቸው።

verses.en: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
verses.fr: Maintenant ils éloigneront de moi leurs prostitutions et les cadavres de leurs rois, et j''habiterai éternellement au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: አሁንም ግልሙትናቸውንና የነገሥታቶቻቸውን ሬሳ ከእኔ ዘንድ ያርቁ፥ እኔም ለዘላለም በመካከላቸው አድራለሁ።

verses.en: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
verses.fr: Toi, fils de l''homme, montre ce temple à la maison d''Israël; qu''ils en mesurent le plan, et qu''ils rougissent de leurs iniquités.
verses.am: አንተም የሰው ልጅ፥ ከኃጢአታቸው የተነሣ ያፍሩ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ወገን ይህን ቤት አሳያቸው አምሳያውንም ይለኩ።

verses.en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
verses.fr: S''ils rougissent de toute leur conduite, fais-leur connaître la forme de cette maison, sa disposition, ses issues et ses entrées, tous ses dessins et toutes ses ordonnances, tous ses dessins et toutes ses lois; mets-en la description sous leurs yeux, afin qu''ils gardent tous ses dessins et toutes ses ordonnances, et qu''ils s''y conforment dans l''exécution.
verses.am: ከሠሩትም ሥራ ሁሉ የተነሣ ቢያፍሩ፥ የቤቱን መልክና ምሳሌውን መውጫውንም መግቢያውንም ሥርዓቱንም ሕጉንም ሁሉ አስታውቃቸው፤ ሥርዓቱንና ሕጉን ሁሉ ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ያደርጉትም ዘንድ በፊታቸው ጻፈው።

verses.en: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
verses.fr: Telle est la loi de la maison. Sur le sommet de la montagne, tout l''espace qu''elle doit occuper est très saint. Voilà donc la loi de la maison.
verses.am: የቤቱ ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ በተራራው ራስ ላይ ዳርቻው ሁሉ በዙሪያው ከሁሉ ይልቅ የተቀደስ ይሆናል። እነሆ፥ የቤቱ ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.
verses.fr: Voici les mesures de l''autel, d''après les coudées dont chacune était d''un palme plus longue que la coudée ordinaire. La base avait une coudée de hauteur, et une coudée de largeur; et le rebord qui terminait son contour avait un empan de largeur; c''était le support de l''autel.
verses.am: የመሠዊያውም ልክ በክንድ ይህ ነው፥ ክንዱም ክንድ ተጋት ነው። የመሠረቱም ቁመቱ አንድ ክንድ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ነው፥ አንድ ስንዝርም ክፈፍ ዳር ዳሩን በዙሪያው አለ፤ የመሠዊያው መሠረት እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.
verses.fr: Depuis la base sur le sol jusqu''à l''encadrement inférieur il y avait deux coudées, et une coudée de largeur; et depuis le petit jusqu''au grand encadrement il y avait quatre coudées, et une coudée de largeur.
verses.am: በመሬቱም ላይ ካለው መሠረት ጀምሮ እስከ ታችኛው እርከን ድረስ ሁለት ክንድ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ነው፤ ከትንሹም እርከን ጀምሮ እስከ ትልቁ እርከን ድረስ አራት ክንድ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ነው።

verses.en: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
verses.fr: L''autel avait quatre coudées; et quatre cornes s''élevaient de l''autel.
verses.am: ምድጃውም አራት ክንድ ነው፤ በምድጃውም ላይ አንድ ክንድ ወደ ላይ ከፍ የሚሉ አራት ቀንዶች አሉበት።

verses.en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
verses.fr: L''autel avait douze coudées de longueur, douze coudées de largeur, et formait un carré par ses quatre côtés.
verses.am: የምድጃውም ርዝመት አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ወርዱም አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነው፥ አራቱም ማዕዘን ትክክል ነው።

verses.en: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.
verses.fr: L''encadrement avait quatorze coudées de longueur sur quatorze coudées de largeur à ses quatre côtés, le rebord qui terminait son contour avait une demi-coudée; la base avait une coudée tout autour, et les degrés étaient tournés vers l''orient.
verses.am: የእርከኑም ርዝመት አሥራ አራት ክንድ ወርዱም አሥራ አራት ክንድ ነው፥ አራቱም ማዕዘን ትክክል ነው፤ በዙሪያውም ያለው ክፈፍ እኩል ክንድ ነው፥ መሠረቱም በዙሪያው አንድ ክንድ ነው፤ ደረጃዎቹም ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከታሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord God; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Fils de l''homme, ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici les lois au sujet de l''autel, pour le jour où on le construira, afin d''y offrir les holocaustes et d''y répandre le sang.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡበት ዘንድ ደሙንም ይረጩበት ዘንድ በሚሠሩበት ቀን የመሠዊያው ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord God, a young bullock for a sin offering.
verses.fr: Tu donneras aux sacrificateurs, aux Lévites, qui sont de la postérité de Tsadok et qui s''approchent de moi pour me servir, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, un jeune taureau pour le sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ ለሚቀርቡ ከሳዶቅ ዘር ለሚሆኑ ለሌዋውያኑ ካህናት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ወይፈን ትሰጣቸዋለህ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
verses.fr: Tu prendras de son sang, et tu en mettras sur les quatre cornes de l''autel, sur les quatre angles de l''encadrement, et sur le rebord qui l''entoure; tu purifieras ainsi l''autel et tu en feras l''expiation.
verses.am: ከደሙም ትወስዳለህ፥ በአራቱ ቀንዶቹም በእርከኑም በአራቱ ማዕዘን ላይ በዙሪያውም ባለው ክፈፍ ላይ ትረጨዋለህ፤ እንዲሁ ታነጻዋለህ ታስተሰርይለትማለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
verses.fr: Tu prendras le taureau expiatoire, et on le brûlera dans un lieu réservé de la maison, en dehors du sanctuaire.
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ወይፈን ትወስዳለህ፥ በመቅደሱም ውጭ በቤቱ በታዘዘው ስፍራ ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
verses.fr: Le second jour, tu offriras en expiation un bouc sans défaut; on purifiera ainsi l''autel, comme on l''aura purifié avec le taureau.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ቀን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባለህ፤ በወይፈኑም እንዳነጹት እንዲሁ መሠዊያውን ያነጹበታል።

verses.en: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
verses.fr: Quand tu auras achevé la purification, tu offriras un jeune taureau sans défaut, et un bélier du troupeau sans défaut.
verses.am: ማንጻቱንም ከፈጸምህ በኋላ ነውር የሌለበትን ወይፈን ከመንጋውም የወጣውን ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt offer them before the Lord, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu les offriras devant l''Eternel; les sacrificateurs jetteront du sel sur eux, et les offriront en holocauste à l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ታቀርባቸዋለህ፥ ካህናቱም ጨው ይጨምሩባቸዋል፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አድርገው ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡአቸዋል።

verses.en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
verses.fr: Pendant sept jours, tu sacrifieras chaque jour un bouc comme victime expiatoire; on sacrifiera aussi un jeune taureau et un bélier du troupeau, l''un et l''autre sans défaut.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀንም በየዕለቱ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን አውራ ፍየልን ታቀርባለህ፥ ነውርም የሌለባቸውን አንድ ወይፈን ከመንጋውም የወጣውን አንድ አውራ በግ ያቀርባሉ።

verses.en: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
verses.fr: Pendant sept jours, on fera l''expiation et la purification de l''autel, on le consacrera.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን ለመሠዊያው ያስተሰርያሉ ያነጹትማል፥ እንዲሁም ይቀድሱታል።

verses.en: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Lorsque ces jours seront accomplis, dès le huitième jour et à l''avenir les sacrificateurs offriront sur l''autel vos holocaustes et vos sacrifices d''actions de grâces. Et je vous serai favorable, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ቀኖቹንም በፈጸሙ ጊዜ በስምንተኛው ቀን ከዚያም በኋላ ካህናቱ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕታችሁን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያደርጋሉ፤ እኔም እቀበላችኋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.
verses.fr: Il me ramena vers la porte extérieure du sanctuaire, du côté de l''orient. Mais elle était fermée.
verses.am: ወደ ምሥራቅም ወደሚመለከተው በስተ ውጭ ወዳለው ወደ መቅደሱ በር አመጣኝ፤ ተዘግቶም ነበር።

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the Lord, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel me dit: Cette porte sera fermée, elle ne s''ouvrira point, et personne n''y passera; car l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël est entré par là. Elle restera fermée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ይህ በር ተዘግቶ ይኖራል እንጂ አይከፈትም፥ ሰውም አይገባበትም፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ገብቶበታልና ተዘግቶ ይኖራል።

verses.en: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui concerne le prince, le prince pourra s''y asseoir, pour manger le pain devant l''Eternel; il entrera par le chemin du vestibule de la porte, et il sortira par le même chemin.
verses.am: አለቃው ግን እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንጀራ ይበላ ዘንድ ይቀመጥበታል፤ በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም መንገድ ይገባል በዚያም መንገድ ይወጣል።

verses.en: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord: and I fell upon my face.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit vers la porte du septentrion, devant la maison. Je regardai, et voici, la gloire de l''Eternel remplissait la maison de l''Eternel. Et je tombai sur ma face.
verses.am: በሰሜኑም በር መንገድ በቤቱ ፊት አመጣኝ፤ እኔም አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበር፤ እኔም በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Fils de l''homme, sois attentif, et regarde de tes yeux! Ecoute de tes oreilles tout ce que je te dirai au sujet de toutes les ordonnances de la maison de l''Eternel et de toutes ses lois; considère attentivement l''entrée de la maison et toutes les issues du sanctuaire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ልብ አድርግ ስለ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ሥርዓትና ሕግ ሁሉ የምናገርህን ሁሉ በዓይንህ ተመልከት በጆሮህም ስማ፤ የቤቱንም መግቢያ የመቅደሱንም መውጫ ሁሉ ልብ አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
verses.fr: Tu diras aux rebelles, à la maison d''Israël: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Assez de toutes vos abominations, maison d''Israël!
verses.am: ለዓመፀኛው ለእስራኤል ቤት እንዲህ በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥

verses.en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
verses.fr: Vous avez introduit dans mon sanctuaire des étrangers incirconcis de coeur et incirconcis de chair, pour profaner ma maison; vous avez offert mon pain, la graisse et le sang à toutes vos abominations, vous avez rompu mon alliance.
verses.am: እንጀራዬን፥ ስብንና ደምን፥ በምታቀርቡበት ጊዜ በመቅደሴ ውስጥ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ቤቴንም ያረክሱ ዘንድ በልባቸውና በሥጋቸው ያልተገረዙትን እንግዶችን ሰዎች አግብታችኋልና፥ እነርሱም በርኵሰታችሁ ሁሉ ላይ ይጨመሩ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳኔን አፍርሰዋልና ርኵሰታችሁ ሁሉ ይብቃችሁ።

verses.en: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
verses.fr: Vous n''avez pas fait le service de mon sanctuaire, mais vous les avez mis à votre place pour faire le service dans mon sanctuaire.
verses.am: በመቅደሴ ውስጥ ለራሳችሁ ሥርዓቴን ጠባቂዎች አደረጋችሁ እንጂ የተቀደሰውን ነገሬን ሥርዓት አልጠበቃችሁም።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Aucun étranger, incirconcis de coeur et incirconcis de chair, n''entrera dans mon sanctuaire, aucun des étrangers qui seront au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ካሉት ሁሉ በልቡና በሥጋው ያልተገረዘ እንግዳ ሁሉ ወደ መቅደሴ አይግባ።

verses.en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
verses.fr: De plus, les Lévites qui se sont éloignés de moi, quand Israël s''égarait et se détournait de moi pour suivre ses idoles, porteront la peine de leur iniquité.
verses.am: ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቁ፥ እስራኤልም በሳቱ ጊዜ ጣዖታቸውን ተከትለው ከእኔ ዘንድ የሳቱ ሌዋውያን ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.en: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
verses.fr: Ils seront dans mon sanctuaire comme serviteurs, ils auront la garde des portes de la maison; et feront le service de la maison; ils égorgeront pour le peuple les victimes destinées aux holocaustes et aux autres sacrifices, et ils se tiendront devant lui pour être à son service.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመቅደሴ ውስጥ አገልጋዮች ይሆናሉ፥ በቤቱም በሮች በረኞች ይሆናሉ በቤቱም ውስጥ ያገለግላሉ፤ ለሕዝቡም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕቱን ያርዳሉ፥ ያገለግሉአቸውም ዘንድ በፊታቸው ይቆማሉ።

verses.en: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord God, and they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.fr: Parce qu''ils l''ont servi devant ses idoles, et qu''ils ont fait tomber dans le péché la maison d''Israël, je lève ma main sur eux, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel, pour qu''ils portent la peine de leur iniquité.
verses.am: በጣዖቶቻቸውም ፊት አገልግለዋቸው ነበሩና፥ ለእስራኤልም ቤት የኃጢአት ዕንቅፋት ሆነዋልና ስለዚህ እጄን በላያቸው አንሥቻለሁ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይሸከማሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
verses.fr: Ils ne s''approcheront pas de moi pour être à mon service dans le sacerdoce, ils ne s''approcheront pas de mes sanctuaires, de mes lieux très saints; ils porteront la peine de leur ignominie et des abominations qu''ils ont commises.
verses.am: ካህናትም ይሆኑኝ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ አይቀርቡም፥ ወደ ተቀደሰውም ነገሬና ወደ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ነገር አይቀርቡም፤ እፍረታቸውንና የሠሩትንም ርኵሰታቸውን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.en: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
verses.fr: Je leur donnerai la garde de la maison, et ils en feront tout le service et tout ce qui doit s''y faire.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለአገልግሎቱ ሁሉና በእርሱ ውስጥ ለሚደረገው ሁሉ የቤቱን ሥርዓት ጠባቂዎች አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord God:
verses.fr: Mais les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, fils de Tsadok, qui ont fait le service de mon sanctuaire quand les enfants d''Israël s''égaraient loin de moi, ceux-là s''approcheront de moi pour me servir, et se tiendront devant moi pour m''offrir la graisse et le sang, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል ልጆች ከእኔ ዘንድ በሳቱ ጊዜ የመቅደሴን ሥርዓት የጠበቁ የሳዶቅ ልጆች ሌዋውያን ካህናት ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ ይቀርባሉ፤ ስቡንና ደሙንም ወደ እኔ ያቀርቡ ዘንድ በፊቴ ይቆማሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
verses.fr: Ils entreront dans mon sanctuaire, ils s''approcheront de ma table pour me servir, ils seront à mon service.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደሴም ይገባሉ ያገለግሉኝም ዘንድ ወደ ገበታዬ ይቀርባሉ ሥርዓቴንም ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils franchiront les portes du parvis intérieur, ils revêtiront des habits de lin; ils n''auront sur eux rien qui soit en laine, quand ils feront le service aux portes du parvis intérieur et dans la maison.
verses.am: ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በር በገቡ ጊዜ የተልባ እግር ልብስ ይልበሱ፤ በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በርና በቤቱ ውስጥ ባገለገሉ ጊዜ ከበግ ጠጕር አንዳች ነገር በላያቸው አይሁን።

verses.en: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
verses.fr: Ils auront des tiares de lin sur la tête, et des caleçons de lin sur leurs reins; ils ne se ceindront point de manière à exciter la sueur.
verses.am: በራሳቸው ላይ የተልባ እግር መጠምጠሚያ ይሁን፥ በወገባቸውም ላይ የተልባ እግር ሱሪ ይሁን፤ የሚያወዛም ነገር አይታጠቁ።

verses.en: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils sortiront pour aller dans le parvis extérieur, dans le parvis extérieur vers le peuple, ils ôteront les vêtements avec lesquels ils font le service, et les déposeront dans les chambres du sanctuaire; ils en mettront d''autres, afin de ne pas sanctifier le peuple par leurs vêtements.
verses.am: ወደ ውጭውም አደባባይ ወደ ሕዝብ በወጡ ጊዜ ያገለገሉበትን ልብሳቸውን ያውልቁ በተቀደሰውም ዕቃ ቤት ውስጥ ያኑሩት፥ ሕዝቡንም በልብሳቸው እንዳይቀድሱ ሌላውን ልብስ ይልበሱ።

verses.en: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
verses.fr: Ils ne se raseront pas la tête, et ne laisseront pas non plus croître leurs cheveux; mais ils devront couper leur chevelure.
verses.am: ራሳቸውንም አይላጩ የራሳቸውንም ጠጕር ይከርከሙ እንጂ ጠጕራቸውን አያሳድጉ።

verses.en: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
verses.fr: Aucun sacrificateur ne boira du vin lorsqu''il entrera dans le parvis intérieur.
verses.am: ካህናቱም ሁሉ በውስጠኛው አደባባይ ሲገቡ የወይን ጠጅ አይጠጡ።

verses.en: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
verses.fr: Ils ne prendront pour femme ni une veuve, ni une femme répudiée, mais ils prendront des vierges de la race de la maison d''Israël; ils pourront aussi prendre la veuve d''un sacrificateur.
verses.am: መበለቲቱንና የተፈታችይቱን አያግቡ፤ ከእስራኤል ቤት ዘር ግን ድንግሊቱን ወይም የካህን ሚስት የነበረችይቱን መበለት ያግቡ።

verses.en: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
verses.fr: Ils enseigneront à mon peuple à distinguer ce qui est saint de ce qui est profane, ils lui feront connaître la différence entre ce qui est impur et ce qui est pur.
verses.am: በተቀደሰውና ባልተቀደሰው መካከል ይለዩ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ያስተምሩ፥ ንጹሕና ንጹሕ ባልሆነው መካከል ይለዩ ዘንድ ያሳዩአቸው።

verses.en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
verses.fr: Ils seront juges dans les contestations, et ils jugeront d''après mes lois. Ils observeront aussi mes lois et mes ordonnances dans toutes mes fêtes, et ils sanctifieront mes sabbats.
verses.am: ክርክርም በሆነ ጊዜ ለመፍረድ ይቁሙ፤ እንደ ፍርዴ ይፍረዱ፤ በበዓላቴ ሁሉ ሕጌንና ሥርዓቴን ይጠብቁ፥ ሰንበታቴንም ይቀድሱ።

verses.en: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
verses.fr: Un sacrificateur n''ira pas vers un mort, de peur de se rendre impur; il ne pourra se rendre impur que pour un père, pour une mère, pour un fils, pour une fille, pour un frère, et pour une soeur qui n''était pas mariée.
verses.am: እንዳይረክሱም ወደ ሞተ ሰው አይግቡ፤ ነገር ግን ለአባት ወይም ለእናት ወይም ለወንድ ልጅ ወይም ለሴት ልጅ ወይም ለወንድም ወይም ላልተዳረች እኅት ይርከሱ።

verses.en: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
verses.fr: Après sa purification, on lui comptera sept jours.
verses.am: ከነጻም በኋላ ሰባት ቀን ይቈጠርለት።

verses.en: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Le jour où il entrera dans le sanctuaire, dans le parvis intérieur, pour faire le service dans le sanctuaire, il offrira son sacrifice d''expiation, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በመቅደስም ውስጥ ያገለግል ዘንድ ወደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ ወደ መቅደሱ በሚገባበት ቀን፥ የኃጢአትን መሥዋዕት ያቅርብ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
verses.fr: Voici l''héritage qu''ils auront: c''est moi qui serai leur héritage. Vous ne leur donnerez point de possession en Israël: je serai leur possession.
verses.am: ርስት ይሆንላቸዋል፤ እኔ ርስታቸው ነኝ፤ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ግዛት አትሰጡአቸው፤ እኔ ግዛታቸው ነኝ።

verses.en: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering: and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
verses.fr: Ils se nourriront des offrandes, des sacrifices d''expiation et de culpabilité; et tout ce qui sera dévoué par interdit en Israël sera pour eux.
verses.am: የእህሉን ቍርባንና የኃጢአትን መሥዋዕት የበደልንም መሥዋዕት ይበላሉ፤ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ እርም የሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ለእነርሱ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
verses.fr: Les prémices de tous les fruits, et toutes les offrandes que vous présenterez par élévation, appartiendront aux sacrificateurs; vous donnerez aux sacrificateurs les prémices de votre pâte, afin que la bénédiction repose sur votre maison.
verses.am: የበኵራቱ ሁሉ መጀመሪያ ከየዓይነቱ ከቍርባናችሁም ሁሉ የማንሣት ቍርባን ሁሉ ለካህናት ይሆናል፤ በቤታችሁም ውስጥ በረከት ያድር ዘንድ የዱቄታችሁን በኵራት ለካህናቱ ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs ne mangeront d''aucun oiseau et d''aucun animal mort ou déchiré.
verses.am: የበከተውንና የተሰበረውን፥ ወፍ ወይም እንስሳ ቢሆን፥ ካህናት አይብሉት።

verses.en: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the Lord, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.
verses.fr: Lorsque vous partagerez le pays en héritage par le sort, vous prélèverez comme une sainte offrande pour l''Eternel une portion du pays, longue de vingt-cinq mille cannes et large de dix mille; elle sera sainte dans toute son étendue.
verses.am: ርስትም አድርጋችሁ ምድርን በዕጣ በምታካፍሉበት ጊዜ ከምድር የተቀደሰውን የዕጣ ክፍል መባ አድርጋችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታቀርባላችሁ። ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል፤ በዳርቻው ሁሉ ዙሪያውን የተቀደሰ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
verses.fr: De cette portion vous prendrez pour le sanctuaire cinq cents cannes sur cinq cents en carré, et cinquante coudées pour un espace libre tout autour.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ርዝመቱ አምስት መቶ ወርዱም አምስት መቶ ክንድ አራት ማዕዘን የሆነ ቦታ ለመቅደሱ ይሆናል፤ በዙሪያውም ባዶ ስፍራ የሚሆን አምሳ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.
verses.fr: Sur cette étendue de vingt-cinq mille cannes en longueur et dix mille en largeur, tu mesureras un emplacement pour le sanctuaire, pour le lieu très saint.
verses.am: ከዚያው ልክ ደግሞ ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ወርዱም አሥር ሺህ ክንድ የሆነ ስፍራ ትለካለህ፤ በእርሱም ውስጥ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን የሆነ መቅደስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the Lord: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.fr: C''est la portion sainte du pays; elle appartiendra aux sacrificateurs qui font le service du sanctuaire, qui s''approchent de l''Eternel pour le servir; c''est là que seront leurs maisons, et ce sera un sanctuaire pour le sanctuaire.
verses.am: ከምድርም የተቀደሰ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ለሚቀርቡ ለመቅደሱ አገልጋዮች ለካህናቱ ይሆናል፥ ለቤቶቻቸውም የሚሆን ስፍራ ለመቅደስም የሚሆን የተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
verses.fr: Vingt-cinq mille cannes en longueur et dix mille en largeur formeront la propriété des Lévites, serviteurs de la maison, avec vingt chambres.
verses.am: ርዝመቱም ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም አሥር ሺህ የሆነ ዕፍራ ለቤቱ አገልጋዮች ለሌዋውያን ይሆናል፥ ለሚቀመጡባቸውም ከተሞች ለራሳቸውም የርስት ይዞታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
verses.fr: Comme propriété de la ville vous destinerez cinq mille cannes en largeur et vingt-cinq mille en longueur, parallèlement à la portion sainte prélevée; ce sera pour toute la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: ለከተማይቱም ይዞታ በተቀደሰው የዕጣ ክፍል መባ አጠገብ ወርዱ አምስት ሺህ ርዝመቱም ሀያ አምስት ሺህ የሆነውን ስፍራ ታደርጋላችሁ። እርሱም ለእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
verses.fr: Pour le prince vous réserverez un espace aux deux côtés de la portion sainte et de la propriété de la ville, le long de la portion sainte et le long de la propriété de la ville, du côté de l''occident vers l''occident et du côté de l''orient vers l''orient, sur une longueur parallèle à l''une des parts, depuis la limite de l''occident jusqu''à la limite de l''orient.
verses.am: ለአለቃውም የሆነ የዕጣ ክፍል በተቀደሰው መባና በከተማይቱ ይዞታ አጠገብ በዚህና በዚያ ይሆናል፤ በተቀደሰው መባና በከተማይቱ ይዞታ ፊት በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ምዕራብ በምሥራቅም በኩል ወደ ምሥራቅ ይሆናል፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ አንድ ነገድ ዕጣ ክፍል ሆኖ ከምድሩ ከምዕራቡ ዳርቻ ጀምሮ እስከ ምሥራቁ ዳርቻ ድረስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
verses.fr: Ce sera sa terre, sa propriété en Israël; et mes princes n''opprimeront plus mon peuple, mais ils laisseront le pays à la maison d''Israël, selon ses tribus.
verses.am: ይህም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ይዞታ ይሆንለታል፥ አለቆቼም ለእስራኤል ቤት ምድሪቱን እንደ ነገዳቸው መጠን ይሰጡአቸዋል እንጂ ሕዝቤን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያስጨንቋቸውም።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Assez, princes d''Israël! cessez la violence et les rapines, pratiquez la droiture et la justice, délivrez mon peuple de vos exactions, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤል አለቆች ሆይ፥ ይብቃችሁ፤ ግፍንና ብዝበዛን አስወግዱ፥ ፍርድንና ጽድቅንም አድርጉ፤ ቅሚያችሁን ከሕዝቤ ላይ አርቁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
verses.fr: Ayez des balances justes, un épha juste, et un bath juste.
verses.am: እውነተኛ ሚዛን እውነተኛም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ እውነተኛውም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.en: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
verses.fr: L''épha et le bath auront la même mesure: le bath contiendra la dixième partie d''un homer, et l''épha la dixième partie d''un homer; leur mesure sera réglée d''après le homer.
verses.am: የኢፍና የባዶስ መስፈሪያ አንድ ይሁን፤ የባዶስ መስፈሪያ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል፥ የኢፍ መስፈሪያውም የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል ይሁን። መስፈሪያው እንደ ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
verses.fr: Le sicle sera de vingt guéras. La mine aura chez vous vingt sicles, vingt-cinq sicles, quinze sicles.
verses.am: ሰቅሉም ሀያ አቦሊ ይሁን፤ ሀያ ሰቅል፥ ሀያ አምስት ሰቅል፥ አሥራ አምስት ሰቅል፥ ምናን ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.en: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
verses.fr: Voici l''offrande que vous prélèverez; la sixième partie d''un épha sur un homer de froment, et la sixième partie d''un épha sur un homer d''orge.
verses.am: የምታቀርቡት መባ ይህ ነው፤ ከአንድ ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ስድስተኛ ክፍል፥ ከአንድም ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ገብስ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ስድስተኛ ክፍል ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:
verses.fr: Ce que vous devrez pour l''huile, pour un bath d''huile, sera la dixième partie d''un bath sur un cor, qui est égal à un homer de dix baths, car dix baths font un homer.
verses.am: የዘይቱም ደንብ፥ ከእያንዳንዱ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የባዶስን አሥረኛ ክፍል ትሰጣላችሁ፤ አሥር የባዶስ መስፈሪያ አንድ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ነውና።

verses.en: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Une brebis sur un troupeau de deux cents dans les gras pâturages d''Israël sera donnée pour l''offrande, l''holocauste et le sacrifice d''actions de grâces, afin de servir de victime expiatoire, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ውኃም ካለበት ከእስራኤል ማሰማርያ ከመንጋው ከሁለቱ መቶ አንዱን የበግ ጠቦት ትሰጣላችሁ፤ ይህ ያስተሰርይላችሁ ዘንድ ለእህል ቍርባንና ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ይሆናል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple du pays devra prélever cette offrande pour le prince d''Israël.
verses.am: የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይህን መባ ለእስራኤል አለቃ ይሰጣሉ።

verses.en: And it shall be the prince's part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Le prince sera chargé des holocaustes, des offrandes et des libations, aux fêtes, aux nouvelles lunes, aux sabbats, à toutes les solennités de la maison d''Israël; il offrira le sacrifice expiatoire, l''offrande, l''holocauste, et le sacrifice d''actions de grâces, en expiation pour la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: በየበዓላቱም በየመባቻውም በየሰንበታቱም በእስራኤልም ቤት ዓመት በዓል ሁሉ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን የመጠጡንም ቍርባን መስጠት በአለቃው ላይ ይሆናል፤ እርሱ ለእስራኤል ቤት ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Le premier jour du premier mois, tu prendras un jeune taureau sans défaut, et tu feras l''expiation du sanctuaire.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ነውር የሌለበትን ወይፈን ውሰድ መቅደሱንም አንጻ።

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra du sang de la victime expiatoire, et il en mettra sur les poteaux de la maison, sur les quatre angles de l''encadrement de l''autel, et sur les poteaux de la porte du parvis intérieur.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ደም ወስዶ በመቅደሱ መቃኖችና በመሠዊያው እርከን በአራቱ ማዕዘን በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በበሩ መቃኖች ላይ ይርጨው።

verses.en: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
verses.fr: Tu feras de même le septième jour du mois, pour ceux qui pèchent involontairement ou par imprudence; vous purifierez ainsi la maison.
verses.am: ከወሩም በሰባተኛው ቀን እንዲሁ አድርግ፥ ይኸውም ስለ ሳተውና ስላላወቀው ሁሉ ነው። እንዲሁም ስለ ቤቱ አስተስርዩ።

verses.en: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.fr: Le quatorzième jour du premier mois, vous aurez la Pâque. La fête durera sept jours; on mangera des pains sans levain.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን የፋሲካን በዓል ታደርጋላችሁ። እስከ ሰባት ቀንም ድረስ ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
verses.fr: Le prince offrira ce jour-là, pour lui et pour tout le peuple du pays, un taureau en sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን አለቃው ለራሱና ለአገሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ወይፈን ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the Lord, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
verses.fr: Pendant les sept jours de la fête, il offrira en holocauste à l''Eternel sept taureaux et sept béliers sans défaut, chacun des sept jours, et un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, chaque jour.
verses.am: በበዓሉም በሰባቱ ቀኖች የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ያቅርብ፤ ሰባቱን ቀኖች በየዕለቱ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሰባት ወይፈንና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ያቅርብ፤ ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት በየዕለቱ አንድ አውራ ፍየል ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
verses.fr: Il y joindra l''offrande d''un épha pour chaque taureau et d''un épha pour chaque bélier, avec un hin d''huile par épha.
verses.am: ለአንድም ወይፈን አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለአንድም አውራ በግ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለአንድም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ለእህል ቍርባን ያቅርብ።

verses.en: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
verses.fr: Le quinzième jour du septième mois, à la fête, il offrira pendant sept jours les mêmes sacrifices d''expiation, les mêmes holocaustes, et la même offrande avec l''huile.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በበዓሉ ሰባት ቀኖች፥ የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት የእህሉንም ቍርባን ከዘይቱ ጋር እንዲሁ ያቅርብ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: La porte du parvis intérieur, du côté de l''orient, restera fermée les six jours ouvriers; mais elle sera ouverte le jour du sabbat, elle sera aussi ouverte le jour de la nouvelle lune.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በውስጠኛው አደባባይ ወደ ምሥራቅ የሚመለከተው በር ሥራ በሚሠራበት በስድስቱ ቀን ተዘግቶ ይቈይ፤ ነገር ግን በሰንበት ቀንና በመባቻ ቀን ይከፈት።

verses.en: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
verses.fr: Le prince entrera par le chemin du vestibule de la porte extérieure, et se tiendra près des poteaux de la porte; les sacrificateurs offriront son holocauste et ses sacrifices d''actions de grâces; il se prosternera sur le seuil de la porte, puis il sortira, et la porte ne sera pas fermée avant le soir.
verses.am: አለቃውም በስተ ውጭ ባለው በር በደጀ ሰላሙ መንገድ ገብቶ በበሩ መቃን አጠገብ ይቁም፥ ካህናቱም የእርሱን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቅርቡ፥ እርሱም በበሩ መድረክ ላይ ይስገድ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ይውጣ፥ በሩ ግን እስከ ማታ ድረስ አይዘጋ።

verses.en: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the Lord in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
verses.fr: Le peuple du pays se prosternera devant l''Eternel à l''entrée de cette porte, aux jours de sabbat et aux nouvelles lunes.
verses.am: የአገሩም ሕዝብ በዚያ በር መግቢያ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሰንበታትና በመባቻ ይስገዱ።

verses.en: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the Lord in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
verses.fr: L''holocauste que le prince offrira à l''Eternel, le jour du sabbat, sera de six agneaux sans défaut et d''un bélier sans défaut;
verses.am: አለቃውም በሰንበት ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸው ስድስት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነውርም የሌለበት አንድ አውራ በግ ይሁን፤

verses.en: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.fr: et son offrande, d''un épha pour le bélier, et de ce qu''il voudra pour les agneaux, avec un hin d''huile par épha.
verses.am: የእህሉም ቍርባን ለአውራ በጉ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ይሁን፥ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባን እንደሚቻል ያህል ይሁን፥ ለአንዱም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
verses.fr: Le jour de la nouvelle lune, il offrira un jeune taureau sans défaut, six agneaux et un bélier qui seront sans défaut;
verses.am: በመባቻም ቀን ነውር የሌለበትን አንድ ወይፈን፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውንም ስድስት ጠቦቶችና አንድ አውራ በግ ያቅርብ፤

verses.en: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.fr: et son offrande sera d''un épha pour le taureau, d''un épha pour le bélier, et de ce qu''il voudra pour les agneaux, avec un hin d''huile par épha.
verses.am: ለወይፈኑም አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለአውራውም በግ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለጠቦቶቹም እንደ ተቻለው ያህል፥ ለአንዱም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ለእህሉ ቍርባን ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
verses.fr: Lorsque le prince entrera, il entrera par le chemin du vestibule de la porte, et il sortira par le même chemin.
verses.am: አለቃውም በሚገባበት ጊዜ በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም መንገድ ይግባ በዚያውም ይውጣ።

verses.en: But when the people of the land shall come before the Lord in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
verses.fr: Mais lorsque le peuple du pays se présentera devant l''Eternel, aux solennités, celui qui entrera par la porte septentrionale pour se prosterner sortira par la porte méridionale, et celui qui entrera par la porte méridionale sortira par la porte septentrionale; on ne devra pas s''en retourner par la porte par laquelle on sera entré, mais on sortira par celle qui lui est opposée.
verses.am: የአገሩ ሕዝብ ግን በየክብረ በዓሉ ቀን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት በመጡ ጊዜ በሰሜን በር በኩል ሊሰግድ የሚገባው በደቡብ በር በኩል ይውጣ፥ በደቡብም በር የሚገባው በሰሜን በር በኩል ይውጣ፤ በፊት ለፊት ይውጣ እንጂ በገባበቱ በር አይመለስ።

verses.en: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
verses.fr: Le prince entrera parmi eux quand ils entreront, et sortira quand ils sortiront.
verses.am: በሚገቡበት ጊዜ አለቃው በመካከላቸው ይግባ በሚወጡበትም ጊዜ ይውጣ።

verses.en: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.fr: Aux fêtes et aux solennités, l''offrande sera d''un épha pour le taureau, d''un épha pour le bélier, et de ce qu''il voudra pour les agneaux, avec un hin d''huile par épha.
verses.am: በበዓላትና በክብረ በዓል ቀኖች የእህሉ ቍርባን ለወይፈኑ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ፥ ለአውራ በጉ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ፥ ለጠቦቶቹም እንደሚቻለው ያህል፥ ለኢፍ መስፈሪያም አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the Lord, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.
verses.fr: Si le prince offre à l''Eternel un holocauste volontaire ou un sacrifice volontaire d''actions de grâces, on lui ouvrira la porte qui est du côté de l''orient, et il offrira son holocauste et son sacrifice d''actions de grâces comme il doit le faire le jour du sabbat; puis il sortira, et l''on fermera la porte après qu''il sera sorti.
verses.am: አለቃውም በፈቃዱ የሚያቀርበውን መሥዋዕት፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ ወይም በፈቃዱ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበውን የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት፥ ባቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ምሥራቅ የሚመለከተው በር ይከፈትለት፥ በሰንበትም ቀን እንደሚያደርግ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቅርብ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ይውጣ፥ ከወጣም በኋላ በሩ ይዘጋ።

verses.en: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the Lord of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
verses.fr: Tu offriras chaque jour en holocauste à l''Eternel un agneau d''un an, sans défaut; tu l''offriras tous les matins.
verses.am: በየዕለቱም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለበትን የአንድ ዓመት በግ ጠቦት ለእግዚአብሔር ያቅርብ፤ በየማለዳው ያቅርበው።

verses.en: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu y joindras pour offrande, tous les matins, un sixième d''épha, et le tiers d''un hin d''huile pour pétrir la farine. C''est l''offrande à l''Eternel, une loi perpétuelle, pour toujours.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር የእህልን ቍርባን፥ በኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶ ዘይት የተለወሰ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ስድስተኛ እጅ መልካም ዱቄትን፥ በየማለዳው ያቅርብ፤ ይህ በዘላለሙ ሥርዓት ለእግዚአብሔር የዘወትር የእህል ቍርባን ይሁን።

verses.en: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.
verses.fr: On offrira, tous les matins, l''agneau et l''offrande avec l''huile, comme holocauste perpétuel.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ዘወትር ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ጠቦቱንና የእህሉን ቍርባን ዘይቱንም በየማለዳው ያቅርብ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Si le prince fait à l''un de ses fils un don pris sur son héritage, ce don appartiendra à ses fils, ce sera leur propriété comme héritage.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አለቃው ከልጆቹ ለአንዱ ከርስቱ ስጦታ ቢሰጥ ለልጆቹ ይሁን፤ የርስት ይዞታ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.en: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.
verses.fr: Mais s''il fait à l''un de ses serviteurs un don pris sur son héritage, ce don lui appartiendra jusqu''à l''année de la liberté, puis il retournera au prince; ses fils seuls posséderont ce qu''il leur donnera de son héritage.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከባሪያዎቹ ለአንዱ ከርስቱ ስጦታ ቢሰጥ እስከ ነጻነት ዓመት ድረሰ ለእርሱ ይሁን፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ለአለቃው ይመለስ፤ ርስቱ ግን ለልጆቹ ይሁን።

verses.en: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
verses.fr: Le prince ne prendra rien de l''héritage du peuple, il ne le dépouillera pas de ses possessions; ce qu''il donnera en héritage à ses fils, il le prendra sur ce qu''il possède, afin que nul parmi mon peuple ne soit éloigné de sa possession.
verses.am: አለቃውም ሕዝቡን ከይዞታቸው ያወጣቸው ዘንድ ከርስታቸው በግድ አይውሰድ፤ ሕዝቤ ሁሉ ከይዞታቸው እንዳይነቀሉ ከገዛ ይዞታው ለልጆች ርስትን ይስጥ።

verses.en: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit, par l''entrée qui était à côté de la porte, dans les chambres saintes destinées aux sacrificateurs, vers le septentrion. Et voici, il y avait un lieu dans le fond, du côté de l''occident.
verses.am: በበሩም አጠገብ ባለው መግቢያ ወደ ሰሜን ወደሚመለከተው ለካህናት ወደሚሆን ወደ ተቀደሰው ዕቃ ቤት አገባኝ፤ እነሆም፥ በኋላው በምዕራብ በኩል አንድ ስፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
verses.fr: Il me dit: C''est le lieu où les sacrificateurs feront cuire la chair des sacrifices de culpabilité et d''expiation, et où ils feront cuire les offrandes, pour éviter de les porter dans le parvis extérieur et de sanctifier le peuple.
verses.am: እርሱም። ካህናቱ ሕዝቡን ለመቀደስ ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ እንዳያወጡ የበደሉን መሥዋዕትና የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት የሚቀቅሉበት፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን የሚጋግሩበት ስፍራ ይህ ነው አለኝ።

verses.en: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit ensuite dans le parvis extérieur, et me fit passer vers les quatre angles du parvis. Et voici, il y avait une cour à chacun des angles du parvis.
verses.am: በውጭው አደባባይ አወጣኝ በአደባባይም ወዳለው ወደ አራቱ ማዕዘን አዞረኝ፤ እነሆም፥ በአደባባዩ ማዕዘን ሁሉ አደባባይ ነበረ።

verses.en: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.
verses.fr: Aux quatre angles du parvis il y avait des cours voûtées, longues de quarante coudées et larges de trente; toutes les quatre avaient la même mesure, dans les angles.
verses.am: በአደባባዩ በአራቱ ማዕዘን ርዝመቱ አርባ ክንድ ወርዱም ሠላሳ ክንድ የሆነ የታጠረ አደባባይ ነበረ፤ በማዕዘኑ ላሉ ለእነዚህ ለአራቱ ስፍራዎች አንድ ልክ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
verses.fr: Un mur les entourait toutes les quatre, et des foyers étaient pratiqués au bas du mur tout autour.
verses.am: በአራቱም ዙሪያ ሁሉ ግንብ ነበረ፥ በግንቡም ሥር በዙሪያው የመቀቀያ ቦታ ነበረ።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Ce sont les cuisines, où les serviteurs de la maison feront cuire la chair des sacrifices offerts par le peuple.
verses.am: እርሱም። እነዚህ የቤቱ አገልጋዮች የሕዝቡን መሥዋዕት የሚቀቅሉባቸው ስፍራዎች ናቸው አለኝ።

verses.en: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.
verses.fr: Il me ramena vers la porte de la maison. Et voici, de l''eau sortait sous le seuil de la maison, à l''orient, car la face de la maison était à l''orient; l''eau descendait sous le côté droit de la maison, au midi de l''autel.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደሱም መዝጊያ መለሰኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ውኃ ከቤቱ መድረክ በታች ወደ ምሥራቅ ይወጣ ነበር፥ የቤቱ ፊት ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከት ነበርና፤ ውኃውም ከቤቱ ከቀኝ ወገን በታች በመሠዊያው በደቡብ በኩል ይወርድ ነበር።

verses.en: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.fr: Il me conduisit par le chemin de la porte septentrionale, et il me fit faire le tour par dehors jusqu''à l''extérieur de la porte orientale. Et voici, l''eau coulait du côté droit.
verses.am: በሰሜኑም በር በኩል አወጣኝ፤ በስተ ውጭ ባለው መንገድ፥ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደሚመለከት በስተ ውጭ ወዳለው በር አዞረኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ውኃው በቀኙ ወገን ይፈስስ ነበር።

verses.en: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''homme s''avança vers l''orient, il avait dans la main un cordeau, et il mesura mille coudées; il me fit traverser l''eau, et j''avais de l''eau jusqu''aux chevilles.
verses.am: ሰውዬውም ገመዱን በእጁ ይዞ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወጣ አንድ ሺህም ክንድ ለካ፥ በውኃውም ውስጥ አሻገረኝ፥ ውኃም እስከ ቍርጭምጭሚት ደረሰ።

verses.en: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
verses.fr: Il mesura encore mille coudées, et me fit traverser l''eau, et j''avais de l''eau jusqu''aux genoux. Il mesura encore mille coudées, et me fit traverser, et j''avais de l''eau jusqu''aux reins.
verses.am: ደግሞ አንድ ሺህ ለካ በውኃውም ውስጥ አሻገረኝ፥ ውኃውም እስከ ጕልበት ደረሰ። ደግሞም አንድ ሺህ ለካ በውኃውም ውስጥ አሻገረኝ፥ ውኃውም እስከ ወገብ ደረሰ።

verses.en: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
verses.fr: Il mesura encore mille coudées; c''était un torrent que je ne pouvais traverser, car l''eau était si profonde qu''il fallait y nager; c''était un torrent qu''on ne pouvait traverser.
verses.am: ደግሞ አንድ ሺህ ለካ ልሻገረውም የማልችለው ወንዝ ሆነ፤ ውኃውም ጥልቅ ነበረ፥ የሚዋኝበትም ውኃ ነበረ፤ ሰው ሊሻገረው የማይችለው ወንዝ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
verses.fr: Il me dit: As-tu vu, fils de l''homme? Et il me ramena au bord du torrent.
verses.am: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ አይተሃልን? አለኝ። አመጣኝም፥ ወደ ወንዙም ዳር መለሰኝ።

verses.en: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.fr: Quand il m''eut ramené, voici, il y avait sur le bord du torrent beaucoup d''arbres de chaque côté.
verses.am: በተመለስሁም ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በወንዙ ዳር በዚህና በዚያ እጅግ ብዙ ዛፎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Cette eau coulera vers le district oriental, descendra dans la plaine, et entrera dans la mer; lorsqu''elle se sera jetée dans la mer, les eaux de la mer deviendront saines.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ይህ ውኃ ወደ ምሥራቅ ምድር ይወጣል ወደ ዓረባም ይወርዳል ወደ ባሕሩም ይገባል፤ ወደ ባሕሩም ወደ ረከሰው ውኃ በገባ ጊዜ ውኃው ይፈወሳል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
verses.fr: Tout être vivant qui se meut vivra partout où le torrent coulera, et il y aura une grande quantité de poissons; car là où cette eau arrivera, les eaux deviendront saines, et tout vivra partout où parviendra le torrent.
verses.am: ሕያው ነፍስ ያለው ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ ወንዙ በመጣበት ስፍራ ሁሉ በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ ይህም ውኃ በዚያ ስለ ደረሰ ዓሣዎች እጅግ ይበዛሉ፤ የባሕሩም ውኃ ይፈወሳል፥ ወንዙም በሚመጣበት ያለው ሁሉ በሕይወት ይኖራል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto Eneglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.fr: Des pêcheurs se tiendront sur ses bords; depuis En-Guédi jusqu''à En-Eglaïm, on étendra les filets; il y aura des poissons de diverses espèces, comme les poissons de la grande mer, et ils seront très nombreux.
verses.am: አጥማጆችም በዚያ ይቆማሉ፤ ከዓይንጋዲ ጀምሮ እስከ ዓይንኤግላይም ድረስ መረብ መዘርጊያ ይሆናል፤ ዓሣዎችም እንደ ታላቁ ባሕር ዓሣዎች በየወገናቸው እጅግ ይበዛሉ።

verses.en: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
verses.fr: Ses marais et ses fosses ne seront point assainis, ils seront abandonnés au sel.
verses.am: እረግረጉና እቋሪው ውኃ ግን ጨው እንደ ሆነ ይኖራል እንጂ አይፈወስም።

verses.en: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
verses.fr: Sur le torrent, sur ses bords de chaque côté, croîtront toutes sortes d''arbres fruitiers. Leur feuillage ne se flétrira point, et leurs fruits n''auront point de fin, ils mûriront tous les mois, parce que les eaux sortiront du sanctuaire. Leurs fruits serviront de nourriture, et leurs feuilles de remède.
verses.am: በወንዙም አጠገብ በዳሩ ላይ በዚህና በዚያ ፍሬው የሚበላ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይበቅላል፥ ቅጠሉም አይረግፍም ፍሬውም አይጐድልም፤ ውኃውም ከመቅደስ ይወጣልና በየወሩ ሁሉ የፍሬ በኵር ያገኛል፤ ፍሬውም ለመብል ቅጠሉም ለመድኃኒት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici les limites du pays que vous distribuerez en héritage aux douze tribus d''Israël. Joseph aura deux parts.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ርስት አድርጋችሁ ለአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገዶች ምድሪቱን የምትከፍሉበት ድንበር ይህ ነው። ለዮሴፍ ሁለት እድል ፈንታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.fr: Vous en aurez la possession l''un comme l''autre; car j''ai juré, la main levée, de le donner à vos pères. Ce pays vous tombera donc en partage.
verses.am: ለአባቶቻችሁ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ምዬ ነበርና እናንተ እኩል አድርጋችሁ ተካፈሉት ይህችም ምድር ርስት ትሆናችኋለች።

verses.en: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
verses.fr: Voici les limites du pays. Du côté septentrional, depuis la grande mer, le chemin de Hethlon jusqu''à Tsedad,
verses.am: የምድሪቱም ድንበር ይህ ነው። በሰሜኑ ወገን ከታላቁ ባሕር ጀምሮ በሔትሎን መንገድ ወደ ጽዳድ መግቢያ፤

verses.en: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazarhatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
verses.fr: Hamath, Bérotha, Sibraïm, entre la frontière de Damas et la frontière de Hamath, Hatzer-Hatthicon, vers la frontière de Havran;
verses.am: ሐማት፥ ቤሮታ፥ በደማስቆ ድንበርና በሐማት ድንበር መካከል ያለው ሲብራይም፥ በሐውራን ድንበር አጠገብ ያለው ሐጸርሃቲኮን።

verses.en: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
verses.fr: ainsi la limite sera, depuis la mer, Hatsar-Enon, la frontière de Damas, Tsaphon au nord, et la frontière de Hamath: ce sera le côté septentrional.
verses.am: ድንበሩ ከባሕሩ በደማስቆ ድንበር ላይ ያለው ሐጸርዔናን ይሆናል፥ በሰሜንም በኩል የሐማት ድንበር አለ። የሰሜኑ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
verses.fr: Le côté oriental sera le Jourdain, entre Havran, Damas et Galaad, et le pays d''Israël; vous mesurerez depuis la limite septentrionale jusqu''à la mer orientale: ce sera le côté oriental.
verses.am: የምሥራቁም ድንበር በሐውራን በደማስቆና በገለዓድ በእስራኤልም ምድር መካከል ዮርዳኖስ ይሆናል። ከሰሜኑ ድንበር ጀምሮ እስከ ምሥራቁ ባሕር እስከ ታማር ድረስ የምሥራቁ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
verses.fr: Le côté méridional, au midi, ira depuis Thamar jusqu''aux eaux de Meriba à Kadès, jusqu''au torrent vers la grande mer: ce sera le côté méridional.
verses.am: የደቡቡም ድንበር ከታማር ጀምሮ እስከ ሜርባ ቃዴስ ውኃ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ድረስ ይሆናል። የደቡቡ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.fr: Le côté occidental sera la grande mer, depuis la limite jusque vis-à-vis de Hamath: ce sera le côté occidental.
verses.am: የምዕራቡም ድንበር ከደቡቡ ድንበር ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ አንጻር ድረስ ታላቁ ባሕር ይሆናል። የምዕራቡ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: Vous partagerez ce pays entre vous, selon les tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ይህችን ምድር እንደ እስራኤል ነገዶች መጠን ለእናንተ ትካፈላላችሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: Vous le diviserez en héritage par le sort pour vous et pour les étrangers qui séjourneront au milieu de vous, qui engendreront des enfants au milieu de vous; vous les regarderez comme indigènes parmi les enfants d''Israël; ils partageront au sort l''héritage avec vous parmi les tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: ለእናንተና በእናንተ መካከል ለሚቀመጡ በእናንተም መካከል ልጆችን ለሚወልዱ መጻተኞች ርስት አድርጋችሁ በዕጣ ትካፈሉአታላችሁ፤ እነርሱም በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል እንዳሉ የአገር ልጆች ይሆኑላችኋል፥ በእስራኤልም ነገዶች መካከል ከእናንተ ጋር ርስትን ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Vous donnerez à l''étranger son héritage dans la tribu où il séjournera, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: መጻተኛውም በማናቸውም ነገድ መካከል ቢቀመጥ በዚያ ርስቱን ትሰጡታላችሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazarenan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des tribus. Depuis l''extrémité septentrionale, le long du chemin de Hethlon à Hamath, Hatsar-Enon, la frontière de Damas au nord vers Hamath, de l''orient à l''occident: Dan, une tribu.
verses.am: የነገዶችም ስም ይህ ነው። በሔትሎን መንገድ አጠገብ ወደ ሐማት መግቢያ በደማስቆም ድንበር ባለው በሐጸርዔናን በሐማትም አጠገብ በሰሜን በኩል ካለው ከሰሜን ድንበር ይጀምራል። ወርዳቸውም ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ይሆናል። ለዳን አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Dan, de l''orient à l''occident: Aser, une tribu.
verses.am: ከዳንም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለአሴር አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
verses.fr: Sur la limite d''Aser, de l''orient à l''occident: Nephthali, une tribu.
verses.am: ከአሴርም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለንፍታሌም አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Nephthali, de l''orient à l''occident: Manassé, une tribu.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለምናሴ አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Manassé, de l''orient à l''occident: Ephraïm, une tribu.
verses.am: ከምናሴም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለኤፍሬም አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
verses.fr: Sur la limite d''Ephraïm, de l''orient à l''occident: Ruben, une tribu.
verses.am: ከኤፍሬምም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለሮቤል አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Ruben, de l''orient à l''occident: Juda, une tribu.
verses.am: ከሮቤልም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለይሁዳ አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.fr: Sur la frontière de Juda, de l''orient à l''occident, sera la portion que vous prélèverez, large de vingt-cinq mille cannes et longue comme l''une des parts de l''orient à l''occident; et le sanctuaire sera au milieu.
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለመባ የሆነ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል፤ ወርዱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል ርዝመቱም ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ከዕጣ ክፍሎች እንደ አንዱ ይሆናል፥ መቅደሱም በመካከሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the Lord shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
verses.fr: La portion que vous prélèverez pour l''Eternel aura vingt-cinq mille cannes de longueur et dix mille de largeur.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የምታቀርቡት መባ ርዝመቱ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም ሃያ ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the Lord shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.fr: C''est aux sacrificateurs qu''appartiendra cette portion sainte: vingt-cinq mille cannes au septentrion, dix mille en largeur à l''occident, dix mille en largeur à l''orient, et vingt-cinq mille en longueur au midi; et le sanctuaire de l''Eternel sera au milieu.
verses.am: ለእነዚህም ለካህናቱ የተቀደሰ መባ ይሆናል፤ በሰሜን በኩል ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ወርዱ አሥር ሺህ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ወርዱ አሥር ሺህ፥ በደቡብም በኩል ርዝመቱ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል። የእግዚአብሔርም መቅደስ በመካከሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.fr: Elle appartiendra aux sacrificateurs consacrés, aux fils de Tsadok, qui ont fait le service de mon sanctuaire, qui ne se sont point égarés, lorsque les enfants d''Israël s''égaraient, comme s''égaraient les Lévites.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በሳቱ ጊዜ፥ ሌዋውያን እንደ ሳቱ ላልሳቱት ሥርዓቴን ለጠበቁት ከሳዶቅ ልጆች ወገን ለተቀደሱት ካህናት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
verses.fr: Elle leur appartiendra comme portion très sainte, prélevée sur la portion du pays qui aura été prélevée, à côté de la limite des Lévites.
verses.am: ከምድርም መባ የተለየ መባ ይሆንላቸዋል፥ ከሁሉም ይልቅ የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ በሌዋውያን ድንበር አጠገብ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.fr: Les Lévites auront, parallèlement à la limite des sacrificateurs, vingt-cinq mille cannes en longueur et dix mille en largeur, vingt-cinq mille pour toute la longueur et dix mille pour la largeur.
verses.am: በካህናቱም ድንበር አንጻር ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም አሥር ሺህ የሆነ ዕጣ ለሌዋውያን ይሆናል፤ ርዝመቱ ሁሉ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም ሀያ ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils n''en pourront rien vendre ni échanger; et les prémices du pays ne seront point aliénées, car elles sont consacrées à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም የተቀደሰ ነውና ከእርሱ ምንም አይሸጡም አይለውጡምም፥ የምድሩም በኵራት አይፋለስም።

verses.en: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.fr: Les cinq mille cannes qui resteront en largeur sur les vingt-cinq mille seront destinées à la ville, pour les habitations et la banlieue; et la ville sera au milieu.
verses.am: በሀያ አምስቱም ሺህ አንጻር አምስት ሺህ ወርድ ያለው የቀረ ስፍራ ለከተማይቱ ለጋራ ጉዳይዋ፥ ለመኖሪያ ለማስማርያም ይሆናል፤ ከተማይቱም በመካከሉ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: En voici les mesures: du côté septentrional quatre mille cinq cents, du côté méridional quatre mille cinq cents, du côté oriental quatre mille cinq cents, et du côté occidental quatre mille cinq cents.
verses.am: ልክዋም ይህ ነው፤ በሰሜን በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በደቡብም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.fr: La ville aura une banlieue de deux cent cinquante au nord, de deux cent cinquante au midi, de deux cent cinquante à l''orient, et de deux cent cinquante à l''occident.
verses.am: ለከተማይቱም ማሰማርያ ይኖራታል፤ በሰሜን በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በደቡብም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
verses.fr: Le reste sur la longueur, parallèlement à la portion sainte, dix mille à l''orient et dix mille à l''occident, parallèlement à la portion sainte, formera les revenus destinés à l''entretien de ceux qui travailleront pour la ville.
verses.am: በተቀደሰው መባ አንጻር የተረፈው ርዝመቱ ወደ ምሥራቅ አሥር ሺህ ወደ ምዕራብም አሥር ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል። በተቀደሰው መባ አንጻር ይሆናል። ፍሬውም ከተማይቱን ለሚያገለግሉ ለመብል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: Le sol en sera cultivé par ceux de toutes les tribus d''Israël qui travailleront pour la ville.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ከተማይቱን የሚያገለግሉ ያርሱታል።

verses.en: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.fr: Toute la portion prélevée sera de vingt-cinq mille cannes en longueur sur vingt-cinq mille en largeur; vous en séparerez un carré pour la propriété de la ville.
verses.am: መባው ሁሉ ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል፤ የተቀደሰውን መባ ከከተማይቱ ይዞታ ጋር አራት ማዕዘን አድርጋችሁ ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.fr: Ce qui restera sera pour le prince, aux deux côtés de la portion sainte et de la propriété de la ville, le long des vingt-cinq mille cannes de la portion sainte jusqu''à la limite de l''orient, et à l''occident le long des vingt-cinq mille cannes vers la limite de l''occident, parallèlement aux parts. C''est là ce qui appartiendra au prince; et la portion sainte et le sanctuaire de la maison seront au milieu.
verses.am: በተቀደሰው መባና በከተማይቱ ይዞታ በዚህና በዚያ ወገን የቀረው ለአለቃው ይሆናል፤ በመባው በሀያ አምስቱ ሺህ ፊት ወደ ምሥራቁ ድንበር፥ በምዕራብም በኩል በሀያ አምስቱ ሺህ ፊት ወደ ምዕራቡ ድንበር፥ እንደ ዕጣ ክፍል ሁሉ መጠን፥ ለአለቃው ይሆናል፤ የተቀደሰውም መባና ቤተ መቅደሱ በመካከሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
verses.fr: Ainsi ce qui appartiendra au prince sera l''espace compris depuis la propriété des Lévites et depuis la propriété de la ville; ce qui sera entre la limite de Juda et la limite de Benjamin appartiendra au prince.
verses.am: የሌዋውያንም ርስት የከተማይቱም ይዞታ ለአለቃው በሆነው መካከል ይሆናል፤ በይሁዳ ድንበርና በብንያም ድንበር መካከል የአለቃ ዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
verses.fr: Voici les autres tribus. De l''orient à l''occident: Benjamin, une tribu.
verses.am: ለቀሩትም ነገዶች እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለብንያም አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Benjamin, de l''orient à l''occident: Siméon, une tribu.
verses.am: ከብንያምም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለስምዖን አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Siméon, de l''orient à l''occident: Issacar, une tribu.
verses.am: ከስምዖንም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለይሳኮር አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
verses.fr: Sur la limite d''Issacar, de l''orient à l''occident: Zabulon, une tribu.
verses.am: ከይሳኮርም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለዛብሎን አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Zabulon, de l''orient à l''occident: Gad, une tribu.
verses.am: ከዛብሎንም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለጋድ አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
verses.fr: Sur la limite de Gad, du côté méridional, au midi, la frontière ira depuis Thamar, jusqu''aux eaux de Meriba à Kadès, jusqu''au torrent vers la grande mer.
verses.am: ከጋድም ድንበር ቀጥሎ በደቡብ በኩል ድንበሩ ከታማር ጀምሮ እስከ ሜሪባ ቃዴስ ውኃ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ድረስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Tel est le pays que vous diviserez en héritage par le sort pour les tribus d''Israël et telles sont leurs parts, dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: ርስት አድርጋችሁ ለእስራኤል ነገዶች በዕጣ የምታካፍሉአት ምድር ይህች ናት፥ የእያንዳንዱም ዕጣ እንደዚህ ነው፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
verses.fr: Voici les issues de la ville. Du côté septentrional quatre mille cinq cents cannes.
verses.am: የከተማይቱም መውጫዎች እነዚህ ናቸው። በሰሜን ወገን ልኩ አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ ነው።

verses.en: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
verses.fr: et les portes de la ville d''après les noms des tribus d''Israël, trois portes au nord: la porte de Ruben, une, la porte de Juda, une, la porte de Lévi, une.
verses.am: የከተማይቱ በሮች እንደ እስራኤል ነገዶች ስም ይሆናሉ፤ በሰሜን በኩል አንዱ የሮቤል በር አንዱም የይሁዳ በር አንዱም የሌዊ በር፥ ሦስት በሮች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
verses.fr: Du côté oriental quatre mille cinq cents cannes, et trois portes: la porte de Joseph, une, la porte de Benjamin, une, la porte de Dan, une.
verses.am: በምሥራቁም ወገን አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ሦስትም በሮች አሉ፤ አንዱ የዮሴፍ በር አንዱም የብንያም በር አንዱም የዳን በር ነው።

verses.en: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
verses.fr: Du côté méridional quatre mille cinq cents cannes, et trois portes: la porte de Siméon, une, la porte d''Issacar, une, la porte de Zabulon, une.
verses.am: በደቡቡም ወገን ልኩ አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ሦስትም በሮች አሉ፤ አንዱ የስምዖን በር አንዱም የይሳኮር በር አንዱም የዛብሎን በር ነው።

verses.en: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
verses.fr: Du côté occidental quatre mille cinq cents cannes, et trois portes: la porte de Gad, une, la porte d''Aser, une, la porte de Nephthali, une.
verses.am: በምዕራቡም ወገን ልኩ አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ሦስትም በሮች አሉ፤ አንዱ የጋድ በር አንዱም የአሴር በር አንዱም የንፍታሌም በር ነው።

verses.en: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The Lord is there.
verses.fr: Circuit: dix-huit mille cannes. Et, dès ce jour, le nom de la ville sera: l''Eternel est ici.
verses.am: ዙሪያዋም አሥራ ስምንት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል፥ ከዚያም ቀን ጀምሮ የከተማይቱ ስም። እግዚአብሔር በዚያ አለ ተብሎ ይጠራል።
